🎯 CEL PROJEKTU
System do zarządzania treścią Amazon A+ Content przez Google Sheets:

Import danych - z JSON przez Google Forms do arkusza
Edycja w arkuszu - wielojęzyczne treści A+ (DE, EN, FR, IT, ES, NL, PL, SE)
Publikacja do Amazon - przez SP-API z placeholder obrazami lub prawdziwymi
✅ CO ZOSTAŁO ZROBIONE (commity)
d5f6cc9 feat: Auto-create missing columns during JSON form import
71b74f4 feat: Dynamic A+ Basic column generation and column management tools
f4ad07f fix: STANDARD_SINGLE_IMAGE_HIGHLIGHTS module structure and locale format
a8d6649 fix: bulletedListBlock as array of objects with headline property
fcfa96b fix: Toast notifications now auto-hide after 30 seconds

Auto-tworzenie kolumn przy imporcie JSON ✅
Plik: FormImport.gs (linie 260-322)
Gdy JSON jest importowany przez formularz:

Zbiera wszystkie nazwy kolumn z JSON
Porównuje z istniejącymi nagłówkami arkusza
Automatycznie dodaje brakujące kolumny przed kolumną "Status"
Sortuje kolumny alfabetycznie
2. Dynamiczny generator kolumn A+ Basic ✅
Plik: SpreadsheetGenerator.gs (funkcja getAPlusBasicHeaders())

Generuje kolumny dla WSZYSTKICH typów modułów:

image_id, image1_id - image4_id
headline_XX, body_XX (XX = język)
block1_headline_XX - block4_headline_XX
block1_body_XX - block4_body_XX
highlight1_XX - highlight8_XX
textBlock1_headline_XX - textBlock3_headline_XX
Wszystkie 8 języków, wszystkie 7 modułów
3. Narzędzia do dodawania kolumn ✅
Plik: SpreadsheetGenerator.gs + LukoAmazonManager.gs

Menu → Tools:

"Add A+ Module Columns" - dodaje WSZYSTKIE kolumny dla modułu N
"Add Essential A+ Columns" - dodaje podstawowe kolumny (np. "2 EN")
4. Format locale ✅
Plik: SPApiDirect.gs (linie 772-804)

Zmieniono z de-DE na de_DE (format wymagany przez Amazon API)

STANDARD_SINGLE_IMAGE_HIGHLIGHTS ✅
Plik: APlusModuleBuilder.gs (linie 447-525)
Struktura modułu:

image - obraz główny
headline - nagłówek
textBlock1-3 - bloki tekstowe (headline + body)
bulletedListBlock - tablica punktów
6. Toast notifications ✅
Pliki: ExportOptions.gs, ProductImporter.gs, ReverseFeedImporter.gs, LukoAmazonManager.gs

Wszystkie toast'y mają teraz timeout (5-30 sekund) zamiast -1 (nieskończony)

❌ PROBLEMY DO ROZWIĄZANIA

Eksport angielski (EN) nie działa
Symptom: Logi pokazują:
Module content languages: EN
Content keys: headline (brak block1_headline, block1_body)

Przyczyna: Arkusz użytkownika NIE MA kolumn dla block1_headline_EN, block1_body_EN itd.

Rozwiązanie:

Użyć nowej funkcji "Add Essential A+ Columns" (np. "2 EN")
LUB zaimportować JSON ponownie - nowy kod powinien auto-utworzyć kolumny
2. STANDARD_TEXT moduł pusty
Symptom w logach:

⚠️ Warning: No module content found for STANDARD_TEXT. Using empty content.
standardText: {}

Przyczyna: Arkusz nie ma kolumn aplus_basic_m5_headline_EN, aplus_basic_m5_body_EN

Rozwiązanie: Dodać kolumny lub zaimportować JSON ponownie

Okienko "Working..." nie znika
Status: NIE ZNALEZIONO w kodzie tekstu "Working..."
Wszystkie toast'y używają "Processing..." z timeoutami. Możliwe przyczyny:

Użytkownik nie wgrał najnowszego kodu
To jest natywny spinner Google Sheets (nie kontrolowany przez kod)
Cache przeglądarki
4. API 403 dla Uploads API
Status: Sprzedawca musi ponownie autoryzować aplikację dla nowych uprawnień (Image Uploading, Image Management)

Podsumowanie projektu:
Struktura plików (apps-script/):
Plik	Opis	Linie
APlusModuleBuilder.gs	Builder wszystkich modułów A+ (STANDARD + PREMIUM)	~1200
SPApiDirect.gs	Bezpośrednie wywołania SP-API	~800
FormImport.gs	Import JSON z Google Forms → APlusBasic/Premium	~650
APlusContentSync.gs	Synchronizacja uploadDestinationId z istniejących A+	~350
APlusContentHelpers.gs	Funkcje pomocnicze (status, upload)	~300
ClientManager.gs	Zarządzanie wieloma kontami sprzedawców	~350
SpreadsheetGenerator.gs	Generator arkusza z kolumnami A+	~1000
LukoAmazonManager.gs	Główne menu i konfiguracja	~2350
Kluczowe funkcjonalności:
9 marketplace'ów: DE, FR, IT, ES, UK, NL, BE, PL, SE
8 języków: DE, EN, FR, IT, ES, NL, PL, SE
7+ typów modułów A+: STANDARD_TEXT, STANDARD_HEADER_IMAGE_TEXT, STANDARD_FOUR_IMAGE_TEXT, STANDARD_SINGLE_IMAGE_HIGHLIGHTS, itd.
Placeholder mode: Eksport z placeholder images z Image Library
Auto-lookup obrazów: Z Image Library lub Asset Library

Muszę naprawić logikę wykrywania języka. W SPApiDirect.gs znajdź buildAPlusContentDocument i zmień na:

function buildAPlusContentDocument(aplusData, marketplace) {
  // Detect the language with most content (not just first key)
  const moduleContentKeys = Object.keys(aplusData.moduleContent || {});
  let bestLang = moduleContentKeys[0] || 'DE';
  let maxFields = 0;
  
  for (const lang of moduleContentKeys) {
    const fieldCount = Object.keys(aplusData.moduleContent[lang] || {}).length;
    if (fieldCount > maxFields) {
      maxFields = fieldCount;
      bestLang = lang;
    }
  }
  
  const firstLang = bestLang;
  const content = aplusData.moduleContent[firstLang] || {};

  Logger.log(`🔍 Language detection: Found languages=${moduleContentKeys.join(',')} → Best="${firstLang}" (${maxFields} fields)`);

  // Generate unique content reference key
  const contentRefKey = `${aplusData.asin}_module${aplusData.moduleNumber}_${Date.now()}`;

  // Detect if this is a Premium module
  const isPremium = aplusData.moduleType && aplusData.moduleType.startsWith('PREMIUM');
  const contentSubType = isPremium ? 'PREMIUM' : 'STANDARD';

  // Use content language for locale detection
  const detectedLocale = convertLanguageToLocale(firstLang, marketplace) || convertMarketplaceToLocale(marketplace);
  Logger.log(`📍 Locale: "${firstLang}" → "${detectedLocale}"`);

  const contentDocument = {
    name: contentRefKey,
    contentType: 'EBC',
    contentSubType: contentSubType,
    locale: detectedLocale,
    contentModuleList: []
  };

/**
 * NetAnaliza SP-API Direct
 * Direct SP-API calls without Cloud Functions
 *
 * @version 3.0.0
 * @author NetAnaliza
 */

// ========================================
// PRODUCT SYNC TO AMAZON
// ========================================

/**
 * Sync product to Amazon SP-API directly
 * Replaces callCloudFunction for product updates
 */
function syncProductToAmazonDirect(productData, marketplace, marketplaceConfig) {
  try {
    const client = getActiveClient();

    // Display which client we're using
    showProgress(`[${client.clientName}] Syncing product ${productData.asin || productData.sku} to Amazon ${marketplace}...`);

    // Get access token
    const accessToken = getActiveAccessToken();

    // Prepare feed for product update
    const feedType = 'JSON_LISTINGS_FEED';
    const feedPayload = prepareFeedPayload(productData, marketplace, marketplaceConfig);

    // Submit feed to Amazon
    const feedResult = submitFeed(feedType, feedPayload, marketplaceConfig, accessToken);

    return {
      asin: productData.asin,
      sku: productData.sku,
      marketplace: marketplace,
      clientName: client.clientName,
      sellerId: client.sellerId,
      status: 'SUCCESS',
      message: `Feed submitted: ${feedResult.feedId}`,
      feedId: feedResult.feedId,
      timestamp: new Date()
    };

  } catch (error) {
    const client = getActiveClient();
    return {
      asin: productData.asin,
      sku: productData.sku,
      marketplace: marketplace,
      clientName: client.clientName,
      sellerId: client.sellerId,
      status: 'ERROR',
      message: error.toString(),
      timestamp: new Date()
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Get active access token (refresh if needed)
 */
function getActiveAccessToken() {
  const client = getActiveClient();

  const config = {
    clientId: client.lwaClientId,
    clientSecret: client.lwaClientSecret,
    redirectUri: 'https://ads.netanaliza.com/amazon-callback'
  };

  const tokens = getAccessTokenFromRefresh(client.refreshToken, config);

  return tokens.access_token;
}

/**
 * Prepare feed payload for Listings API
 */
function prepareFeedPayload(productData, marketplace, marketplaceConfig) {
  const payload = {
    header: {
      sellerId: getActiveClient().sellerId,
      version: '2.0',
      issueLocale: 'en_US'
    },
    messages: [
      {
        messageId: 1,
        sku: productData.sku,
        operationType: productData.action || 'UPDATE',
        productType: productData.productType || 'PRODUCT',
        requirements: 'LISTING',
        attributes: {}
      }
    ]
  };

  const message = payload.messages[0];
  const attrs = message.attributes;

  // Add ASIN if provided
  if (productData.asin) {
    attrs.externally_assigned_product_identifier = [{
      marketplace_id: marketplaceConfig.marketplaceId,
      value: productData.asin,
      type: 'ASIN'
    }];
  }

  // Add multi-language content
  if (productData.content) {
    for (const langCode in productData.content) {
      const langData = productData.content[langCode];

      // Convert marketplace lang code to locale (e.g., DE -> de_DE)
      const locale = convertToLocale(langCode, marketplace);

      if (!locale) continue;

      // Title
      if (langData.title) {
        if (!attrs.item_name) attrs.item_name = [];
        attrs.item_name.push({
          language_tag: locale,
          value: langData.title
        });
      }

      // Brand
      if (langData.brand) {
        if (!attrs.brand) attrs.brand = [];
        attrs.brand.push({
          language_tag: locale,
          value: langData.brand
        });
      }

      // Manufacturer
      if (langData.manufacturer) {
        if (!attrs.manufacturer) attrs.manufacturer = [];
        attrs.manufacturer.push({
          language_tag: locale,
          value: langData.manufacturer
        });
      }

      // Bullet points
      if (langData.bulletPoints && langData.bulletPoints.length > 0) {
        if (!attrs.bullet_point) attrs.bullet_point = [];

        for (const bullet of langData.bulletPoints) {
          if (bullet && bullet.trim()) {
            attrs.bullet_point.push({
              language_tag: locale,
              value: bullet
            });
          }
        }
      }

      // Description
      if (langData.description) {
        if (!attrs.product_description) attrs.product_description = [];
        attrs.product_description.push({
          language_tag: locale,
          value: langData.description
        });
      }

      // Generic keywords
      if (langData.keywords) {
        if (!attrs.generic_keyword) attrs.generic_keyword = [];
        attrs.generic_keyword.push({
          language_tag: locale,
          value: langData.keywords
        });
      }

      // Platinum keywords (1-5)
      for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
        const pkField = `platinumKeywords${i}`;
        if (langData[pkField]) {
          const attrName = `platinum_keywords${i}`;
          if (!attrs[attrName]) attrs[attrName] = [];
          attrs[attrName].push({
            language_tag: locale,
            value: langData[pkField]
          });
        }
      }

      // Target audience keywords
      if (langData.targetAudienceKeywords) {
        if (!attrs.target_audience_keywords) attrs.target_audience_keywords = [];
        attrs.target_audience_keywords.push({
          language_tag: locale,
          value: langData.targetAudienceKeywords
        });
      }

      // Legal disclaimer
      if (langData.legalDisclaimer) {
        if (!attrs.legal_disclaimer) attrs.legal_disclaimer = [];
        attrs.legal_disclaimer.push({
          language_tag: locale,
          value: langData.legalDisclaimer
        });
      }

      // Safety warning
      if (langData.safetyWarning) {
        if (!attrs.safety_warning) attrs.safety_warning = [];
        attrs.safety_warning.push({
          language_tag: locale,
          value: langData.safetyWarning
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // Add images
  if (productData.images) {
    if (productData.images.main) {
      attrs.main_product_image_locator = [{
        media_location: productData.images.main
      }];
    }

    if (productData.images.additional && productData.images.additional.length > 0) {
      attrs.other_product_image_locator_1 = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < productData.images.additional.length && i < 8; i++) {
        if (productData.images.additional[i]) {
          attrs.other_product_image_locator_1.push({
            media_location: productData.images.additional[i]
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Add non-language-specific fields
  if (productData.modelNumber) {
    attrs.model_number = [{ value: productData.modelNumber }];
  }

  if (productData.releaseDate) {
    attrs.release_date = [{ value: productData.releaseDate }];
  }

  if (productData.packageQuantity) {
    attrs.number_of_items = [{ value: parseInt(productData.packageQuantity) }];
  }

  // Add dimensions
  if (productData.dimensions) {
    const dims = productData.dimensions;

    if (dims.itemLength) {
      attrs.item_length = [{ value: parseFloat(dims.itemLength), unit: 'centimeters' }];
    }
    if (dims.itemWidth) {
      attrs.item_width = [{ value: parseFloat(dims.itemWidth), unit: 'centimeters' }];
    }
    if (dims.itemHeight) {
      attrs.item_height = [{ value: parseFloat(dims.itemHeight), unit: 'centimeters' }];
    }
    if (dims.itemWeight) {
      attrs.item_weight = [{ value: parseFloat(dims.itemWeight), unit: 'kilograms' }];
    }
    if (dims.packageLength) {
      attrs.package_length = [{ value: parseFloat(dims.packageLength), unit: 'centimeters' }];
    }
    if (dims.packageWidth) {
      attrs.package_width = [{ value: parseFloat(dims.packageWidth), unit: 'centimeters' }];
    }
    if (dims.packageHeight) {
      attrs.package_height = [{ value: parseFloat(dims.packageHeight), unit: 'centimeters' }];
    }
    if (dims.packageWeight) {
      attrs.package_weight = [{ value: parseFloat(dims.packageWeight), unit: 'kilograms' }];
    }
  }

  // Add compliance
  if (productData.compliance) {
    const comp = productData.compliance;

    if (comp.countryOfOrigin) {
      attrs.country_of_origin = [{ value: comp.countryOfOrigin }];
    }

    if (comp.batteriesRequired !== undefined) {
      attrs.are_batteries_included = [{ value: comp.batteriesRequired }];
    }

    if (comp.isLithiumBattery !== undefined) {
      attrs.lithium_battery_packaging = [{ value: comp.isLithiumBattery ? 'batteries_contained_in_equipment' : 'batteries_only' }];
    }
  }

  return payload;
}

/**
 * Submit feed to SP-API
 */
function submitFeed(feedType, feedPayload, marketplaceConfig, accessToken) {
  // Step 1: Create feed document
  const createDocResponse = createFeedDocument(feedPayload, accessToken);
  const feedDocumentId = createDocResponse.feedDocumentId;
  const uploadUrl = createDocResponse.url;

  // Step 2: Upload feed content to S3
  uploadFeedContent(uploadUrl, feedPayload);

  // Step 3: Create feed
  const feedResult = createFeed(feedType, [marketplaceConfig.marketplaceId], feedDocumentId, accessToken);

  Logger.log(`Feed created: ${feedResult.feedId}`);

  return feedResult;
}

/**
 * Create feed document
 */
function createFeedDocument(feedPayload, accessToken) {
  const client = getActiveClient();
  const marketplaceConfig = MARKETPLACE_LANGUAGES[client.marketplace];
  const endpoint = marketplaceConfig.endpoint;

  const url = `${endpoint}/feeds/2021-06-30/documents`;

  const payload = {
    contentType: 'application/json; charset=UTF-8'
  };

  const options = {
    method: 'post',
    headers: {
      'x-amz-access-token': accessToken,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    payload: JSON.stringify(payload),
    muteHttpExceptions: true
  };

  const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, options);
  const responseCode = response.getResponseCode();

  if (responseCode !== 201) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to create feed document: ${response.getContentText()}`);
  }

  return JSON.parse(response.getContentText());
}

/**
 * Upload feed content to S3
 */
function uploadFeedContent(uploadUrl, feedPayload) {
  const options = {
    method: 'put',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=UTF-8'
    },
    payload: JSON.stringify(feedPayload),
    muteHttpExceptions: true
  };

  const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(uploadUrl, options);
  const responseCode = response.getResponseCode();

  if (responseCode !== 200) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to upload feed content: ${response.getContentText()}`);
  }

  Logger.log('Feed content uploaded successfully');
}

/**
 * Create feed
 */
function createFeed(feedType, marketplaceIds, feedDocumentId, accessToken) {
  const client = getActiveClient();
  const marketplaceConfig = MARKETPLACE_LANGUAGES[client.marketplace];
  const endpoint = marketplaceConfig.endpoint;

  const url = `${endpoint}/feeds/2021-06-30/feeds`;

  const payload = {
    feedType: feedType,
    marketplaceIds: marketplaceIds,
    inputFeedDocumentId: feedDocumentId
  };

  const options = {
    method: 'post',
    headers: {
      'x-amz-access-token': accessToken,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    payload: JSON.stringify(payload),
    muteHttpExceptions: true
  };

  const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, options);
  const responseCode = response.getResponseCode();

  if (responseCode !== 202) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to create feed: ${response.getContentText()}`);
  }

  return JSON.parse(response.getContentText());
}

    },
    'IT': {

    'ES': {
      'es-ES': 'es_ES',
      'en-GB': 'en_GB',
      'ca-ES': 'ca_ES',
      'eu-ES': 'eu_ES'
    },
    'UK': {

      'de-DE': 'de_DE',

      'it-IT': 'it_IT',
      'pl-PL': 'pl_PL'

    'NL': {

/**
 * Publish A+ Content module to Amazon
 */
function publishAPlusContentDirect(aplusData, marketplace, marketplaceConfig) {
  try {
    const client = getActiveClient();
    const accessToken = getActiveAccessToken();

    showProgress(`[${client.clientName}] Publishing A+ Content for ${aplusData.asin}...`);

    // Build A+ Content payload based on module type
    const contentDocument = buildAPlusContentDocument(aplusData, marketplace);

    // Create or update content document
    const contentReferenceKey = `${aplusData.asin}_module${aplusData.moduleNumber}_${Date.now()}`;

    const result = createAPlusContent(contentDocument, contentReferenceKey, marketplaceConfig, accessToken);

    return {
      asin: aplusData.asin,
      moduleNumber: aplusData.moduleNumber,
      contentReferenceKey: contentReferenceKey,
      status: 'SUCCESS',
      message: `A+ Content submitted successfully`,
      timestamp: new Date()
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      asin: aplusData.asin,
      moduleNumber: aplusData.moduleNumber,
      status: 'ERROR',
      message: error.toString(),
      timestamp: new Date()
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Build A+ Content document from module data
 */
function buildAPlusContentDocument(aplusData, marketplace) {
  // Detect the language with MOST content (not just first alphabetical key!)
  const moduleContentKeys = Object.keys(aplusData.moduleContent || {});
  let bestLang = moduleContentKeys[0] || 'DE';
  let maxFields = 0;

  for (const lang of moduleContentKeys) {
    const langData = aplusData.moduleContent[lang] || {};
    // Count non-empty fields
    let fieldCount = 0;
    for (const key in langData) {
      if (langData[key] && langData[key].toString().trim() !== '') {
        fieldCount++;
      }
    }
    Logger.log(`🔍 Language "${lang}" has ${fieldCount} non-empty fields`);
    if (fieldCount > maxFields) {
      maxFields = fieldCount;
      bestLang = lang;
    }
  }

  const firstLang = bestLang;
  const content = aplusData.moduleContent[firstLang] || {};

  Logger.log(`✅ Best language detected: "${firstLang}" with ${maxFields} fields (from: ${moduleContentKeys.join(', ')})`);

  // Generate unique content reference key
  const contentRefKey = `${aplusData.asin}_module${aplusData.moduleNumber}_${Date.now()}`;

  // Detect if this is a Premium module
  const isPremium = aplusData.moduleType && aplusData.moduleType.startsWith('PREMIUM');
  const contentSubType = isPremium ? 'PREMIUM' : 'STANDARD';

  // Use content language for locale detection, fallback to marketplace if not detected
  const detectedLocale = convertLanguageToLocale(firstLang, marketplace) || convertMarketplaceToLocale(marketplace);
  Logger.log(`📍 Locale: "${firstLang}" → "${detectedLocale}" (marketplace=${marketplace})`);

  const contentDocument = {
    name: contentRefKey,
    contentType: 'EBC',  // Enhanced Brand Content
    contentSubType: contentSubType,
    locale: detectedLocale,
    contentModuleList: []
  };

  // Build module based on type
  const module = {
    contentModuleType: aplusData.moduleType
  };

  // STANDARD_TEXT module - Simple text block
  if (aplusData.moduleType === 'STANDARD_TEXT') {
    module.standardText = {};

    // headline is TextComponent - NO textList wrapper, direct {value, decoratorSet}
    if (content.headline) {
      module.standardText.headline = {
        value: content.headline,
        decoratorSet: []
      };
    }

    // body is ParagraphComponent - REQUIRES textList wrapper
    if (content.body) {
      module.standardText.body = {
        textList: [
          {
            value: content.body,
            decoratorSet: []
          }
        ]
      };
    }
  }

  // STANDARD_SINGLE_SIDE_IMAGE module - Text with optional side image
  else if (aplusData.moduleType === 'STANDARD_SINGLE_SIDE_IMAGE') {
    module.standardSingleSideImage = {
      imagePositionType: aplusData.images.imagePositionType || 'RIGHT',
      block: {}
    };

    // Add image to block if uploadDestinationId is provided
    if (aplusData.images.image_id) {
      module.standardSingleSideImage.block.image = {
        uploadDestinationId: aplusData.images.image_id,
        imageCropSpecification: {
          size: {
            width: {
              value: 300,
              units: 'pixels'
            },
            height: {
              value: 300,
              units: 'pixels'
            }
          },
          offset: {
            x: {
              value: 0,
              units: 'pixels'
            },
            y: {
              value: 0,
              units: 'pixels'
            }
          }
        },
        altText: aplusData.images.image_altText || content.headline || 'Product image'
      };
    }

    // headline is TextComponent - NO textList
    if (content.headline) {
      module.standardSingleSideImage.block.headline = {
        value: content.headline,
        decoratorSet: []
      };
    }

    // body is ParagraphComponent - REQUIRES textList
    if (content.body) {
      module.standardSingleSideImage.block.body = {
        textList: [
          {
            value: content.body,
            decoratorSet: []
          }
        ]
      };
    }
  }

  // STANDARD_HEADER_IMAGE_TEXT module - Header with image and text
  else if (aplusData.moduleType === 'STANDARD_HEADER_IMAGE_TEXT') {
    module.standardHeaderImageText = {
      block: {}
    };

    // headline is TextComponent - NO textList (note: it's 'headline' not 'heading')
    if (content.headline) {
      module.standardHeaderImageText.headline = {
        value: content.headline,
        decoratorSet: []
      };
    }

    // Add image to block if uploadDestinationId is provided
    if (aplusData.images.image_id) {
      module.standardHeaderImageText.block.image = {
        uploadDestinationId: aplusData.images.image_id,
        imageCropSpecification: {
          size: {
            width: {
              value: 970,
              units: 'pixels'
            },
            height: {
              value: 300,
              units: 'pixels'
            }
          },
          offset: {
            x: {
              value: 0,
              units: 'pixels'
            },
            y: {
              value: 0,
              units: 'pixels'
            }
          }
        },
        altText: aplusData.images.image_altText || content.headline || 'Product image'
      };
    }

    // body is ParagraphComponent - REQUIRES textList
    if (content.body) {
      module.standardHeaderImageText.block.body = {
        textList: [
          {
            value: content.body,
            decoratorSet: []
          }
        ]
      };
    }

    // Or add multiple paragraphs from highlights
    if (!content.body && content.highlight1) {
      const bodyTextList = [];
      for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
        const paragraphText = content[`highlight${i}`];
        if (paragraphText) {
          bodyTextList.push({
            value: paragraphText,
            decoratorSet: []
          });
        }
      }
      if (bodyTextList.length > 0) {
        module.standardHeaderImageText.block.body = {
          textList: bodyTextList
        };
      }
    }
  }

  contentDocument.contentModuleList.push(module);

  return contentDocument;
}

/**
 * Create A+ Content document via SP-API
 */
function createAPlusContent(contentDocument, contentReferenceKey, marketplaceConfig, accessToken) {
  const endpoint = marketplaceConfig.endpoint;
  // Add marketplaceId as query parameter
  const url = `${endpoint}/aplus/2020-11-01/contentDocuments?marketplaceId=${marketplaceConfig.marketplaceId}`;

  // Payload should only contain contentDocument
  const payload = {
    contentDocument: contentDocument
  };

  // Debug: Log the payload being sent
  Logger.log(`A+ Content URL: ${url}`);
  Logger.log(`A+ Content Payload: ${JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)}`);

  const options = {
    method: 'post',
    headers: {
      'x-amz-access-token': accessToken,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    payload: JSON.stringify(payload),
    muteHttpExceptions: true
  };

  Logger.log(`Creating A+ Content: ${contentReferenceKey}`);

  const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, options);
  const responseCode = response.getResponseCode();
  const responseBody = response.getContentText();

  Logger.log(`A+ API Response Code: ${responseCode}`);
  Logger.log(`A+ API Response: ${responseBody}`);

  if (responseCode < 200 || responseCode >= 300) {
    let errorMessage = `SP-API Error ${responseCode}`;
    try {
      const error = JSON.parse(responseBody);
      errorMessage = error.errors?.[0]?.message || error.message || responseBody;
    } catch (e) {
      errorMessage = responseBody;
    }
    throw new Error(errorMessage);
  }

  return JSON.parse(responseBody);
}

/**
 * Convert marketplace code to locale
 */
function convertMarketplaceToLocale(marketplace) {
  const localeMap = {
    'DE': 'de-DE',
    'FR': 'fr-FR',
    'IT': 'it-IT',
    'ES': 'es-ES',
    'UK': 'en-GB',
    'NL': 'nl-NL',
    'PL': 'pl-PL',
    'SE': 'sv-SE'
  };
  return localeMap[marketplace] || 'en-GB';
}

/**
 * Convert language code to locale for specific marketplace
 */
function convertLanguageToLocale(lang, marketplace) {
  const localeMap = {
    'DE': 'de-DE',
    'EN': 'en-GB',
    'FR': 'fr-FR',
    'IT': 'it-IT',
    'ES': 'es-ES',
    'NL': 'nl-NL',
    'PL': 'pl-PL',
    'SE': 'sv-SE'
  };
  return localeMap[lang] || null;
}

/**
 * Call SP-API with proper authentication (enhanced version)
 */
function callSPAPIDirect(method, path, params, accessToken, body) {
  const client = getActiveClient();
  const marketplaceConfig = MARKETPLACE_LANGUAGES[client.marketplace];
  const endpoint = marketplaceConfig.endpoint;

  let url = endpoint + path;

  // Add query parameters
  if (params && Object.keys(params).length > 0) {
    const queryString = Object.keys(params)
      .map(key => `${encodeURIComponent(key)}=${encodeURIComponent(params[key])}`)
      .join('&');
    url += '?' + queryString;
  }

  const options = {
    method: method.toLowerCase(),
    headers: {
      'x-amz-access-token': accessToken,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    muteHttpExceptions: true
  };

  if (body) {
    options.payload = JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  Logger.log(`[${client.clientName}] Calling SP-API: ${method} ${url}`);

  const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, options);
  const responseCode = response.getResponseCode();
  const responseBody = response.getContentText();

  if (responseCode < 200 || responseCode >= 300) {
    let errorMessage = `SP-API Error ${responseCode}`;
    try {
      const error = JSON.parse(responseBody);
      errorMessage = error.errors?.[0]?.message || error.message || errorMessage;
    } catch (e) {
      errorMessage = responseBody;
    }
    throw new Error(errorMessage);
  }

  return JSON.parse(responseBody);
}

function publishMultiModuleAPlusContent(modules, contentType, exportMode) {
  try {
    const client = getActiveClient();
    const marketplace = client.marketplace || 'DE';
    const marketplaceConfig = getMarketplaceConfig(marketplace);
 
    if (!marketplaceConfig) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid marketplace: ${marketplace}`);
    }
 
    if (!modules || modules.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('No modules provided');
    }

function extractAPlusData(sheet, rowNumber, contentType) {
  const range = sheet.getRange(rowNumber, 1, 1, sheet.getLastColumn());
  const values = range.getValues()[0];
  // Headers are in row 3, not row 1
  const headers = sheet.getRange(3, 1, 1, sheet.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0];
 
  // Debug: Log first few values
  Logger.log(`Row ${rowNumber}: ${values.slice(0, 5).join(' | ')}`);
  Logger.log(`Headers (row 3): ${headers.slice(0, 5).join(' | ')}`);
 
  const asin = getColumnValue(values, headers, 'ASIN');
  const moduleNumber = getColumnValue(values, headers, 'Module Number');
  const moduleType = getColumnValue(values, headers, 'Module Type');
  const marketplace = getColumnValue(values, headers, 'Marketplace') || 'DE';
  const language = getColumnValue(values, headers, 'Language') || 'DE';
 
  Logger.log(`Extracted - ASIN: "${asin}", Module: "${moduleNumber}", Type: "${moduleType}", Marketplace: "${marketplace}", Language: "${language}"`);
 
  if (!asin || asin === '') {
    throw new Error(`ASIN is empty in row ${rowNumber}. Please fill in the ASIN column.`);

 * A+ Content Module Builder - Complete Implementation
 * Handles all A+ Basic and Premium module types
 *
 * TEXT FORMATTING SUPPORT (v2):

 *   - STYLE_BOLD      → Use **text** or __text__
 *   - STYLE_ITALIC    → Use *text* or _text_
 *   - STYLE_UNDERLINE → Use ~~text~~ (strikethrough renders as underline)

 *   - LIST_ORDERED    → Use 1. item or 1) item at start of line

 *   "This is **bold** and *italic* text with a list:\n- Item one\n- Item two"

Input	Output
**bold text** or __bold__	STYLE_BOLD
*italic text* or _italic_	STYLE_ITALIC
~~underline~~	STYLE_UNDERLINE
- item or • item (start of line)	LIST_ITEM (bullet)

1. Deploy w Apps Script

2. Wygeneruj nową strukturę kolumn
W arkuszu Google Sheets:

Menu → LUKO Amazon → Tools → Generate LUKO-ACM Spreadsheet

UWAGA: To usunie stare kolumny i stworzy nowe (m1_headline, m1_body, itd.)

Jeśli masz dane w arkuszu które chcesz zachować - zrób backup najpierw!

3. Aktualizuj prompt dla Claude (do generowania JSON)
Nowy format kolumn:

{
  "modules": [
    {
      "columns": {
        "☑️ Export": true,
        "ASIN": "B0XXXXXXXX",
        "Module Number": 1,
        "Module Type": "STANDARD_TEXT",
        "m1_headline": "Nagłówek z **pogrubieniem**",
        "m1_body": "Tekst z *kursywą* i listą:\n- punkt 1\n- punkt 2"
      }
    }
  ]
}

function getAPlusPremiumHeaders() {
  const control = ['☑️ Export', 'ASIN', 'Brand Story ID'];
  const languages = ['DE', 'EN', 'FR', 'IT', 'ES', 'NL', 'PL', 'SE'];
 
  const hero = [
    'aplus_premium_hero_brandLogo_URL',
    'aplus_premium_hero_heroImage_URL',
    'aplus_premium_hero_heroVideo_URL',
    ...languages.map(lang => `aplus_premium_hero_tagline_${lang}`),
    'aplus_premium_hero_backgroundColor_HEX'
  ];
 
  const status = ['Status', 'ExportDateTime', 'ErrorMessage'];
 
  return [...control, ...hero, ...status];

    '☑️ Export',
    'ASIN',
    'Module Number',

Toast "Working..." nie jest z naszego kodu.

Sprawdziłem - w kodzie nie ma tekstu "Working". Nasz toast mówi "Processing...".

To pochodzi od:

Gemini (widzę w menu) - wyłącz dodatek Gemini

Rozwiązanie:
Wyłącz Gemini:

Rozszerzenia → Dodatki → Zarządzaj dodatkami
Znajdź Gemini → wyłącz
Lub odśwież stronę (F5) - toast powinien zniknąć

Co do wizualizacji - tak, da się to zrobić! Mam kilka pomysłów:

Opcja 1: HTML Preview Generator (najprostsza)
Jak działałoby:

Menu → "Generate A+ Preview"
Tworzy plik HTML w Google Drive wyglądający jak Amazon A+ Preview
Link do pliku wpisuje do komórki w arkuszu
Można otworzyć w przeglądarce, wydrukować do PDF, zrobić screenshot
Zalety: 100% w Google Apps Script, bez zewnętrznych serwisów

Opcja 2: Mockup na żywej stronie produktu (zaawansowana)
Jak działałoby:

Serwis (np. Cloud Function) pobiera stronę produktu z Amazon
Wstrzykuje Twój A+ Content HTML w miejsce rzeczywistego A+
Generuje screenshot (Puppeteer)
Zapisuje do Drive, link w komórce
Zalety: Klient widzi dokładnie jak będzie wyglądać na ich produkcie
Wady: Wymaga zewnętrznego serwera (Cloud Run/Function)

Opcja 3: Google Slides/Docs (alternatywa)
Jak działałoby:

Generuje Google Slides z modułami A+
Eksport do PDF automatycznie
Link w komórce
Moja rekomendacja:
Zacznijmy od Opcji 1 (HTML Preview) - mogę to zrobić teraz.
Potem możemy dodać Opcję 2 jako upgrade.

                                               <h3 class="a-spacing-mini"> 80% Merinowolle - Der Unterschied, den Sie spüren </h3>                                      <p> Merinowolle ist nicht gleich Merinowolle. Lanolin in der Wolle wirkt natürlich antibakteriell - weniger Geruch, auch nach langem Tragen. 18% Baumwolle und 2% Elastan sorgen für Formstabilität und perfekten Sitz. Waschen Sie die Socken bei 40 Grad ohne Weichspüler. </p>    </div>

</style> <script type="application/javascript">
/**
 * Common event handler for click and keydown events.
 * @param {Event} event - The event object.
 * @param {Function} handleClickOrEnter - Function to handle click or Enter key events.
 * @param {Function} handleEsc - Function to handle Esc key events.
 */
// [TODO][AplusMantle-8064] Create common event handler util(key events, click events) in AplusModuleResources
function handleClickAndKeyEvents(event, handleClickOrEnterOrSpace) {
    const ENTER_KEY_CODE = 13;
    const ESCAPE_KEY_CODE = 27;
    const SPACE_KEY_CODE = 32;
    const isClick = event.type === 'click';
    const isKeydown = event.type === 'keydown';
    const isEnter = isKeydown && event.keyCode === ENTER_KEY_CODE;
    const isSpace = isKeydown && event.keyCode === SPACE_KEY_CODE;
    const isEsc = isKeydown && event.keyCode === ESCAPE_KEY_CODE;

    if (isClick || isEnter || isSpace) {
        handleClickOrEnterOrSpace();
    } else if (isEsc) {
        handleEsc(event);
    }
}

/**
* Function to handle esc key event.
* @param {Event} event - The event object.
*/
function handleEsc(event) {
    event.target.blur()  // force remove focus
}

                <li id="faq-qa-pair-0" class="faq-block">
                        <h3>
                            <span data-faq-question="" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-controls="faq-0" aria-expanded="false">
                                                                  <p class="aplus-question aplus-p1"> Wie viele Sockenpaare enthält eine Packung? </p>    <span class="faq-arrow" aria-label="Klicke hier, um den Frage- und Antwort-Block zu öffnen oder zu schließen"></span>
                            </span>  
                        </h3>
                                                          <p class="aplus-answer aplus-p2"> Jede Packung enthält normalerweise ein Paar Socken. Du findest diese Informationen in der Produktbeschreibung des jeweiligen Artikels. </p>    </li>
                     <li id="faq-qa-pair-1" class="faq-block">
                        <h3>
                            <span data-faq-question="" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-controls="faq-1" aria-expanded="false">
                                                                  <p class="aplus-question aplus-p1"> In welchen Größen werden hohe Socken verkauft? </p>    <span class="faq-arrow" aria-label="Klicke hier, um den Frage- und Antwort-Block zu öffnen oder zu schließen"></span>
                            </span>  
                        </h3>
                                                          <p class="aplus-answer aplus-p2"> Unsere hohen Socken sind in drei Größen erhältlich, nämlich 35–38, 39–42 und 43–46. Die Produktmaße sind in der Größentabelle angegeben. </p>    </li>
                     <li id="faq-qa-pair-2" class="faq-block">
                        <h3>
                            <span data-faq-question="" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-controls="faq-2" aria-expanded="false">
                                                                  <p class="aplus-question aplus-p1"> Warum ist jede Socke eines Paares unterschiedlich? </p>    <span class="faq-arrow" aria-label="Klicke hier, um den Frage- und Antwort-Block zu öffnen oder zu schließen"></span>
                            </span>  
                        </h3>
                                                          <p class="aplus-answer aplus-p2"> Unsere Socken sollen dir den Tag verschönern. Deshalb ist jede Socke unterschiedlich, aber zusammen passen sie perfekt zusammen. Mit unterschiedlichen Socken können unsere Kunden ihr wahres Ich zum Ausdruck bringen und sich von anderen abheben. </p>    </li>

function extractModuleDataForPreview(values, headers) {
  // Get module number - ensure it's a number

  if (typeof moduleNumber === 'string') {
    moduleNumber = parseInt(moduleNumber, 10);
  }
  if (!moduleNumber || isNaN(moduleNumber)) {
    moduleNumber = 1;
  }

    moduleNumber: moduleNumber,

    marketplace: getColumnValue(values, headers, 'Marketplace') || 'DE',
    language: getColumnValue(values, headers, 'Language') || 'DE'
  };

 * Uses productImages from ImportedProducts as fallback
 */
function generateMultipleImageTextModule(data, headline, body, moduleImages, productImages, startIndex) {
  productImages = productImages || [];
  startIndex = startIndex || 0;
 
  // Collect images from module data first
  let images = moduleImages.filter(img => img.url && img.url.startsWith('http')).slice(0, 6);
 
  // If not enough images from module, fill with product images

/**
 * Generic module for unknown types - shows all available content
 */
function generateGenericModule(data, headline, body, imageUrl, imageAlt, allImages, allTextContent) {
  const otherImages = allImages.filter(img => img.url !== imageUrl).slice(0, 4);
  const otherText = allTextContent.filter(t =>
    t.value !== headline && t.value !== body &&
    !t.key.includes('altText') && !t.key.includes('position')
  );
 
  return `
    <div class="apm-genericmodule">
      <div class="apm-genericmodule-type">${escapeHtml(data.moduleType || 'Module')}</div>
 
      ${imageUrl ? `
        <div class="apm-genericmodule-mainimage">
          <img src="${escapeHtml(imageUrl)}" alt="${escapeHtml(imageAlt)}">
        </div>
      ` : ''}

Done! I've implemented the fixes for the A+ Preview Generator. Here's what was changed in APlusPreviewGenerator.gs:

Changes Made
1. Smart Content Detection (for misaligned columns)
Added detection for text content based on characteristics (length, line breaks)
Shorter text (< 150 chars, no newlines) → likely headline
Longer text (> 100 chars) → likely body
Falls back to using subheadline as headline and backgroundImage_altText as body when proper fields are empty
2. ImportedProducts Image Lookup
New function getImagesFromImportedProducts(asin):

Looks up the ASIN in ImportedProducts sheet
Returns array: [mainImage, additionalImage1, additionalImage2, ...]
Up to 6 images from Main Image URL + Additional Image 1-5 columns
3. Module Generators Updated
All multi-image modules now use product images as fallback:

FOUR_IMAGE_TEXT - Uses 4 product images cycling through available
THREE_IMAGE_TEXT - Uses 3 product images cycling through available
MULTIPLE_IMAGE_TEXT - Uses up to 6 product images
COMPARISON_TABLE - Uses product images for comparison products
GENERIC - Uses first available product image
How It Works
When generating preview, fetches images from ImportedProducts by ASIN
For each module: prefers real HTTP URLs from module data
If no proper URL found, uses next product image from ImportedProducts
Images cycle (if 3 images available and module needs 4, it repeats from beginning)
Download command for the updated file:

curl -k -o APlusPreviewGenerator.gs "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LUKOAI/LUKOAmazonContentManager/claude/amazon-content-manager-continued-w6RdQ/apps-script/APlusPreviewGenerator.gs"

After deploying the new version, the preview should show actual product images from ImportedProducts and proper text content even with misaligned columns.

You are an expert Amazon A+ Content Strategist integrated with NetAnaliza Content Manager system. You create high-converting product descriptions that increase sales by 8-25% while ensuring seamless integration with Google Sheets workflow and Amazon compliance.
Your role is to transform product data into compelling visual stories that address customer pain points, build emotional connections, and drive purchasing decisions through strategic content design and psychological selling principles.

Core Capabilities
1. Product Analysis & Customer Psychology
Extract and analyze all product data (ASIN, title, description, reviews, Q&A)
Identify unspoken customer questions and pain points from reviews
Create detailed customer personas based on emotional triggers
Map customer journey stages (awareness -> consideration -> purchase)
2. Multi-Language Content Generation
Supported languages: German (default), English, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, Swedish, Polish
Language selection logic:

Write content in the specified language
If not specified, use marketplace language (e.g., amazon.de -> German)
Account for text expansion rates from knowledge base (check exact rates per language)
Adapt for cultural preferences and local shopping behaviors
3. Module Strategy & Layout
Read knowledge base first to get ALL available module types (Basic AND Premium)
Select optimal modules based on product type and target audience
Do NOT force specific number of modules - choose what fits the product (3-7 typical)
Prioritize mobile optimization (90% of traffic)
Create logical content flow following customer decision journey
Arrange modules into cohesive story addressing customer pain points
4. Psychological Selling Approach
Apply P.A.S. framework (Problem -> Agitation -> Solution)
Integrate emotional triggers: FOMO, trust, belonging, instant gratification
Address unspoken customer questions proactively
Build trust through social proof and authority
Focus on customer needs, not catalog descriptions

Workflow Process
Step 1: Initial Assessment
Ask user for content type preference (Basic A+ or Premium A+)
Default to Basic A+ if no response
Check knowledge base for module options and requirements
Verify sufficient product data; request additional if needed
Step 2: Knowledge Base Review (MANDATORY)
Execute before content creation:

View knowledge base documents using view tool
Read GOOGLE_FORMS_INTEGRATION_V2.md for exact column names
Identify ALL available modules (Basic + Premium)
Note exact column structure and naming
Extract exact character limits per module type - DO NOT assume or invent limits
Review compliance rules for target marketplace
Document image dimension requirements
Step 3: Deep Customer Research
Analyze minimum 50+ customer reviews
Extract exact quotes in target language
Identify top 10 pain points with frequency counts
Map pain points to product features that solve them
Create 3 detailed customer personas
Note emotional triggers and purchase motivations
Identify unspoken questions customers have before buying
Step 4: Competitive Positioning
Identify 5-8 direct competitors by ASIN
Analyze product differentiation
Review competitor A+ content approach
Identify unique value propositions
Create differentiation strategy
Find content gaps to exploit
Step 5: Strategic Module Selection
Based on research, determine optimal modules:

Consider:

Product complexity (technical vs lifestyle)
Customer information needs from reviews
Visual storytelling requirements
Category best practices
Available content (images, specs)
Choose appropriate number of modules (typically 3-7):

Consult knowledge base for ALL available options
Include Premium modules if appropriate
Don't force arbitrary counts - let product needs drive selection
Document rationale for each module choice
Step 6: Content Creation
For EACH selected module:

Headlines: Create emotional hook + clear benefit

Check knowledge base for exact character limit per module
Apply target language text expansion
Use customer language from reviews
Body Text: Address specific pain points

Reference exact character limits from knowledge base
Solve customer problems identified in research
Use power words and emotional triggers
Keep mobile-friendly (short paragraphs)
Compliance Validation:

No pricing/promotional language
No superlatives without proof
No competitor mentions
No Amazon references
Product-focused, benefit-driven

Critical Compliance Rules (Amazon)
PROHIBITED CONTENT
Price information or symbols ($, EUR, GBP)
Time-sensitive terms (new, now, today, latest)
Promotional language (sale, discount, free shipping, buy now)
Competitor references (direct or indirect)
External links or QR codes
Contact information (email, phone, address)
Warranty or guarantee details
"Best" claims without substantiation
HTML tags or code
Watermarked images
REQUIRED ELEMENTS
Alt-text for all images
Professional grammar and spelling
Brand consistency
Mobile optimization
Accurate product information
High-quality images (check knowledge base for DPI requirements)
Proper image dimensions per module (from knowledge base)
RGB color space (not CMYK)
JSON Formatting Rules
CRITICAL: ASCII Characters Only!
NEVER use these characters in JSON:

German quotes: (U+201E), (U+201C), (U+201D)
Smart quotes: (U+2018), (U+2019)
Em dash: (U+2014)
En dash: (U+2013)
ALWAYS use these instead:

Straight double quotes: "
Regular apostrophe: '
Regular hyphen: -
Example - WRONG:
{
  "aplus_basic_m1_body_DE": "Das sagen Kunden: 'Perfekt' - sehr gut"
}

Example - CORRECT:
{
  "aplus_basic_m1_body_DE": "Das sagen Kunden: 'Perfekt' - sehr gut"
}

Amazon SP-API A+ Content Module Reference
CRITICAL: API-Supported Module Types Only
IMPORTANT: The Amazon SP-API A+ Content endpoint supports exactly 20 module types.

The Seller Central web interface may show additional module types (video, hotspots, Q&A, etc.) but these are NOT available through the API. Only use the module types listed below!

Module Count Summary
Basic A+ Modules: 15 types
Max modules per ASIN: 7
Premium A+ Modules: 5 types
Max modules per ASIN: 7
Total API-supported modules: 20

Critical Rule: Cannot Mix Basic + Premium
IMPORTANT: You CANNOT use Basic and Premium modules in the same ASIN!

ALLOWED:

ASIN 1: Module 1 (Basic) + Module 2 (Basic) + Module 3 (Basic)
ASIN 2: Module 1 (Premium) + Module 2 (Premium) + Module 3 (Premium)
FORBIDDEN:

ASIN 1: Module 1 (Basic) + Module 2 (Premium) <- WILL FAIL

Placeholder Image System
Current Placeholders Available:

300x300 (square - most common)
970x600 (header)
220x220 (multiple images)
135x135 (quadrant)
1464x600 (premium image)
1940x600 (premium background)
362x453 (carousel)
600x180 (company logo)
970x300 (overlay)
150x300 (comparison)
300x400 (specs detail)
Usage in JSON:

image_url: "" (empty string)
image_id: "amazon_a_plus_placeholder_[dimension]_[type].png"
System auto-selects placeholder based on:

Module Type
Field name (image vs image1 vs backgroundImage)
Dimension requirements

Common Mistakes to Avoid
DON'T:
Mix Premium and Basic in same ASIN
Use module types not supported by API
Use database URLs in image_url fields
Forget language variants for multi-language products
Exceed character limits
Use Basic modules for premium products
Use unsubstantiated claims
Include pricing information
Use column letters (A, B, C) instead of column names
Use PREMIUM_FULL_VIDEO, PREMIUM_VIDEO_IMAGE_CAROUSEL, etc.
DO:
Check module type compatibility with API list
Use empty strings for URL fields with placeholders
Provide real uploadDestinationIds for images
Create all language variants needed
Count characters before finalizing
Match module type to product positioning
Use factual, benefit-focused language
Focus on customer pain points
Use column names from GOOGLE_FORMS_INTEGRATION_V2.md
Only use the 20 API-supported module types
Summary
API-Supported Module Types:

15 Basic modules (STANDARD_*)
5 Premium modules (PREMIUM_TEXT, PREMIUM_IMAGE_TEXT, PREMIUM_FULL_BACKGROUND_TEXT, PREMIUM_FULL_BACKGROUND_IMAGE, PREMIUM_IMAGE_CAROUSEL)
Total: 20 modules
NOT Supported by API:

Video modules
Hotspots
Navigation carousels
Q&A modules
Comparison tables (premium)
Technical specs (premium)

Google Forms â†’ APlusBasic/APlusPremium Auto-Import Integration v2.0
Overview
Automated system that imports A+ Content data from Google Form submissions directly into the appropriate sheet:

STANDARD modules â†’ APlusBasic sheet
PREMIUM modules â†’ APlusPremium sheet
Claude can submit A+ Content modules via Google Forms, and they automatically populate your spreadsheet based on module type.

How It Works
Claude â†’ Google Form â†’ ClaudeAPlusQueue â†’ Apps Script â†’ APlusBasic OR APlusPremium

Claude submits form with JSON payload
Response recorded in ClaudeAPlusQueue sheet
Trigger fires onFormSubmit() function
JSON parsed and validated
Modules separated by type (STANDARD vs PREMIUM)
Modules written to appropriate sheet at first empty row
â˜‘ï¸ Export set to TRUE automatically for new imports
Notification shown with success/error details
Form Structure
Form URL: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1LDysIzwc5kfSBG3cAT7cDKnWlx6w-Sj9vJw2YhbrYI8/edit

Response Sheet: ClaudeAPlusQueue

Column A: Timestamp (auto-generated)
Column B: JSON payload (from Claude)
JSON Format
Basic Structure
Claude submits JSON with column names (not just letters):

Module Types Reference
CRITICAL: API-Supported Module Types Only!
The Amazon SP-API supports exactly 20 module types (15 Basic + 5 Premium).

Module types like PREMIUM_FULL_VIDEO, PREMIUM_HOTSPOTS, etc. are visible in Seller Central but NOT available through SP-API.

Basic Module Types (15) - ALL API-SUPPORTED
Module Type	API Property Name	Description	Required Images
STANDARD_TEXT	standardText	Text only	None
STANDARD_SINGLE_SIDE_IMAGE	standardSingleSideImage	Image + text side by side	1x 300x300
STANDARD_HEADER_IMAGE_TEXT	standardHeaderImageText	Header image + text below	1x 970x600
STANDARD_COMPANY_LOGO	standardCompanyLogo	Logo + description	1x 600x180
STANDARD_IMAGE_TEXT_OVERLAY	standardImageTextOverlay	Image with text overlay	1x 970x300
STANDARD_SINGLE_IMAGE_HIGHLIGHTS	standardSingleImageHighlights	Image + 4 bullet points	1x 300x300
STANDARD_MULTIPLE_IMAGE_TEXT	standardMultipleImageText	Text + up to 4 images	4x 220x220
STANDARD_FOUR_IMAGE_TEXT	standardFourImageText	4 images with text blocks	4x 220x220
STANDARD_FOUR_IMAGE_TEXT_QUADRANT	standardFourImageTextQuadrant	4 images in grid	4x 135x135
STANDARD_THREE_IMAGE_TEXT	standardThreeImageText	3 images with text blocks	3x 300x300
STANDARD_COMPARISON_TABLE	standardComparisonTable	Product comparison	6x 150x300
STANDARD_PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION	standardProductDescription	Long text description	None
STANDARD_SINGLE_IMAGE_SPECS_DETAIL	standardSingleImageSpecsDetail	Image + specs table	1x 300x400
STANDARD_IMAGE_SIDEBAR	standardImageSidebar	Text + sidebar image	1x 300x300
STANDARD_TECH_SPECS	standardTechSpecs	Technical specifications	None
Premium Module Types (5) - ALL API-SUPPORTED
Module Type	API Property Name	Description	Required Images
PREMIUM_TEXT	premiumText	Enhanced text	None
PREMIUM_IMAGE_TEXT	premiumImageText	Image + text	1x 1464x600
PREMIUM_FULL_BACKGROUND_TEXT	premiumFullBackgroundText	Background + overlay text	1x 1940x600
PREMIUM_FULL_BACKGROUND_IMAGE	premiumFullBackgroundImage	Background only	1x 1940x600
PREMIUM_IMAGE_CAROUSEL	premiumImageCarousel	Up to 8 carousel images	8x 362x453
NOT SUPPORTED BY API (Will Cause Errors!)
These module types exist in Seller Central but are NOT available through SP-API:

PREMIUM_FULL_VIDEO

JSON Formatting Rules
CRITICAL: ASCII Characters Only!
NEVER use these characters:

âŒ German quotes: â€ž (U+201E), " (U+201C), " (U+201D)
âŒ Smart quotes: ' (U+2018), ' (U+2019)
âŒ Em dash: â€” (U+2014)
âŒ En dash: â€“ (U+2013)
ALWAYS use these instead:

âœ… Straight double quotes: "
âœ… Regular apostrophe: '
âœ… Regular hyphen: -
Example - WRONG:
{
  "aplus_basic_m1_body_DE": "Das sagen Kunden: â€žPerfekt" â€“ sehr gut"
}

Example - CORRECT:
{
  "aplus_basic_m1_body_DE": "Das sagen Kunden: 'Perfekt' - sehr gut"
}

Features
âœ… Automatic Sheet Routing
Detects Module Type value
Routes STANDARD_* to APlusBasic
Routes PREMIUM_* to APlusPremium
Creates APlusPremium sheet if missing
âœ… Column Name Mapping
Uses actual column names from row 3 headers
Supports both letter codes (A, B, C) and names
Handles all columns from A to ZZ
âœ… Automatic Checkbox Setting
Sets â˜‘ï¸ Export to TRUE for new imports
Sets Status to PENDING
Ready for immediate publishing
âœ… Error Handling
Invalid JSON â†’ Clear error message
Missing sheet â†’ Auto-creates APlusPremium
Unknown columns â†’ Logged and skipped
Troubleshooting
Modules Go to Wrong Sheet
Cause: Wrong Module Type value
Solution: Ensure Module Type starts with STANDARD_ or PREMIUM_

Column Not Found Warning
Cause: Column name doesn't match sheet headers
Solution: Check exact column names in row 3 of target sheet

JSON Parse Error
Cause: Smart quotes or special characters
Solution: Use only ASCII characters, validate at jsonlint.com

â˜‘ï¸ Export Not Checked
Cause: Old script version
Solution: Update FormImport.gs - new version sets â˜‘ï¸ Export = TRUE automatically

Best Practices for Claude
Always validate JSON before submitting
Use column names instead of letters when possible
Include Module Type with correct prefix
Use ASCII characters only in text values
Test with single module before submitting multiple
Check uploadDestinationIds are correct format

# Google Forms to APlusBasic/APlusPremium Auto-Import Integration v3.0
 
## CRITICAL: Simplified Column Format (NO Language Suffixes!)
 
**Version 3.0 uses SIMPLIFIED column names WITHOUT language suffixes.**
 
The language is controlled by a separate "Language" dropdown field in the form, NOT by column name suffixes.
 
## Overview
 
```
Claude -> Google Form -> ClaudeAPlusQueue -> Apps Script -> APlusBasic OR APlusPremium
```
 
1. Claude submits form with JSON payload + Marketplace + Language dropdowns
2. Response recorded in ClaudeAPlusQueue sheet
3. Trigger fires onFormSubmit() function
4. JSON parsed and validated
5. Marketplace/Language injected into each module from form fields
6. Modules written to appropriate sheet at first empty row

1. Google Sheets + Apps Script

APlusPreviewGenerator.gs - generuje wizualny podgląd HTML A+ Content

Projekt Claude do generowania tekstów A+ Content
Wysyła JSON przez Google Forms → automatycznie trafia do arkusza

Błąd jest jasny - brakuje arkusza "Config" w NetAnalizaAmazonContentManager.

Ten arkusz zawiera dane do autoryzacji SP-API (credentials, refresh token, itp.).

Sprawdzę w kodzie czego dokładnie wymaga:

Grep
Config sheet not found|getConfig
Widzę strukturę. Arkusz Config musi zawierać:

Kolumna A: Nazwa klucza
Kolumna B: Wartość
Sprawdzam jakie klucze są wymagane:


6 Muster gesucht
Teraz szukam gdzie jest zdefiniowana funkcja getActiveClient:

Rozumiem całą strukturę. Potrzebujesz 2 arkusze do autoryzacji SP-API:

1. Arkusz "Config" (brakuje!)
A (Key)	B (Value)
clientId	amzn1.application-oa2-client.xxx
clientSecret	amzn1.oa2-cs.v1.xxx
2. Arkusz "Client Settings"
✓ Active	Client Name	Seller ID	Marketplace	Refresh Token	LWA Client ID	LWA Client Secret
✅	ULLMYS	A3xxx	DE	Atzr|xxx	amzn1.app...	amzn1.oa2-cs...
Rozwiązanie:
Najszybciej: Skopiuj arkusz "Config" z LUKO Amazon Content Manager do NetAnalizaAmazonContentManager:

Otwórz LUKO Amazon Content Manager
Kliknij prawym na zakładkę "Config" → Kopiuj do → NetAnalizaAmazonContentManager

Kompletna dokumentacja pól Amazon API dla pobierania danych produktu po ASIN
Amazon udostępnia cztery główne API do pobierania danych produktów po ASIN: SP-API Catalog Items, SP-API Product Pricing, PA-API 5.0 oraz SP-API Reports. Łącznie oferują one ponad 250 unikalnych pól danych - od podstawowych informacji katalogowych, przez szczegółowe dane cenowe i konkurencyjne, po zaawansowane metryki analityczne dostępne wyłącznie dla właścicieli marek. Poniżej przedstawiam kompletną dokumentację techniczną wszystkich dostępnych pól.

SP-API Catalog Items API v2022-04-01
Ta API stanowi główne źródło danych katalogowych produktu. Operacje getCatalogItem i searchCatalogItems zwracają dane kontrolowane parametrem includedData.

Dostępne wartości parametru includedData
Wartość	Opis	Dostępność
summaries	Podstawowe dane produktu (domyślne)	Wszyscy
attributes	Strukturalne atrybuty produktu	Tylko właściciele marek
identifiers	Identyfikatory (UPC, EAN, ISBN)	Wszyscy
images	Zdjęcia produktu	Wszyscy
productTypes	Klasyfikacja typu produktu	Wszyscy
classifications	Klasyfikacje browse node	Wszyscy
salesRanks	Rankingi sprzedaży	Wszyscy
relationships	Relacje parent-child (warianty)	Wszyscy
dimensions	Wymiary fizyczne produktu i opakowania	Wszyscy
vendorDetails	Dane vendorów	Tylko vendorzy
Pola podstawowe (root response)
Ścieżka JSON	Typ	Wymagane	Opis	Przykład
asin	string	Tak	Amazon Standard Identification Number	"B00U26V4VQ"
Summaries - podstawowe informacje o produkcie
Ścieżka JSON	Typ	Wymagane	Opis	Przykład
summaries[].marketplaceId	string	Tak	Identyfikator marketplace	"A1PA6795UKMFR9" (Amazon.de)
summaries[].itemName	string	Nie	Tytuł produktu	"Samsung QLED TV 55 Zoll"
summaries[].brand	string	Nie	Nazwa marki	"Samsung"
summaries[].manufacturer	string	Nie	Nazwa producenta	"Samsung Electronics"
summaries[].modelNumber	string	Nie	Numer modelu	"QN55Q60AAFXZA"
summaries[].partNumber	string	Nie	Numer części	"QN55Q60AAFXZA"
summaries[].color	string	Nie	Kolor	"Schwarz"
summaries[].size	string	Nie	Rozmiar	"55 Zoll"
summaries[].style	string	Nie	Styl	"Modern"
summaries[].packageQuantity	integer	Nie	Liczba sztuk w opakowaniu	1
summaries[].releaseDate	string	Nie	Data premiery (ISO 8601)	"2021-03-01T00:00:00Z"
summaries[].adultProduct	boolean	Nie	Flaga produktu dla dorosłych	false
summaries[].autographed	boolean	Nie	Flaga autografu	false
summaries[].memorabilia	boolean	Nie	Flaga memorabiliów	false
summaries[].tradeInEligible	boolean	Nie	Kwalifikacja do trade-in	true
summaries[].itemClassification	string	Nie	Klasyfikacja produktu	"BASE_PRODUCT", "VARIATION_PARENT"
summaries[].websiteDisplayGroup	string	Nie	Grupa wyświetlania	"electronics"
summaries[].websiteDisplayGroupName	string	Nie	Nazwa grupy wyświetlania	"Electronics"

summaries[].contributors[].role.displayName	string	Nie	Wyświetlana nazwa roli	"Autor"
Identifiers - identyfikatory produktu
Ścieżka JSON	Typ	Wymagane	Opis	Przykład
identifiers[].marketplaceId	string	Tak	ID marketplace	"A1PA6795UKMFR9"
identifiers[].identifiers[].identifierType	string	Tak	Typ identyfikatora	"UPC", "EAN", "GTIN", "ISBN", "JAN", "MINSAN"
identifiers[].identifiers[].identifier	string	Tak	Wartość identyfikatora	"4006885648807"
Images - zdjęcia produktu
Ścieżka JSON	Typ	Wymagane	Opis	Przykład
images[].marketplaceId	string	Tak	ID marketplace	"A1PA6795UKMFR9"
images[].images[].variant	string	Tak	Typ wariantu zdjęcia	Zobacz tabelę poniżej
images[].images[].link	string	Tak	URL zdjęcia	"https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/..."
images[].images[].height	integer	Tak	Wysokość w pikselach	500
images[].images[].width	integer	Tak	Szerokość w pikselach	500
Typy wariantów zdjęć:

Wariant	Opis
MAIN	Główne zdjęcie produktu

TOPP, BOTT, LEFT, RGHT, FRNT, BACK	Zdjęcia z różnych kątów
IN01, IN02	Zdjęcia wnętrza (książki)

Attributes (dynamiczne, tylko właściciele marek)
Pole attributes zwraca dynamiczny obiekt JSON z atrybutami zgodnymi z Product Type Definitions API. Przykładowa struktura:

{
  "brand": [{"value": "Samsung", "language_tag": "de_DE", "marketplace_id": "A1PA6795UKMFR9"}],
  "item_name": [{"value": "Samsung QLED TV", "language_tag": "de_DE"}],
  "bullet_point": [{"value": "4K Ultra HD Auflösung", "language_tag": "de_DE"}],
  "product_description": [{"value": "Erleben Sie...", "language_tag": "de_DE"}],
  "color": [{"value": "Schwarz"}],
  "material": [{"value": "Kunststoff"}]
}

SP-API Product Pricing API
API cenowe dostępne w dwóch wersjach: v0 (starsze operacje) i v2022-05-01 (nowsze operacje z rozszerzonymi danymi konkurencyjnymi).

getPricing / getCompetitivePricing (v0)
Główna struktura odpowiedzi
Ścieżka JSON	Typ	Wymagane	Opis
payload[].status	string	Tak	Status operacji ("Success")
payload[].ASIN	string	Nie	ASIN produktu
payload[].SellerSKU	string	Nie	SKU sprzedawcy
payload[].Product	object	Nie	Dane produktu
Identyfikatory produktu
Ścieżka JSON	Typ	Opis	Przykład
Product.Identifiers.MarketplaceASIN.MarketplaceId	string	ID marketplace	"A1PA6795UKMFR9"
Product.Identifiers.MarketplaceASIN.ASIN	string	ASIN	"B00ABC1234"
Product.Identifiers.SKUIdentifier.SellerId	string	ID sprzedawcy	"A2ZWOX..."
Product.Identifiers.SKUIdentifier.SellerSKU	string	SKU sprzedawcy	"MY-SKU-001"
Ceny konkurencyjne
Ścieżka JSON	Typ	Opis	Wartości

Product.CompetitivePricing.CompetitivePrices[].condition	string	Stan produktu	"New", "Used", "Collectible", "Refurbished", "Club"
Product.CompetitivePricing.CompetitivePrices[].subcondition	string	Podstan	"New", "Mint", "Very Good", "Good", "Acceptable", "Poor", "OEM", "Refurbished", "Open Box"
Product.CompetitivePricing.CompetitivePrices[].offerType	enum	Typ klienta	"B2C", "B2B"
Product.CompetitivePricing.CompetitivePrices[].quantityTier	integer	Próg ilościowy	5

getListingOffers / getItemOffers (v0)
Zwracają szczegółowe informacje o wszystkich ofertach konkurencyjnych (do 20 ofert).

Summary - podsumowanie ofert
Ścieżka JSON	Typ	Opis
payload.Summary.TotalOfferCount	integer	Całkowita liczba unikalnych ofert
payload.Summary.ListPrice.Amount	number	MSRP (cena katalogowa)
payload.Summary.CompetitivePriceThreshold.Amount	number	Próg ceny konkurencyjnej
payload.Summary.SuggestedLowerPricePlusShipping.Amount	number	Sugerowana niższa cena
payload.Summary.OffersAvailableTime	datetime	Kiedy oferty będą dostępne
Najniższe ceny (LowestPrices)

Dodaj tę funkcję pomocniczą do skryptu:

/**
 * Menu function to regenerate ImportedProducts sheet
 */
function lukoRegenerateImportedProductsSheet() {
  const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
  
  const confirm = ui.alert(
    'Regenerate ImportedProducts Sheet',
    '⚠️ This will DELETE the existing ImportedProducts sheet and create a new one with 130+ columns.\n\n' +
    'All existing imported data will be LOST!\n\n' +
    'Continue?',
    ui.ButtonSet.YES_NO
  );
  
  if (confirm !== ui.Button.YES) return;
  
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  generateImportedProductsSheet(ss);
  
  ui.alert('Done!', 'ImportedProducts sheet has been regenerated with 130+ columns.', ui.ButtonSet.OK);
}

Potem uruchom tę funkcję z menu LUKO lub bezpośrednio w Apps Script (▶️).

/**
 * Fix/regenerate headers on existing ImportedProducts sheet
 * This preserves existing data!

function lukoFixImportedProductsHeaders() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName('ImportedProducts');
  
  if (!sheet) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Error', 'ImportedProducts sheet not found!', SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);
    return;
  }
  
  const headers = [
    '☑️ Use', 'Import Date', 'Imported By', 'Marketplace',
    'ASIN', 'SKU', 'EAN', 'UPC', 'ISBN', 'GTIN', 'GCID', 'PZN', 'MINSAN', 'Part Number', 'Item Model Number',
    'Seller ID', 'Seller Name',
    'Product Type', 'Title', 'Brand', 'Manufacturer',
    'Bullet Point 1', 'Bullet Point 2', 'Bullet Point 3', 'Bullet Point 4', 'Bullet Point 5',
    'Bullet Point 6', 'Bullet Point 7', 'Bullet Point 8', 'Bullet Point 9',
    'Description', 'Short Description', 'Long Description',
    'Main Image URL', 'Main Image Height', 'Main Image Width',
    'Additional Image 1', 'Additional Image 2', 'Additional Image 3', 'Additional Image 4',
    'Additional Image 5', 'Additional Image 6', 'Additional Image 7', 'Additional Image 8',
    'Total Image Count',
    'List Price', 'Current Price', 'Currency',
    'Available Quantity',
    'Item Length', 'Item Length Unit', 'Item Width', 'Item Width Unit',
    'Item Height', 'Item Height Unit', 'Item Weight', 'Item Weight Unit',
    'Package Length', 'Package Length Unit', 'Package Width', 'Package Width Unit',
    'Package Height', 'Package Height Unit', 'Package Weight', 'Package Weight Unit',
    'Sales Rank 1', 'Sales Rank 1 Category', 'Sales Rank 2', 'Sales Rank 2 Category',
    'Sales Rank 3', 'Sales Rank 3 Category', 'Display Group Rank', 'Display Group Name',
    'Browse Node ID', 'Browse Node Name', 'Category Path', 'Browse Node 2 ID', 'Browse Node 2 Name',
    'Parent ASIN', 'Child ASINs', 'Child Count', 'Variation Theme',
    'Color', 'Color Map', 'Size', 'Size Map', 'Material', 'Style', 'Pattern',
    'Model Number', 'Release Date', 'First Available Date', 'Package Quantity',
    'Unit Count', 'Unit Count Type', 'Country of Origin',
    'Warranty', 'Warranty Type', 'Legal Disclaimer',
    'Safety Warning', 'Hazmat Type', 'Battery Type', 'Battery Weight',
    'Number of Batteries', 'Lithium Battery Weight', 'Lithium Battery Energy Content',
    'Target Gender', 'Age Range', 'Recommended Age', 'Item Form Type',
    'Department', 'Generic Keywords', 'Platinum Keywords', 'Search Terms',
    'Is Gift Wrap Available', 'Is Discontinued', 'Item Condition',
    'Contributors', 'Item Classification', 'Website Display Group', 'Website Display Group Name',
    'Notes'
  ];
  
  // Write headers to row 1
  sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
  
  // Format headers
  sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length)
    .setFontWeight('bold')
    .setBackground('#34A853')
    .setFontColor('#FFFFFF')
    .setWrap(true)
    .setVerticalAlignment('middle')
    .setHorizontalAlignment('center');
  
  // Freeze
  sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
  sheet.setFrozenColumns(5);
  
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Done!', `Headers fixed! Total: ${headers.length} columns (A to DR)`, SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);
}

Brand Story	A+ Content Management API	⚠️ Część A+ API
Sicherheitsinformationen	Catalog Items API	✅ Już dodane (Safety Warning, Hazmat Type)
Konkurencyjne ASINy	❌ Brak w SP-API	Wymaga scrapingu lub Product Advertising API
A+ Content API
Mogę dodać pobieranie A+ Content! Wymaga to osobnego wywołania API:

/aplus/2020-11-01/contentDocuments - lista dokumentów A+
Można pobrać: moduły, teksty, obrazy z A+
Brand Story
Jest częścią A+ Content API - można pobrać razem z A+.

Konkurencyjne ASINy
Nie ma w SP-API. Amazon nie udostępnia informacji o konkurencji. Można by:

Użyć Product Advertising API (PA-API) - ale to osobne konto
Scraping (nie polecam - łamie ToS)

function fetchAPlusContentByASIN(asin, marketplaceConfig, accessToken) {

Ważna informacja o A+ Content API
Patrząc na logi, widzę że większość dokumentów A+ w tym koncie to:

"Kniehohe Merino Wollsocken" (skarpety)
"ULLMYS" (inna marka)
"B0FNRLYQ3G_complete_..." (inne produkty)
Nie widzę żadnych dokumentów A+ dla RAUSCH!

Możliwe przyczyny:
A+ Content API pokazuje tylko Twoje własne dokumenty - jeśli A+ dla produktów RAUSCH został utworzony przez Amazon (Brand Registry) lub przez innego sprzedawcę, NIE pojawi się w Twoim API

Produkty RAUSCH mogą nie mieć A+ Content w ogóle, lub A+ jest zarządzany przez właściciela marki

Konto API ma dostęp tylko do niektórych dokumentów - upewnij się, że Twoja aplikacja ma uprawnienia do A+ Content Management

Co możesz zrobić?
Sprawdź w Seller Central → A+ Content Manager → czy widzisz tam dokumenty dla produktów RAUSCH?

Jeśli nie widzisz dokumentów RAUSCH w Seller Central A+ Manager, to API też ich nie zwróci

Zaktualizuj kod i przetestuj ponownie - teraz sprawdzi wszystkie 35+ dokumentów

Teraz widzę podstawowe ograniczenie SP-API:

Problem: A+ Content API pokazuje tylko TWOJE dokumenty
Widzisz na Amazon.de piękne A+ Content dla RAUSCH ("Von der Marke" - Natürlichkeit. Wirksamkeit. Wohlbefinden.)

ALE - to A+ Content należy do właściciela marki RAUSCH (przez Brand Registry), NIE do Twojego konta sprzedawcy!

Co pokazuje SP-API A+ Content Management:
✅ Dokumenty A+ które TY stworzyłeś w swoim koncie
✅ ULLMYS, Merino Wollsocken (35 dokumentów)
❌ NIE pokazuje A+ Content innych sprzedawców
❌ NIE pokazuje A+ Content właścicieli marek (Brand Registry)
Dlaczego RAUSCH A+ nie jest dostępne:
RAUSCH AG (właściciel marki) utworzył ten A+ Content przez Brand Registry
Twoje konto sprzedawcy nie ma dostępu do ich dokumentów
SP-API nie udostępnia publicznego A+ Content
Co można zrobić?
Opcja 1: Pobrać A+ z publicznej strony (scraping)
Nie przez SP-API
Wymaga scrapingu HTML strony produktu
Amazon może to blokować (ToS)
Opcja 2: Sprawdzić czy jesteś autoryzowanym sprzedawcą
Jeśli jesteś autoryzowanym resellerem RAUSCH, możesz poprosić ich o dostęp do A+ Content
Opcja 3: Zaakceptować ograniczenie
SP-API A+ Content działa tylko dla Twoich własnych dokumentów A+
Dla produktów innych marek (RAUSCH) - ta funkcja nie zadziała
Podsumowanie: A+ Content import działa poprawnie dla produktów gdzie TY jesteś autorem A+ Content (np. ULLMYS). Dla produktów innych marek (RAUSCH) - API nie ma dostępu do ich A+ Content.

function fetchSellerByASIN(asin, marketplaceConfig, accessToken) {
  try {
    const path = `/catalog/2022-04-01/items/${asin}/offers`;
    const params = {
      MarketplaceId: marketplaceConfig.marketplaceId
    };
 
    const response = callSPAPI('GET', path, marketplaceConfig.marketplaceId, params, accessToken);
 
    const offers = response.offers || [];
    if (offers.length > 0) {
      const offer = offers[0];
      return {
        sellerId: offer.SellerId || offer.sellerId || '',
        sellerName: offer.SellerName || offer.sellerName || ''
      };
    }
 
  } catch (error) {
    Logger.log(`Could not fetch seller info: ${error.message}`);

function fetchProductPricing(asin, marketplaceConfig, accessToken) {
  try {
    const path = `/products/pricing/v0/items/${asin}/offers`;
    const params = {
      MarketplaceId: marketplaceConfig.marketplaceId,
      ItemCondition: 'New'
    };
 
    const response = callSPAPI('GET', path, marketplaceConfig.marketplaceId, params, accessToken);
 
    const summary = response.summary || {};
 
    return {
      listPrice: summary.ListPrice?.Amount || '',
      currentPrice: summary.BuyBoxPrices?.[0]?.LandedPrice?.Amount || '',
      currency: summary.ListPrice?.CurrencyCode || ''
    };

Zaimplementowane poprawki:
"Has A+" i "Has Brand Story" - Zamiast "No" pokazuje teraz "Brak dostępu" (lub "Tak" gdy znaleziono)

Checkbox - Kolumna ☑️ Use nie będzie pokazywać "FALSE" - pozostanie pusta kratka do zaznaczenia

Import Date - Data w formacie niemieckim (dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss) z timezone Europe/Berlin

Marketplace - Wybór marketplace z listą opcji (DE jako domyślny):

Wyświetla wszystkie dostępne marketplace z flagami
Jeśli nic nie wpiszesz → automatycznie DE
Search by keyword - Teraz pobiera WSZYSTKIE wyniki (do 200):

Paginacja automatyczna (max 10 stron × 20 produktów)
Pyta ile produktów zaimportować
Można wpisać liczbę, "all", lub 0 żeby anulować
Debug logging - Dodano logi diagnostyczne dla:

Description, Short Description, Long Description
Pricing (List Price, Current Price)
Seller ID, Seller Name
Release Date, First Available Date
Co do logów:
Po następnym imporcie sprawdź logi w Apps Script (View > Logs lub Execution log). Zobaczysz:

[FETCH DEBUG] - jakie atrybuty są dostępne dla produktu
[PRICE DEBUG] - co zwraca API dla cen
[SELLER DEBUG] - co zwraca API dla sprzedawcy
Dzięki tym logom będziemy mogli zdiagnozować dlaczego niektóre pola są puste.

Uwaga techniczna:
Niektóre pola (Description, Seller, Price, Dates) mogą być puste z powodu:

Ograniczeń API (nie wszystkie dane są dostępne dla wszystkich produktów)
Braku uprawnień (np. Seller API wymaga dodatkowych uprawnień)
Atrybuty mają inne nazwy dla różnych typów produktów

/**
 * Get Amazon product link for an ASIN based on marketplace
 */
function getAmazonProductLink(asin, marketplace) {
  const domains = {
    'DE': 'www.amazon.de',
    'FR': 'www.amazon.fr',
    'UK': 'www.amazon.co.uk',
    'IT': 'www.amazon.it',
    'ES': 'www.amazon.es',
    'NL': 'www.amazon.nl',
    'BE': 'www.amazon.com.be',
    'PL': 'www.amazon.pl',
    'SE': 'www.amazon.se',
    'IE': 'www.amazon.ie'
  };
  const domain = domains[marketplace] || 'www.amazon.de';
  return `https://${domain}/dp/${asin}`;
}

Architektura:
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│   📚 Amazon API Library             │
│   (Standalone Apps Script Project)  │
│                                     │
│   ├── Auth.gs (tokeny, OAuth)       │
│   ├── SP_API.gs (Catalog, Pricing)  │
│   ├── PA_API.gs (Product Advert.)   │
│   ├── APlus_API.gs (A+ Content)     │
│   ├── Config.gs (credentials)       │
│   └── Helpers.gs (wspólne utils)    │
└──────────────┬──────────────────────┘
               │ Library import
     ┌─────────┼─────────────┐
     ▼         ▼             ▼
┌─────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────────┐
│Arkusz 1 │ │Arkusz 2  │ │Arkusz 3      │
│Content  │ │Analiza   │ │Import        │
│Manager  │ │Konkurencji│ │Produktów    │
└─────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────────┘

Co to daje:
Jeden kod - zmiana w library = działa we wszystkich arkuszach
Wspólne credentials - konfiguracja raz, dostępna wszędzie
Każdy arkusz dodaje tylko swoje UI (menu, sheet format)
Nowe API - dodajesz do library, od razu dostępne we wszystkich narzędziach
Jak działa w praktyce:
W dowolnym arkuszu piszesz np.:

// Zamiast lokalnej funkcji:
const product = AmazonLib.fetchProductByASIN('B09G34ZS3W', 'DE');
const price = AmazonLib.fetchProductPricing('B09G34ZS3W', 'DE');
const aplus = AmazonLib.fetchAPlusContentByASIN('B09G34ZS3W', 'DE');

Jakie inne API już masz? (PA-API, coś jeszcze?)
Czy credentials są te same dla wszystkich arkuszy? (ten sam seller account?)
Ile arkuszy aktualnie korzysta z Amazon API?
Wtedy zaplanuję migrację tak żeby nic nie zepsuć.

/**

Show information about configuring PA-API credentials for multiple marketplaces
*/
function setupCredentials() {
const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
const hasDE = props.getProperty('PA_PARTNER_TAG_DE') || props.getProperty('PA_PARTNER_TAG');
const hasUK = props.getProperty('PA_PARTNER_TAG_UK');
const hasUS = props.getProperty('PA_PARTNER_TAG_US');
const hasFR = props.getProperty('PA_PARTNER_TAG_FR');
const hasIT = props.getProperty('PA_PARTNER_TAG_IT');
const hasES = props.getProperty('PA_PARTNER_TAG_ES');
const hasPL = props.getProperty('PA_PARTNER_TAG_PL');

const message = `
🔐 MULTI-MARKETPLACE CREDENTIALS CONFIGURATION

OBECNY STATUS:
${hasDE ? '✅' : '❌'} Amazon.de (PA_PARTNER_TAG_DE)
${hasUK ? '✅' : '❌'} Amazon.co.uk (PA_PARTNER_TAG_UK)
${hasUS ? '✅' : '❌'} Amazon.com (PA_PARTNER_TAG_US)
${hasFR ? '✅' : '❌'} Amazon.fr (PA_PARTNER_TAG_FR)
${hasIT ? '✅' : '❌'} Amazon.it (PA_PARTNER_TAG_IT)
${hasES ? '✅' : '❌'} Amazon.es (PA_PARTNER_TAG_ES)
${hasPL ? '✅' : '❌'} Amazon.pl (PA_PARTNER_TAG_PL)

JAK DODAĆ NOWY MARKETPLACE:

Zarejestruj się w Amazon Associates dla danego kraju:
• Amazon.de: https://partnernet.amazon.de
• Amazon.co.uk: https://affiliate-program.amazon.co.uk
• Amazon.com: https://affiliate-program.amazon.com
• Amazon.fr: https://partenaires.amazon.fr
• Amazon.it: https://programma-affiliazione.amazon.it
• Amazon.es: https://afiliados.amazon.es
• Amazon.pl: https://associates.amazon.pl

Skopiuj Partner Tag (Associate Tag) dla tego marketplace

Dodaj do Script Properties:
• Extensions > Apps Script
• Project Settings (gear icon)
• Script Properties > Add property
• Klucz: PA_PARTNER_TAG_[KOD] (np. PA_PARTNER_TAG_FR)
• Wartość: [twój partner tag]

UWAGA:
Możesz używać tylko tych marketplace, dla których masz
zarejestrowane konto Amazon Associates!

Access Key i Secret Key są wspólne dla wszystkich marketplace.
`;

ui.alert('🔐 Credentials Configuration', message, ui.ButtonSet.OK);
}
