/**

Setup all required sheets with proper headers
RUN THIS ONCE to create sheet structure
*/
function setupSheets() {
const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId());
// Create INPUT sheet
let inputSheet = ss.getSheetByName('INPUT');
if (!inputSheet) {
inputSheet = ss.insertSheet('INPUT');
inputSheet.getRange('A1:M1').setValues([[
'ASIN', 'Status', 'Marketplace', 'Brand', 'Product_Type',
'Client_Email', 'Additional_Notes', 'Timestamp_Started',
'Timestamp_Completed', 'Doc_URL', 'Error_Log', '', 'Language'
]]);
inputSheet.getRange('A1:M1').setFontWeight('bold').setBackground('#4285f4').setFontColor('#ffffff');
inputSheet.setFrozenRows(1);
}

// Create or UPDATE RESEARCH sheet with ALL PA-API fields
let researchSheet = ss.getSheetByName('RESEARCH');
if (!researchSheet) {
researchSheet = ss.insertSheet('RESEARCH');
}

// Always update headers (in case structure changed)
const headers = getResearchHeaders();
const headerRange = researchSheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length);
headerRange.setValues([headers]);
headerRange.setFontWeight('bold');
headerRange.setBackground('#34a853');
headerRange.setFontColor('#ffffff');
researchSheet.setFrozenRows(1);
researchSheet.setFrozenColumns(3); // Freeze ASIN, ASIN_Type, Related_To_ASIN

Logger.log(✅ RESEARCH sheet updated with ${headers.length} columns);

// Create GROK_PROMPT sheet
let grokSheet = ss.getSheetByName('GROK_PROMPT');
if (!grokSheet) {
grokSheet = ss.insertSheet('GROK_PROMPT');
grokSheet.getRange('A1:E1').setValues([[
'ASIN', 'Generated_Prompt', 'Instructions_PL', 'Timestamp_Generated', 'Language'
]]);
grokSheet.getRange('A1:E1').setFontWeight('bold').setBackground('#fbbc04').setFontColor('#ffffff');
grokSheet.setFrozenRows(1);
grokSheet.setColumnWidth(2, 800); // Wide column for prompt
} else {
// Update headers if sheet exists (add Language column if missing)
const headers = grokSheet.getRange('A1:E1').getValues()[0];
if (headers.length < 5 || headers[4] !== 'Language') {
grokSheet.getRange('A1:E1').setValues([[
'ASIN', 'Generated_Prompt', 'Instructions_PL', 'Timestamp_Generated', 'Language'
]]);
Logger.log('✅ Updated GROK_PROMPT headers with Language column');
}
}

// Create OUTPUT sheet
let outputSheet = ss.getSheetByName('OUTPUT');
if (!outputSheet) {
outputSheet = ss.insertSheet('OUTPUT');
outputSheet.getRange('A1:AI1').setValues([[
'ASIN', 'Grok_JSON_Input', 'Title_DE', 'Bullet_1', 'Bullet_2', 'Bullet_3',
'Bullet_4', 'Bullet_5', 'Description_HTML', 'Keywords',
'Infographic_1_Text_DE', 'Infographic_1_Instructions_PL',
'Infographic_2_Text_DE', 'Infographic_2_Instructions_PL',
'Infographic_3_Text_DE', 'Infographic_3_Instructions_PL',
'Infographic_4_Text_DE', 'Infographic_4_Instructions_PL',
'Infographic_5_Text_DE', 'Infographic_5_Instructions_PL',
'Video_Text_DE', 'Video_Instructions_PL',
'A+_Module_1', 'A+_Module_2', 'A+_Module_3', 'A+_Module_4',
'Brand_Story_Text_DE', 'Brand_Store_Suggestions_PL', 'Compliance_Check',
'Title_PL', 'Language', 'Doc_URL', 'PDF_URL', 'Client_Sheet_URL', 'Flat_File_URL'
]]);
outputSheet.getRange('A1:AI1').setFontWeight('bold').setBackground('#ea4335').setFontColor('#ffffff');
outputSheet.setFrozenRows(1);
outputSheet.setColumnWidth(2, 600); // Wide column for JSON input
} else {
// Update headers if sheet exists (add Title_PL and Language columns if missing)
const lastCol = outputSheet.getLastColumn();
if (lastCol < 35) {
outputSheet.getRange('A1:AI1').setValues([[
'ASIN', 'Grok_JSON_Input', 'Title_DE', 'Bullet_1', 'Bullet_2', 'Bullet_3',
'Bullet_4', 'Bullet_5', 'Description_HTML', 'Keywords',
'Infographic_1_Text_DE', 'Infographic_1_Instructions_PL',
'Infographic_2_Text_DE', 'Infographic_2_Instructions_PL',
'Infographic_3_Text_DE', 'Infographic_3_Instructions_PL',
'Infographic_4_Text_DE', 'Infographic_4_Instructions_PL',
'Infographic_5_Text_DE', 'Infographic_5_Instructions_PL',
'Video_Text_DE', 'Video_Instructions_PL',
'A+_Module_1', 'A+_Module_2', 'A+_Module_3', 'A+_Module_4',
'Brand_Story_Text_DE', 'Brand_Store_Suggestions_PL', 'Compliance_Check',
'Title_PL', 'Language', 'Doc_URL', 'PDF_URL', 'Client_Sheet_URL', 'Flat_File_URL'
]]);
Logger.log('✅ Updated OUTPUT headers with Title_PL and Language columns');
}
}

Logger.log('✅ All sheets created successfully');
SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('✅ All sheets created successfully!');
}

// ============================================================================

/**

Update status in INPUT sheet
*/
function updateStatus(asin, status, errorMsg = '') {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('INPUT');
const row = findRow(sheet, asin);
sheet.getRange(row, 2).setValue(status); // Column B: Status

if (status === 'PROCESSING' && sheet.getRange(row, 8).getValue() === '') {
sheet.getRange(row, 8).setValue(Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm')); // Timestamp_Started
}

if (status === 'COMPLETE') {
sheet.getRange(row, 9).setValue(Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm')); // Timestamp_Completed
}

if (errorMsg) {
sheet.getRange(row, 11).setValue(errorMsg); // Error_Log
}
}

/**

Find row number by ASIN
*/
function findRow(sheet, asin) {
const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
if (data[i][0] === asin) {
return i + 1;
}
}
throw new Error(ASIN ${asin} not found in sheet ${sheet.getName()});
}
/**

Find or create row by ASIN
*/
function findOrCreateRow(sheet, asin) {
try {
return findRow(sheet, asin);
} catch (e) {
// Add new row
const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
sheet.getRange(lastRow + 1, 1).setValue(asin);
return lastRow + 1;
}
}
/**

Get selected ASIN from active cell
*/
function getSelectedAsin() {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();
const row = sheet.getActiveCell().getRow();
if (row < 2) return null;
return sheet.getRange(row, 1).getValue();
}
/**

Get input data for ASIN
*/
function getInputData(asin) {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('INPUT');
const row = findRow(sheet, asin);
const data = sheet.getRange(row, 1, 1, 13).getValues()[0];
return {
asin: data[0],
status: data[1],
marketplace: data[2] || 'de',
brand: data[3],
productType: data[4],
clientEmail: data[5],
additionalNotes: data[6],
timestampStarted: data[7],
timestampCompleted: data[8],
docUrl: data[9],
errorLog: data[10],
language: data[12] || 'DE'
};
}

/**

Get research data for ASIN (legacy - limited fields)
*/
function getResearchData(asin) {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('RESEARCH');
const row = findRow(sheet, asin);
const data = sheet.getRange(row, 1, 1, 14).getValues()[0];
return {
asin: data[0],
titleDE: data[1],
bulletsDE: data[2],
descriptionDE: data[3],
imagesUrls: data[4],
starRating: data[5],
reviewsCount: data[6],
priceEUR: data[7],
competitorAsins: data[8],
reviewsSummary: data[9],
technicalSpecs: data[10],
browseNode: data[11],
keywordsExtracted: data[12],
timestampResearch: data[13]
};
}

/**

Get FULL research data for ASIN (all 200+ fields)
Returns object with field names as keys
*/
function getFullResearchData(asin) {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('RESEARCH');
const headers = getResearchHeaders();
try {
const row = findRow(sheet, asin);
const data = sheet.getRange(row, 1, 1, headers.length).getValues()[0];

// Build object with header names as keys
const result = {};
for (let i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
  result[headers[i]] = data[i] || '';
}

return result;

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(Error getting full research data for ${asin}: ${error.message});
return null;
}
}

/**

Get all similar products (where Related_To_ASIN = mainAsin)
Returns array of objects with full data for each similar product
*/
function getSimilarProducts(mainAsin) {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('RESEARCH');
const headers = getResearchHeaders();
const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
const similarProducts = [];

// Find column indices
const asinIdx = headers.indexOf('ASIN');
const typeIdx = headers.indexOf('ASIN_Type');
const relatedIdx = headers.indexOf('Related_To_ASIN');

// Skip header row, start from row 1
for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
const rowData = data[i];

// Check if this is a similar product for our main ASIN
if (rowData[relatedIdx] === mainAsin && rowData[typeIdx] === 'Podobny') {
  // Build object with all fields
  const product = {};
  for (let j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) {
    product[headers[j]] = rowData[j] || '';
  }
  similarProducts.push(product);
}

}

Logger.log(Found ${similarProducts.length} similar products for ${mainAsin});
return similarProducts;
}

/**

Save output URLs to OUTPUT sheet
Columns: AE=Language, AF=Title_Short_Lang, AG=Title_Short_PL, AH=Doc_URL, AI=PDF_URL, AJ=Client_Sheet_URL, AK=Flat_File_URL
*/
function saveOutputUrl(asin, type, url) {
const outputSheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('OUTPUT');
const row = findRow(outputSheet, asin);
// Determine which column to update
let column;
switch(type) {
case 'doc':
column = 34; // AH (was 31/AE - now shifted +3 due to Title_Short columns)
break;
case 'pdf':
column = 35; // AI (was 32/AF - now shifted +3)
break;
case 'client':
column = 36; // AJ (was 33/AG - now shifted +3)
break;
case 'flatfile':
column = 37; // AK (was 34/AH - now shifted +3)
break;
default:
Logger.log(Unknown URL type: ${type});
return;
}

outputSheet.getRange(row, column).setValue(url);
Logger.log(Saved ${type} URL to OUTPUT column ${column});
}

// ============================================================================
// AWS SIGNATURE V4 AUTHENTICATION - FIXED FOR MULTI-MARKETPLACE
// ============================================================================

/**

Helper to convert byte array to hex string
*/
function bytesToHex(bytes) {
return bytes.map(function(byte) {
return ('0' + (byte & 0xFF).toString(16)).slice(-2);
}).join('');
}
/**

Generate AWS Signature Version 4
Required for Amazon PA-API 5.0
✅ FIXED: Include ALL required headers for multi-marketplace support
@param {string} method - HTTP method (POST)
@param {string} host - API endpoint host (e.g. webservices.amazon.fr)
@param {string} path - API path (/paapi5/getitems)
@param {string} queryString - Query string (empty for PA-API)
@param {string} payload - JSON payload
@param {string} region - AWS region (e.g. eu-west-1)
@param {string} service - Service name (ProductAdvertisingAPI)
@param {string} operation - PA-API operation (GetItems, SearchItems, etc.)
@param {string} contentType - Content-Type header value
*/
function generateAwsSignature(method, host, path, queryString, payload, region, service, operation, contentType = 'application/json; charset=utf-8') {
const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
const accessKey = props.getProperty('PA_ACCESS_KEY');
const secretKey = props.getProperty('PA_SECRET_KEY');
// Date and time
const now = new Date();
const amzDate = Utilities.formatDate(now, 'GMT', "yyyyMMdd'T'HHmmss'Z'");
const dateStamp = Utilities.formatDate(now, 'GMT', 'yyyyMMdd');

// X-Amz-Target for PA-API
const amzTarget = com.amazon.paapi5.v1.ProductAdvertisingAPIv1.${operation};

// Canonical request
const canonicalUri = path;
const canonicalQueryString = queryString || '';

// ⚠️ CRITICAL FIX: Include ALL headers that will be sent in the request!
// PA-API requires these 5 headers in canonical request:
// 1. content-encoding:amz-1.0
// 2. content-type:application/json; charset=utf-8
// 3. host:webservices.amazon.XX
// 4. x-amz-date:YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ
// 5. x-amz-target:com.amazon.paapi5.v1.ProductAdvertisingAPIv1.Operation
const canonicalHeaders =
content-encoding:amz-1.0\n +
content-type:${contentType}\n +
host:${host}\n +
x-amz-date:${amzDate}\n +
x-amz-target:${amzTarget}\n;
const signedHeaders = 'content-encoding;content-type;host;x-amz-date;x-amz-target';

const payloadHash = bytesToHex(
Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256, payload)
);

const canonicalRequest = ${method}\n${canonicalUri}\n${canonicalQueryString}\n${canonicalHeaders}\n${signedHeaders}\n${payloadHash};

// String to sign
const algorithm = 'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256';
const credentialScope = ${dateStamp}/${region}/${service}/aws4_request;
const canonicalRequestHash = bytesToHex(
Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256, canonicalRequest)
);
const stringToSign = ${algorithm}\n${amzDate}\n${credentialScope}\n${canonicalRequestHash};

// Signing key - chain HMAC operations properly
const kDate = Utilities.computeHmacSha256Signature(dateStamp, 'AWS4' + secretKey);
const kRegion = Utilities.computeHmacSha256Signature(Utilities.newBlob(region).getBytes(), kDate);
const kService = Utilities.computeHmacSha256Signature(Utilities.newBlob(service).getBytes(), kRegion);
const kSigning = Utilities.computeHmacSha256Signature(Utilities.newBlob('aws4_request').getBytes(), kService);

// Signature - stringToSign must also be byte array when key is byte array
const signature = bytesToHex(
Utilities.computeHmacSha256Signature(Utilities.newBlob(stringToSign).getBytes(), kSigning)
);

// Authorization header
const authorizationHeader = ${algorithm} Credential=${accessKey}/${credentialScope}, SignedHeaders=${signedHeaders}, Signature=${signature};

return {
'Authorization': authorizationHeader,
'X-Amz-Date': amzDate
};
}

// ============================================================================
// PA-API HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

/**

Recursively merge two objects
*/
function mergeObjects(target, source) {
if (!source) return target;
if (!target) return source;
for (const key in source) {
if (source.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
if (typeof source[key] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(source[key]) && source[key] !== null) {
target[key] = mergeObjects(target[key] || {}, source[key]);
} else if (source[key] !== undefined && source[key] !== null && source[key] !== '') {
target[key] = source[key];
}
}
}
return target;
}

/**

Merge multiple product items from different API calls
*/
function mergeProductItems(items) {
if (!items || items.length === 0) return null;
if (items.length === 1) return items[0];
let merged = items[0];
for (let i = 1; i < items.length; i++) {
merged = mergeObjects(merged, items[i]);
}
return merged;
}

/**

Determine main category with 4-level priority hierarchy
*/
function determineMainCategory(result, item, marketplace) {
let mainCategory = '';
let source = '';
// Priority 1: WebsiteSalesRank.DisplayValue
if (item.BrowseNodeInfo && item.BrowseNodeInfo.WebsiteSalesRank && item.BrowseNodeInfo.WebsiteSalesRank.DisplayValue) {
mainCategory = item.BrowseNodeInfo.WebsiteSalesRank.DisplayValue;
source = 'WebsiteSalesRank';
}

// Priority 2: Root from BrowseNodes tree traversal
if (!mainCategory && item.BrowseNodeInfo && item.BrowseNodeInfo.BrowseNodes && item.BrowseNodeInfo.BrowseNodes.length > 0) {
function findRoot(node) {
let current = node;
while (current.Ancestor) {
current = current.Ancestor;
}
return current;
}

const root = findRoot(item.BrowseNodeInfo.BrowseNodes[0]);
if (root && root.DisplayName) {
  mainCategory = root.DisplayName;
  source = 'BrowseNodes_Root';
}

}

// Priority 3: Map ProductGroup to category
if (!mainCategory && result.ProductGroup) {
const mapped = mapProductGroupToMainCategory(result.ProductGroup);
if (mapped) {
mainCategory = mapped;
source = 'ProductGroup_Mapped';
}
}

// Priority 4: Fallback to CategoryName
if (!mainCategory && result.CategoryName) {
mainCategory = mapToMainCategory(result.CategoryName);
source = 'CategoryName';
}

result.BSRMainCategoryName = mainCategory;
result.BestSellerCategory1 = mainCategory;
result.BSRMainCategorySource = source;
result.MainCategoryName = mainCategory;

return result;
}

/**

Process extended product data with all 200+ field mappings
*/
function processExtendedProductData(item, result) {
// Helper to safely get nested values
const get = (obj, path, defaultValue = '') => {
try {
return path.split('.').reduce((o, k) => o?.[k], obj) || defaultValue;
} catch (e) {
return defaultValue;
}
};
// Helper to parse float
const parseNum = (val) => {
if (!val) return 0;
const num = parseFloat(val.toString().replace(/[^\d.-]/g, ''));
return isNaN(num) ? 0 : num;
};

// ===== TITLE FIELDS =====
const title = get(item, 'ItemInfo.Title.DisplayValue', '');
result.Title = title;
result.TitleLength = title.length;
result.TitleWords = title ? title.split(/\s+/).length : 0;
result.TitleFirstWord = title ? title.split(/\s+/)[0] : '';
result.TitleLastWord = title ? title.split(/\s+/).pop() : '';
result.TitleShort = title.substring(0, 80);
result.TitleMedium = title.substring(0, 120);
result.TitleLabel = get(item, 'ItemInfo.Title.Label', '');
result.TitleLocale = get(item, 'ItemInfo.Title.Locale.DisplayValue', '');

// ===== BRAND FIELDS =====
const brandName = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ByLineInfo.Brand.DisplayValue', '');
result.BrandName = brandName;
result.BrandNameLower = brandName.toLowerCase();
result.BrandNameLength = brandName.length;
result.BrandLabel = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ByLineInfo.Brand.Label', '');
result.BrandLocale = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ByLineInfo.Brand.Locale.DisplayValue', '');

const manufacturer = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ByLineInfo.Manufacturer.DisplayValue', '');
result.Manufacturer = manufacturer;
result.ManufacturerLabel = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ByLineInfo.Manufacturer.Label', '');
result.ManufacturerLocale = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ByLineInfo.Manufacturer.Locale.DisplayValue', '');
result.ManufacturerDiffersFromBrand = (brandName && manufacturer && brandName !== manufacturer) ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';

// ===== FEATURES / BULLET POINTS =====
const features = get(item, 'ItemInfo.Features.DisplayValues', []);
result.FeaturesCount = features.length;
result.Features = features.join('\n');
result.BulletPoints = features.join('\n');
result.FeaturesLabel = get(item, 'ItemInfo.Features.Label', '');
result.FeaturesLocale = get(item, 'ItemInfo.Features.Locale.DisplayValue', '');

let totalLength = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(5, features.length); i++) {
const feature = features[i];
result[Feature${i+1}] = feature;
result[BulletPoint${i+1}] = feature;
result[Feature${i+1}Length] = feature.length;
result[Feature${i+1}Words] = feature.split(/\s+/).length;
totalLength += feature.length;
}
result.TotalFeaturesLength = totalLength;
result.AvgFeatureLength = features.length > 0 ? Math.floor(totalLength / features.length) : 0;

// ===== CLASSIFICATIONS =====
const binding = get(item, 'ItemInfo.Classifications.Binding.DisplayValue', '');
result.Binding = binding;
result.BindingLabel = get(item, 'ItemInfo.Classifications.Binding.Label', '');
result.BindingLocale = get(item, 'ItemInfo.Classifications.Binding.Locale.DisplayValue', '');

const productGroup = get(item, 'ItemInfo.Classifications.ProductGroup.DisplayValue', '');
result.ProductGroup = productGroup;
result.ProductGroupLabel = get(item, 'ItemInfo.Classifications.ProductGroup.Label', '');
result.ProductGroupLocale = get(item, 'ItemInfo.Classifications.ProductGroup.Locale.DisplayValue', '');

// ===== EXTERNAL IDS =====
const eans = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ExternalIds.EANs.DisplayValues', []);
result.EANs = eans.join(', ');
result.EANCount = eans.length;
if (eans.length > 0) {
result.EAN = eans[0];
result.EAN1 = eans[0];
result.PrimaryEAN = eans[0];
}

// ===== MANUFACTURE INFO =====
result.PartNumber = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ManufactureInfo.ItemPartNumber.DisplayValue', '');
result.PartNumberLabel = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ManufactureInfo.ItemPartNumber.Label', '');
result.PartNumberLocale = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ManufactureInfo.ItemPartNumber.Locale.DisplayValue', '');

result.Model = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ManufactureInfo.Model.DisplayValue', '');
result.ModelLabel = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ManufactureInfo.Model.Label', '');
result.ModelLocale = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ManufactureInfo.Model.Locale.DisplayValue', '');

// ===== PRODUCT INFO =====
result.ColorName = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ProductInfo.Color.DisplayValue', '');
result.ColorNameLower = result.ColorName.toLowerCase();
result.ColorLabel = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ProductInfo.Color.Label', '');
result.ColorLocale = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ProductInfo.Color.Locale.DisplayValue', '');
result.IsBlack = result.ColorNameLower.includes('black') || result.ColorNameLower.includes('schwarz') ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';
result.IsWhite = result.ColorNameLower.includes('white') || result.ColorNameLower.includes('weiß') || result.ColorNameLower.includes('weiss') ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';

result.SizeName = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ProductInfo.Size.DisplayValue', '');
result.SizeNameLower = result.SizeName.toLowerCase();
result.SizeLabel = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ProductInfo.Size.Label', '');
result.SizeLocale = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ProductInfo.Size.Locale.DisplayValue', '');

result.UnitCount = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ProductInfo.UnitCount.DisplayValue', '');
result.UnitCountNumeric = parseNum(result.UnitCount);

// ===== DIMENSIONS =====
const itemDims = get(item, 'ItemInfo.ProductInfo.ItemDimensions', null);
if (itemDims) {
result.HasDimensions = 'TRUE';

result.ItemHeight = get(itemDims, 'Height.DisplayValue', '');
result.ItemHeightDisplayValue = result.ItemHeight;
result.ItemHeightNumeric = parseNum(result.ItemHeight);
result.ItemHeightUnit = get(itemDims, 'Height.Unit', '');
result.ItemHeightUnitOfMeasure = result.ItemHeightUnit;

result.ItemLength = get(itemDims, 'Length.DisplayValue', '');
result.ItemLengthDisplayValue = result.ItemLength;
result.ItemLengthNumeric = parseNum(result.ItemLength);
result.ItemLengthUnit = get(itemDims, 'Length.Unit', '');
result.ItemLengthUnitOfMeasure = result.ItemLengthUnit;

result.ItemWidth = get(itemDims, 'Width.DisplayValue', '');
result.ItemWidthDisplayValue = result.ItemWidth;
result.ItemWidthNumeric = parseNum(result.ItemWidth);
result.ItemWidthUnit = get(itemDims, 'Width.Unit', '');
result.ItemWidthUnitOfMeasure = result.ItemWidthUnit;

result.ItemWeight = get(itemDims, 'Weight.DisplayValue', '');
result.ItemWeightDisplayValue = result.ItemWeight;
result.ItemWeightNumeric = parseNum(result.ItemWeight);
result.ItemWeightUnit = get(itemDims, 'Weight.Unit', '');
result.ItemWeightUnitOfMeasure = result.ItemWeightUnit;

// Calculate volume (assuming same unit for all dimensions)
if (result.ItemHeightNumeric && result.ItemLengthNumeric && result.ItemWidthNumeric) {
  result.ItemVolume = (result.ItemHeightNumeric * result.ItemLengthNumeric * result.ItemWidthNumeric).toFixed(2);
  result.ItemVolumeUnit = result.ItemHeightUnit + '³';
}

} else {
result.HasDimensions = 'FALSE';
}

// ===== IMAGES =====
// Primary images
const primarySmall = get(item, 'Images.Primary.Small', null);
const primaryMedium = get(item, 'Images.Primary.Medium', null);
const primaryLarge = get(item, 'Images.Primary.Large', null);

if (primarySmall) {
result.PrimarySmallImageHeight = primarySmall.Height;
result.PrimarySmallImageWidth = primarySmall.Width;
result.PrimarySmallImageAspectRatio = primarySmall.Width && primarySmall.Height ? (primarySmall.Width / primarySmall.Height).toFixed(2) : '';
}

if (primaryMedium) {
result.PrimaryMediumImageHeight = primaryMedium.Height;
result.PrimaryMediumImageWidth = primaryMedium.Width;
result.PrimaryMediumImageAspectRatio = primaryMedium.Width && primaryMedium.Height ? (primaryMedium.Width / primaryMedium.Height).toFixed(2) : '';
}

if (primaryLarge) {
result.PrimaryLargeImageHeight = primaryLarge.Height;
result.PrimaryLargeImageWidth = primaryLarge.Width;
result.PrimaryLargeImageAspectRatio = primaryLarge.Width && primaryLarge.Height ? (primaryLarge.Width / primaryLarge.Height).toFixed(2) : '';
result.FeaturedImageSource = primaryLarge.URL;
result.Image0Source = primaryLarge.URL;
}

result.HasPrimaryImage = primaryLarge ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';

// Variant images
const variants = get(item, 'Images.Variants', []);
result.VariantImagesCount = variants.length;
result.HasVariantImages = variants.length > 0 ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';

const variantLargeUrls = [];
const variantMediumUrls = [];
const variantSmallUrls = [];

for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(8, variants.length); i++) {
const variant = variants[i];

if (variant.Large) {
  const url = variant.Large.URL;
  variantLargeUrls.push(url);
  result[`VariantLargeImage${i+1}`] = url;
  result[`VariantLargeImage${i+1}Height`] = variant.Large.Height;
  result[`VariantLargeImage${i+1}Width`] = variant.Large.Width;
  result[`VariantLargeImage${i+1}AspectRatio`] = variant.Large.Width && variant.Large.Height ? (variant.Large.Width / variant.Large.Height).toFixed(2) : '';
  result[`Image${i+1}Source`] = url;
}

if (variant.Medium) {
  variantMediumUrls.push(variant.Medium.URL);
  result[`VariantMediumImage${i+1}`] = variant.Medium.URL;
}

if (variant.Small) {
  variantSmallUrls.push(variant.Small.URL);
  result[`VariantSmallImage${i+1}`] = variant.Small.URL;
}

}

result.VariantLargeImagesUrls = variantLargeUrls.join(', ');
result.VariantMediumImagesUrls = variantMediumUrls.join(', ');
result.VariantSmallImagesUrls = variantSmallUrls.join(', ');
result.TotalImagesCount = (primaryLarge ? 1 : 0) + variants.length;
result.HasImages = result.TotalImagesCount > 0 ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';

// ===== OFFERS & PRICING =====
const listings = get(item, 'Offers.Listings', []);
result.OffersCount = listings.length;
result.HasOffers = listings.length > 0 ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';

if (listings.length > 0) {
const listing = listings[0];

// Price
const price = get(listing, 'Price.Amount', '');
result.Price = price;
result.PriceCurrency = get(listing, 'Price.Currency', '');
result.PriceFormatted = get(listing, 'Price.DisplayAmount', '');
result.PriceText = result.PriceFormatted;

// List Price (from SavingBasis)
const listPrice = get(listing, 'SavingBasis.Amount', '');
if (listPrice) {
  result.ListPrice = listPrice;
  result.ListPriceCurrency = get(listing, 'SavingBasis.Currency', '');
  result.ListPriceFormatted = get(listing, 'SavingBasis.DisplayAmount', '');

  // Calculate discount
  if (price && listPrice && parseNum(listPrice) > 0) {
    const discount = ((1 - (parseNum(price) / parseNum(listPrice))) * 100).toFixed(0);
    result.CalculatedDiscount = discount;
    result.HasSavings = 'TRUE';
  }
}

// Promotions
const promos = get(listing, 'Promotions', []);
result.HasDeal = promos.length > 0 ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';
result.HasCoupon = promos.some(p => p.Type === 'COUPON') ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';

// Other offer details
result.ListingId = get(listing, 'Id', '');
result.Availability = get(listing, 'Availability.Type', '');
result.MerchantName = get(listing, 'MerchantInfo.Name', '');
result.Condition = get(listing, 'Condition.Value', '');
result.DeliveryInfo = get(listing, 'DeliveryInfo.IsAmazonFulfilled', false) ? 'Prime' : 'Standard';

}

// ===== REVIEWS =====
const rating = get(item, 'CustomerReviews.StarRating.Value', '');
const reviewsCount = get(item, 'CustomerReviews.Count', 0);
result.Rating = rating;
result.ReviewsCount = reviewsCount;
result.HasReviews = reviewsCount > 0 ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';

// ===== PARENT ASIN =====
const parentAsin = get(item, 'ParentASIN', '');
result.ParentAsin = parentAsin;
result.HasParent = parentAsin ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';
result.IsVariant = parentAsin ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';

// ===== BROWSE NODES & BSR =====
const browseNodes = get(item, 'BrowseNodeInfo.BrowseNodes', []);
result.BrowseNodesCount = browseNodes.length;

if (browseNodes.length > 0) {
const node = browseNodes[0];
result.BrowseNodeId = get(node, 'Id', '');
result.BrowseNodeDisplayName = get(node, 'DisplayName', '');
result.BrowseNodeContextFreeName = get(node, 'ContextFreeName', '');

// Sales Rank from BrowseNode
if (node.SalesRank) {
  result.BestSellerRank = node.SalesRank;
  result.BestSellerRank1 = node.SalesRank;
  result.CategoryNumber = node.SalesRank;
}

}

// WebsiteSalesRank
const websiteRank = get(item, 'BrowseNodeInfo.WebsiteSalesRank', null);
if (websiteRank) {
result.BSRProductCategory = websiteRank.SalesRank;
result.BSRProductCategoryName = websiteRank.DisplayValue;
if (!result.BestSellerRank) {
result.BestSellerRank = websiteRank.SalesRank;
}
}

// ===== CATEGORY NAME =====
if (browseNodes.length > 0) {
result.CategoryName = browseNodes[0].DisplayName;
}

// ===== FETCH TIMESTAMP =====
const now = new Date();
result.FetchDate = Utilities.formatDate(now, 'GMT+1', 'yyyy-MM-dd');
result.FetchTime = Utilities.formatDate(now, 'GMT+1', 'HH:mm:ss');
result.FetchYear = Utilities.formatDate(now, 'GMT+1', 'yyyy');
result.FetchMonth = Utilities.formatDate(now, 'GMT+1', 'MM');
result.FetchDay = Utilities.formatDate(now, 'GMT+1', 'dd');
result.FetchTimeEpoch = now.getTime();
result.FetchTimeMS = now.getTime();
result.fetchTimestamp = now.getTime();
result.Timestamp_Research = Utilities.formatDate(now, 'GMT+1', 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm');

// ===== MARKETPLACE & URLS =====
result.Marketplace = 'www.amazon.de';
result.Link = https://www.amazon.de/dp/${result.ASIN};
result.ProductUrl = result.Link;
result.Url = result.Link;
result.MobileUrl = https://www.amazon.de/gp/aw/d/${result.ASIN};
result.ShortUrl = https://amzn.to/${result.ASIN};

// Apply determineMainCategory
result = determineMainCategory(result, item, 'de');

// ===== DUPLICATE FIELDS FOR COMPATIBILITY =====
result.best_seller_main_rank = result.BestSellerRank;
result.best_seller_rank_1 = result.BestSellerRank1;
result.binding = result.Binding;
result.brand_name = result.BrandName;
result.browse_node_id = result.BrowseNodeId;
result.category_name = result.CategoryName;
result.color_name = result.ColorName;
result.currency = result.PriceCurrency;
result.featured_image_source = result.FeaturedImageSource;
result.has_coupon = result.HasCoupon;
result.has_deal = result.HasDeal;
result.image_0_source = result.Image0Source;
result.image_1_source = result.Image1Source;
result.images_sources = result.VariantLargeImagesUrls;
result.link = result.Link;
result.lowest_category_sales_rank = result.LowestCategorySalesRank;
result.model_number = result.Model;
result.parent_asin = result.ParentAsin;
result.part_number = result.PartNumber;
result.price = result.Price;
result.product_group = result.ProductGroup;
result.size_name = result.SizeName;
result.unit_count = result.UnitCount;

return result;
}

/**

Call Amazon Product Advertising API 5.0
✅ FIXED: Pass operation parameter for correct signature
@param {string} operation - API operation (GetItems, SearchItems)
@param {object} payload - Request payload
@param {string} marketplaceCode - Marketplace code (de, uk, us, fr, it, es, pl)
*/
function callPaApi(operation, payload, marketplaceCode = 'de') {
const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
const marketplaceConfig = getMarketplaceConfig(marketplaceCode);

let partnerTag = props.getProperty(marketplaceConfig.partnerTagProperty);
if (!partnerTag) {
partnerTag = props.getProperty('PA_PARTNER_TAG');
Logger.log(⚠️ No specific Partner Tag found for ${marketplaceCode}, using default PA_PARTNER_TAG);
} else {
Logger.log(✓ Using marketplace-specific Partner Tag: ${marketplaceConfig.partnerTagProperty});
}

const host = marketplaceConfig.host;
const path = '/paapi5/getitems';
const region = marketplaceConfig.region;
const service = 'ProductAdvertisingAPI';

payload.PartnerTag = partnerTag;
payload.PartnerType = 'Associates';
payload.Marketplace = marketplaceConfig.domain;

const payloadString = JSON.stringify(payload);

Logger.log(🌍 PA-API Request: ${operation} to ${marketplaceConfig.domain});
Logger.log( Host: ${host});
Logger.log( Region: ${region});
Logger.log( Partner Tag Property: ${marketplaceConfig.partnerTagProperty});
Logger.log( Partner Tag: ${partnerTag ? partnerTag.substring(0, 10) + '...' : 'NOT FOUND'});

// ✅ CRITICAL FIX: Pass operation parameter to signature function
const authHeaders = generateAwsSignature('POST', host, path, '', payloadString, region, service, operation);

const options = {
method: 'post',
contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
headers: {
'Content-Encoding': 'amz-1.0',
'X-Amz-Target': com.amazon.paapi5.v1.ProductAdvertisingAPIv1.${operation},
...authHeaders
},
payload: payloadString,
muteHttpExceptions: true
};

const url = https://${host}${path};
const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, options);
const responseCode = response.getResponseCode();

if (responseCode !== 200) {
const errorText = response.getContentText();
Logger.log(PA-API Error (${marketplaceConfig.domain}): ${responseCode} - ${errorText});

if (errorText.includes('AssociateValidationException') || errorText.includes('InvalidAssociate')) {
  const helpfulError = `

❌ BŁĄD AUTORYZACJI AMAZON ASSOCIATES (${marketplaceConfig.domain})

Twoje klucze PA-API nie są zarejestrowane dla marketplace ${marketplaceCode.toUpperCase()}.

KOD BŁĘDU: ${responseCode} - InvalidAssociate

CO TO ZNACZY:
Każdy marketplace Amazon wymaga OSOBNEGO konta Amazon Associates.
Obecnie masz konto dla Amazon.de, ale nie dla ${marketplaceConfig.domain}.

JAK NAPRAWIĆ:

OPCJA 1: Zarejestruj się w Amazon Associates dla ${marketplaceCode.toUpperCase()}

Przejdź do: ${marketplaceConfig.associatesCentralUrl}
Zarejestruj się lub zaloguj
Skopiuj swój Partner Tag (Associate Tag) dla ${marketplaceCode.toUpperCase()}
Dodaj do Script Properties:
Klucz: ${marketplaceConfig.partnerTagProperty}
Wartość: [twój partner tag dla ${marketplaceCode.toUpperCase()}]
OPCJA 2: Użyj tylko marketplace które masz
Zmień w INPUT kolumnę Marketplace na: de (lub inny marketplace gdzie masz konto)

AKTUALNE KONFIGURACJE:
Extensions > Apps Script > Project Settings > Script Properties

Potrzebne właściwości dla wszystkich marketplace:

PA_PARTNER_TAG_DE (Amazon.de) - masz ✓
PA_PARTNER_TAG_UK (Amazon.co.uk)
PA_PARTNER_TAG_US (Amazon.com)
PA_PARTNER_TAG_FR (Amazon.fr)
PA_PARTNER_TAG_IT (Amazon.it)
PA_PARTNER_TAG_ES (Amazon.es)
PA_PARTNER_TAG_PL (Amazon.pl)
Dokumentacja: https://webservices.amazon.com/paapi5/documentation/register-for-pa-api.html
`;
throw new Error(helpfulError);
}

throw new Error(`PA-API Error (${marketplaceConfig.domain}): ${responseCode} - ${errorText}`);

}

return JSON.parse(response.getContentText());
}

/**

Fetch product data from Amazon PA-API with ALL available fields
Uses 4 Resource Groups with retry logic for maximum data extraction
✅ FIXED: ALWAYS creates NEW ROW (never overwrites) - tracks changes over time
@param {string} asin - Product ASIN
@param {string} asinType - "Główny" or "Podobny"
@param {string} relatedToAsin - For Podobny products, ASIN of main product
@param {string} marketplaceCode - Marketplace code (de, uk, us, fr, it, es, pl)
*/
function fetchProductData(asin, asinType = 'Główny', relatedToAsin = '', marketplaceCode = 'de') {
Logger.log(Fetching product data for ${asin} (${asinType}) - marketplace: ${marketplaceCode}...);
// Define 4 Resource Groups with optional flag
const resourceGroups = [
{
name: 'Podstawowe informacje i obrazy',
resources: [
'ItemInfo.Title',
'ItemInfo.ByLineInfo',
'ItemInfo.Features',
'ItemInfo.ProductInfo',
'ItemInfo.ManufactureInfo',
'ItemInfo.ExternalIds',
'ItemInfo.Classifications',
'ItemInfo.ContentInfo',
'ItemInfo.ContentRating',
'ItemInfo.TechnicalInfo',
'ItemInfo.TradeInInfo',
'Images.Primary.Small',
'Images.Primary.Medium',
'Images.Primary.Large',
'Images.Variants.Small',
'Images.Variants.Medium',
'Images.Variants.Large',
'ParentASIN'
],
optional: false
},
{
name: 'Informacje o ofercie',
resources: [
'Offers.Listings.Price',
'Offers.Listings.SavingBasis',
'Offers.Listings.Promotions'
],
optional: false
},
{
name: 'Kategorie i rankingi',
resources: [
'BrowseNodeInfo.BrowseNodes',
'BrowseNodeInfo.BrowseNodes.Ancestor',
'BrowseNodeInfo.BrowseNodes.SalesRank',
'BrowseNodeInfo.WebsiteSalesRank'
],
optional: false
},
{
name: 'Recenzje',
resources: [
'CustomerReviews.Count',
'CustomerReviews.StarRating'
],
optional: true
}
];

const collectedItems = [];

try {
// Fetch each Resource Group with retry logic
for (let i = 0; i < resourceGroups.length; i++) {
const group = resourceGroups[i];
Logger.log(Fetching group ${i+1}/${resourceGroups.length}: ${group.name}...);

  const payload = {
    ItemIds: [asin],
    Resources: group.resources
  };

  let attempt = 0;
  const maxRetries = 1;
  let success = false;

  while (attempt <= maxRetries && !success) {
    try {
      const response = callPaApi('GetItems', payload, marketplaceCode);

      if (response.ItemsResult && response.ItemsResult.Items && response.ItemsResult.Items.length > 0) {
        collectedItems.push(response.ItemsResult.Items[0]);
        Logger.log(`✓ Group ${i+1} fetched successfully`);
        success = true;
      } else if (!group.optional) {
        throw new Error(`No data returned for required group: ${group.name}`);
      } else {
        Logger.log(`⚠ Optional group ${group.name} returned no data, continuing...`);
        success = true;
      }

    } catch (error) {
      attempt++;

      if (error.message.includes('429') && attempt <= maxRetries) {
        const sleepTime = 2000 * attempt;
        Logger.log(`⚠ Rate limit hit for group ${group.name}, waiting ${sleepTime}ms before retry...`);
        Utilities.sleep(sleepTime);
      } else if (group.optional) {
        Logger.log(`⚠ Optional group ${group.name} failed: ${error.message}, continuing...`);
        success = true;
      } else if (attempt > maxRetries) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to fetch required group ${group.name} after ${maxRetries} retries: ${error.message}`);
      } else {
        throw error;
      }
    }
  }

  if (i < resourceGroups.length - 1) {
    Utilities.sleep(500);
  }
}

if (collectedItems.length === 0) {
  throw new Error('No product data collected from any resource group');
}

Logger.log(`Merging ${collectedItems.length} resource groups...`);
const item = mergeProductItems(collectedItems);

// Initialize result object with ASIN info
let result = {
  ASIN: asin,
  ASIN_Type: asinType,
  Related_To_ASIN: relatedToAsin
};

// Process all extended product data (200+ fields)
Logger.log('Processing extended product data (200+ fields)...');
result = processExtendedProductData(item, result);

// Build row data array matching all headers from getResearchHeaders()
const headers = getResearchHeaders();
const rowData = new Array(headers.length).fill('');

// Map result object to rowData array
for (let i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
  const header = headers[i];
  if (result.hasOwnProperty(header)) {
    rowData[i] = result[header] !== undefined && result[header] !== null ? result[header] : '';
  }
}

// ✅ FIXED: ALWAYS CREATE NEW ROW (never overwrite)
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('RESEARCH');
const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
const newRow = lastRow + 1;

sheet.getRange(newRow, 1, 1, rowData.length).setValues([rowData]);

Logger.log(`✅ NEW ROW #${newRow}: Product data saved for ${asin} (${asinType}) - ${Object.keys(result).length} fields processed`);
return item;

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Error fetching product data: ${error.message});
throw error;
}
}

/**

Find similar/competitor products and save them as separate rows
@param {string} mainAsin - Main product ASIN
@param {number} count - Number of similar products to find (default: 3)
*/
function findSimilarProducts(mainAsin, count = 3, marketplaceCode = 'de') {
Logger.log(Finding ${count} similar products for ${mainAsin} in marketplace ${marketplaceCode}...);
try {
// Get main product title from RESEARCH to use as search keywords
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('RESEARCH');
const mainRow = findRow(sheet, mainAsin);
const headers = getResearchHeaders();
const titleIdx = headers.indexOf('Title');
const title = sheet.getRange(mainRow, titleIdx + 1).getValue();

if (!title) {
  throw new Error('Main product must be fetched first (no title found)');
}

// Use first 3-4 words from title as search keywords
const keywords = title.split(' ').slice(0, 4).join(' ');
Logger.log(`Searching with keywords: ${keywords}`);

const payload = {
  Keywords: keywords,
  SearchIndex: 'All',
  ItemCount: count + 2,  // Get a few extra in case main product is in results
  Resources: [
    'ItemInfo.Title',
    'ItemInfo.ByLineInfo',
    'Offers.Listings.Price',
    'CustomerReviews.StarRating'
  ]
};

const response = callPaApi('SearchItems', payload, marketplaceCode);

if (!response.SearchResult || !response.SearchResult.Items) {
  Logger.log('⚠️ No similar products found');
  return [];
}

// Filter out main product and get top N
const similarAsins = response.SearchResult.Items
  .filter(item => item.ASIN !== mainAsin)
  .slice(0, count)
  .map(item => item.ASIN);

Logger.log(`Found ${similarAsins.length} similar products: ${similarAsins.join(', ')}`);

// Fetch full data for each similar product
const results = [];
for (const similarAsin of similarAsins) {
  try {
    Logger.log(`Fetching data for similar product: ${similarAsin}...`);
    fetchProductData(similarAsin, 'Podobny', mainAsin);
    results.push(similarAsin);
  } catch (error) {
    Logger.log(`⚠️ Error fetching similar product ${similarAsin}: ${error.message}`);
  }
}

Logger.log(`✅ Successfully fetched ${results.length} similar products`);
return results;

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Error finding similar products: ${error.message});
return [];
}
}

Analyze reviews (placeholder - PA-API doesn't provide review text)

/**

Process ALL selected rows (even if ASIN repeats)
Call this from menu or manually
*/
function processAllSelectedRows() {
const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
try {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();

if (sheet.getName() !== 'INPUT') {
  ui.alert('⚠️ Error', 'Please select rows in the INPUT sheet', ui.ButtonSet.OK);
  return;
}

// Get selected range
const activeRange = sheet.getActiveRange();
if (!activeRange) {
  ui.alert('⚠️ Error', 'No rows selected', ui.ButtonSet.OK);
  return;
}

const startRow = activeRange.getRow();
const numRows = activeRange.getNumRows();

// Collect selected rows (skip header)
const selectedRows = [];
for (let row = startRow; row < startRow + numRows; row++) {
  if (row > 1) { // Skip header
    selectedRows.push(row);
  }
}

if (selectedRows.length === 0) {
  ui.alert('⚠️ Error', 'No data rows selected (only header)', ui.ButtonSet.OK);
  return;
}

// Confirm
const response = ui.alert(
  '🚀 Process Selected Rows',
  `Process ${selectedRows.length} selected rows?\n\nThis will fetch fresh data even if ASIN was already processed.`,
  ui.ButtonSet.YES_NO
);

if (response !== ui.Button.YES) {
  return;
}

// Process each row
let processed = 0;
let successful = 0;
let failed = 0;

for (const rowIndex of selectedRows) {
  const asin = sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 1).getValue(); // Column A: ASIN

  if (!asin || asin.trim() === '') {
    Logger.log(`Skipping row ${rowIndex} - empty ASIN`);
    continue;
  }

  Logger.log(`Processing row ${rowIndex}: ${asin}...`);

  try {
    const result = processASINRowAllowDuplicates(asin, rowIndex);
    if (result) {
      successful++;
    } else {
      failed++;
    }
    processed++;

    // Delay between rows to avoid rate limits
    Utilities.sleep(2000);

  } catch (error) {
    Logger.log(`Error in row ${rowIndex}: ${error.message}`);
    failed++;
    processed++;
  }
}

// Show summary
ui.alert(
  '✅ Processing Complete',
  `Processed: ${processed}\nSuccessful: ${successful}\nFailed: ${failed}`,
  ui.ButtonSet.OK
);

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(Error in processAllSelectedRows: ${error.message});
ui.alert('❌ Error', error.message, ui.ButtonSet.OK);
}
}

/**

OLD FIXED VERSION - Process ASIN row even if it was processed before

USE THIS instead of original function to allow duplicate ASIN processing
/
/*

✅ FIXED - Process ASIN from SPECIFIC ROW (not by searching ASIN)

Reads marketplace and all data from the actual selected row
*/
function processASINRowAllowDuplicates(asin, rowIndex) {
try {
Logger.log(=== PROCESSING ASIN: ${asin} (Row ${rowIndex}) - DUPLICATE ALLOWED ===);

const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();

// ✅ FIX: Read data from THIS SPECIFIC ROW (not by searching ASIN)
const inputData = {
asin: sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 1).getValue(),
status: sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 2).getValue(),
marketplace: sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 3).getValue() || 'de',
brand: sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 4).getValue(),
productType: sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 5).getValue(),
clientEmail: sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 6).getValue(),
additionalNotes: sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 7).getValue(),
language: sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 13).getValue() || 'DE'
};

Logger.log(📍 Row ${rowIndex} data: ASIN=${inputData.asin}, Marketplace=${inputData.marketplace}, Language=${inputData.language});

// Step 1: Update status to PROCESSING
sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 2).setValue('PROCESSING');
sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 8).setValue(Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm'));

// Step 2: Fetch product data (ALWAYS creates NEW ROW in RESEARCH)
Logger.log(Step 1: Fetching product data for ${asin} (marketplace: ${inputData.marketplace})...);
fetchProductData(asin, 'Główny', '', inputData.marketplace);

// Step 3: Find similar products (ALWAYS)
Logger.log(Step 2: Finding similar products for ${asin}...);
findSimilarProducts(asin, 3, inputData.marketplace);

// Step 4: Generate Grok prompt (ALWAYS)
Logger.log(Step 3: Generating Grok prompt for ${asin}...);
generateGrokPrompt(asin);

// Update status to READY_FOR_GROK
sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 2).setValue('READY_FOR_GROK');
sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 9).setValue(Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm'));

Logger.log(✅ ASIN ${asin} processed successfully - ready for Grok);
return true;

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Error processing ASIN ${asin}: ${error.message});
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();
sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 2).setValue('ERROR');
sheet.getRange(rowIndex, 11).setValue(error.message);
return false;
}
}

}
}

/**

Generate comprehensive prompt for Grok with full product data and competition insights
*/
function generateGrokPrompt(asin) {
Logger.log(Generating Grok prompt for ${asin}...);
const inputData = getInputData(asin);
const mainProduct = getFullResearchData(asin);

if (!mainProduct) {
throw new Error(No research data found for ASIN ${asin}. Please fetch product data first.);
}

// Get marketplace and language configuration
const marketplaceCode = inputData.marketplace || 'de';
const marketplaceConfig = getMarketplaceConfig(marketplaceCode);
const languageCode = marketplaceConfig.language; // DE, EN, FR, etc.
const targetLanguage = getLanguageNameEnglish(languageCode); // German, English, French, etc.
const targetAudience = inputData.productType || 'Professional users & DIY enthusiasts';
Logger.log(Generating prompt for language: ${targetLanguage} (${languageCode}));

// Get similar/competitor products
const similarProducts = getSimilarProducts(asin);

// Build detailed competitor section
let competitorSection = '';
if (similarProducts.length > 0) {
competitorSection = '\n### Competitor Products Data:\n\n';
similarProducts.forEach((product, index) => {
competitorSection += **Competitor #${index + 1}: ${product.ASIN}**\n;
competitorSection += - Title: "${product.Title || 'N/A'}" (${product.TitleLength || 0} chars)\n;
competitorSection += - Title structure: First word="${product.TitleFirstWord || 'N/A'}", Last word="${product.TitleLastWord || 'N/A'}"\n;
competitorSection += - Brand: ${product.BrandName || 'N/A'}\n;
competitorSection += - BSR: ${product.BestSellerRank || 'N/A'} in ${product.CategoryName || 'N/A'}\n;
competitorSection += - Price: ${product.PriceFormatted || product.Price || 'N/A'}\n;
competitorSection += - Rating: ${product.Rating || 'N/A'} stars (${product.ReviewsCount || 0} reviews)\n;
competitorSection += - Images: ${product.TotalImagesCount || 'N/A'} total\n;
competitorSection += - Bullet Points (${product.FeaturesCount || 0} total, ${product.TotalFeaturesLength || 0} chars total, avg ${product.AvgFeatureLength || 0} chars):\n;

  for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
    const bullet = product[`BulletPoint${i}`];
    const bulletLength = product[`Feature${i}Length`];
    if (bullet) {
      competitorSection += `  ${i}. (${bulletLength || 0} chars) ${bullet.substring(0, 150)}${bullet.length > 150 ? '...' : ''}\n`;
    }
  }

  competitorSection += `- Has coupon/deal: Coupon=${product.HasCoupon || 'N/A'}, Deal=${product.HasDeal || 'N/A'}\n`;
  competitorSection += `\n`;
});

// Add strategic analysis section
competitorSection += `\n**Competitive Landscape Summary:**\n`;
const avgCompetitorTitleLength = similarProducts.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.TitleLength || 0), 0) / similarProducts.length;
const avgCompetitorBulletLength = similarProducts.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.AvgFeatureLength || 0), 0) / similarProducts.length;
competitorSection += `- Average competitor title length: ${Math.round(avgCompetitorTitleLength)} chars\n`;
competitorSection += `- Average competitor bullet length: ${Math.round(avgCompetitorBulletLength)} chars\n`;
competitorSection += `- Number of competitors analyzed: ${similarProducts.length}\n`;
competitorSection += `\n**Your strategic opportunity:** Current title is ${mainProduct.TitleLength || 0} chars vs competitor avg ${Math.round(avgCompetitorTitleLength)} chars. Current bullets avg ${mainProduct.AvgFeatureLength || 0} chars vs competitor avg ${Math.round(avgCompetitorBulletLength)} chars.\n\n`;

} else {
competitorSection = '\n### Competitor Products Data:\n\nNo competitor data available - search the web for top products in this category to analyze their approach.\n\n';
}

// Build images list
const imagesList = [];
if (mainProduct.FeaturedImageSource || mainProduct.Image0Source) imagesList.push(mainProduct.FeaturedImageSource || mainProduct.Image0Source);
for (let i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
const imgSrc = mainProduct[Image${i}Source];
if (imgSrc) imagesList.push(imgSrc);
}

// Build current bullets detailed section
let bulletsDetailed = '';
for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
const bullet = mainProduct[BulletPoint${i}] || mainProduct[Feature${i}];
const bulletLength = mainProduct[Feature${i}Length] || (bullet ? bullet.length : 0);
const bulletWords = mainProduct[Feature${i}Words] || (bullet ? bullet.split(' ').length : 0);

if (bullet) {
  bulletsDetailed += `${i}. ${bullet} (${bulletLength} chars, ${bulletWords} words)\n\n`;
}

}
if (!bulletsDetailed) {
bulletsDetailed = 'No bullets provided in current product data.\n';
}

// COMPACT PROMPT - References Knowledge Base for details
const prompt = `# AMAZON LISTING GENERATION - ${targetLanguage.toUpperCase()}

TASK: Create high-quality Amazon listing in ${targetLanguage} for Amazon.${marketplaceCode}

IMPORTANT: Check your Knowledge Base documents BEFORE writing:

KB_01: Amazon 2025 Compliance Rules
KB_02: Rufus AI Optimization
KB_03: Content Structure Guidelines
KB_04: Image & Media Strategy
KB_05: Marketplace-Specific Rules
KB_06: Advanced Grok Guidelines & Examples
🚨 CRITICAL RULES - READ FIRST!
BULLET LENGTH LIMITS (ULTRA-CRITICAL - RUTHLESSLY ENFORCED!)
🔥 MINIMUM: 260 characters per bullet
🔥 OPTIMAL: 260-320 characters per bullet (TARGET THIS RANGE!)
🔥 MAXIMUM: 350 characters per bullet (ABSOLUTE HARD LIMIT!!!)

CURRENT PROBLEM: You're writing 460-470 char bullets = WAY TOO LONG!
SOLUTION: Cut ALL fluff. One sentence = one benefit. NO repetitive phrasing!
TARGET: ~300 chars per bullet. Mobile users scroll past anything longer!

Other Critical Rules:
NO REPETITIONS IN BULLETS: Each bullet = UNIQUE argument! Don't repeat same benefits/features!
BRAND COMPATIBILITY (MANDATORY!): If mentioning other brands (Bosch, Makita, etc.), MUST include BOTH:
"kompatibel mit [Brand]" or "passt zu [Brand]"
"Kein offizielles [Brand]-Produkt, keine Verbindung zum Hersteller [Brand]"
Example: "...kompatibel mit Bosch, Makita und Einhell. Kein offizielles Bosch-Produkt, keine Verbindung zu den genannten Herstellern."
This bullet can be longer (max 400-500 chars) to accommodate disclaimer.
CERTIFICATES (textiles only): If OEKO-TEX or similar mentioned in data, include certificate number + expiry year.
Bullet 5: NEVER mention delivery/shipping/warranty (account closure risk!)
Keywords: 🚨 MAX 240 BYTES (HARD LIMIT! System rejects >250!) 🚨
Keywords: CURRENT PROBLEM: You write 270-320 bytes = AUTO-FAIL! Count UTF-8 bytes BEFORE submitting!
Keywords: German ä/ö/ü/ß = 2 bytes EACH! "Sägeblatt" = 11 bytes (not 10 chars!)
Keywords: Must be SYNONYMS and SEMANTIC CONTEXT - NOT different names for the same thing!
Keywords: Think: "What would customers type when searching?" Use variations, use cases, applications
Keywords: Example GOOD (187b): "Sägeblatt Holz Metall schneiden sägen Bosch Makita kompatibel Werkzeug"
Keywords: Example BAD (278b): "Sägeblatt Säbelsägeblatt Reciprosägeblatt Tigersägeblatt..." ❌ TOO LONG!
Description: Max 1800 chars INCLUDING HTML tags - AIM FOR 1650-1800 chars (longer = better for SEO and conversions!)
Title: 80-200 chars optimal (first 70-110 = mobile preview)
BSR: Use BOTH numbers (subcategory + main category) for analysis
Reviews: Ignore if N/A or 0 count
📊 PRODUCT DATA
Current Listing (Low Quality - Rewrite from scratch!)
Title: ${mainProduct.Title || 'No title'} (${mainProduct.TitleLength || 0} chars)

Bullets: (Avg ${mainProduct.AvgFeatureLength || 0} chars each)
${bulletsDetailed}

Images: ${mainProduct.TotalImagesCount || 0} total
${imagesList.slice(0, 3).map((url, i) => - ${url}).join('\n') || '- No images'}
${imagesList.length > 3 ? ... and ${imagesList.length - 3} more : ''}

Market Position
BSR Subcategory: ${mainProduct.BestSellerRank || 'N/A'} in ${mainProduct.CategoryName || 'N/A'}
BSR Main Category: ${mainProduct.BSRProductCategory || 'N/A'} (main indicator!)
Price: ${mainProduct.PriceFormatted || mainProduct.Price || 'N/A'}

Note: Rating/Reviews data NOT available from PA-API. Use competitor analysis + BSR for market insights.

Technical Specs
Dimensions: ${mainProduct.ItemLengthDisplayValue || 'N/A'} × ${mainProduct.ItemWidthDisplayValue || 'N/A'} × ${mainProduct.ItemHeightDisplayValue || 'N/A'}
Weight: ${mainProduct.ItemWeightDisplayValue || 'N/A'}
Brand: ${mainProduct.BrandName || 'N/A'}
Model: ${mainProduct.Model || 'N/A'}
Part #: ${mainProduct.PartNumber || 'N/A'}
EAN: ${mainProduct.PrimaryEAN || mainProduct.EAN || 'N/A'}
Color: ${mainProduct.ColorName || 'N/A'}
Size: ${mainProduct.SizeName || 'N/A'}
Competitors Analysis
${competitorSection}

🎯 OUTPUT FORMAT (JSON only!)
Return ONLY valid JSON. See full structure in Knowledge Base documents.

📌 ADDITIONAL NOTES FROM CLIENT:
${inputData.additionalNotes || 'No additional notes provided.'}
`;

// Write to GROK_PROMPT sheet
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('GROK_PROMPT');
const row = findOrCreateRow(sheet, asin);

sheet.getRange(row, 1).setValue(asin);
sheet.getRange(row, 2).setValue(prompt);
sheet.getRange(row, 3).setValue(`📋 INSTRUKCJE PO POLSKU:

✅ Skopiuj cały prompt z kolumny B (kliknij w komórkę i Ctrl+C)
🌐 Przejdź do Grok: https://grok.x.ai
📝 Wklej prompt do Groka
📄 (OPCJONALNIE) Dodaj reviews jako załącznik lub w czacie
⏳ Poczekaj na odpowiedź (może potrwać 1-3 minuty - Grok teraz robi research!)
📄 Skopiuj CAŁĄ odpowiedź JSON (razem z ```json i ```)
📊 Przejdź do zakładki OUTPUT
📋 Wklej do kolumny B (Grok_JSON_Input) w wierszu z tym samym ASIN
🚀 Uruchom z menu: "📝 Parse Grok Output"
UWAGA: Prompt teraz wymaga od Groka researchu przed pisaniem - to zajmie dłużej ale jakość będzie lepsza!`);
sheet.getRange(row, 4).setValue(Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm'));
sheet.getRange(row, 5).setValue(languageCode); // Column E: Language

// Auto-create row in OUTPUT sheet with ASIN and Language
const outputSheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('OUTPUT');
const outputRow = findOrCreateRow(outputSheet, asin);
outputSheet.getRange(outputRow, 1).setValue(asin); // Column A: ASIN
outputSheet.getRange(outputRow, 31).setValue(languageCode); // Column AE: Language
Logger.log(✅ Created OUTPUT row for ${asin} with language ${languageCode});

// Update status in INPUT
updateStatus(asin, 'READY_FOR_GROK');

Logger.log(✅ Grok prompt generated for ${asin});
}

// ============================================================================
// GROK OUTPUT PARSING
// ============================================================================

/**

Parse Grok JSON output and populate OUTPUT sheet
*/
function parseGrokOutput(asin) {
Logger.log(Parsing Grok output for ${asin}...);
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('OUTPUT');
const row = findRow(sheet, asin);

// Read JSON from column B (user pastes Grok output here)
const jsonText = sheet.getRange(row, 2).getValue();

if (!jsonText || jsonText.trim() === '') {
throw new Error('No Grok output found in OUTPUT sheet column B. Please paste Grok response first.');
}

try {
// Clean JSON - remove markdown code blocks if present
let cleanJson = jsonText.trim();
cleanJson = cleanJson.replace(/^json\s*/i, ''); cleanJson = cleanJson.replace(/^\s*/i, '');
cleanJson = cleanJson.replace(/\s*```$/i, '');
cleanJson = cleanJson.trim();

const data = JSON.parse(cleanJson);

// Collect validation warnings and errors
const errors = [];
const warnings = [];

// Validate required fields (hard errors)
if (!data.title_de) {
  errors.push('❌ Missing title_de in JSON');
}

if (!data.bullets || !Array.isArray(data.bullets) || data.bullets.length !== 5) {
  errors.push('❌ Must have exactly 5 bullets');
}

if (!data.description_html) {
  errors.push('❌ Missing description_html');
}

if (!data.keywords) {
  errors.push('❌ Missing keywords');
}

if (!data.infographics || data.infographics.length !== 5) {
  errors.push('❌ Must have exactly 5 infographics');
}

if (!data.video) {
  errors.push('❌ Missing video data');
}

if (!data.aplus_modules || data.aplus_modules.length === 0) {
  errors.push('❌ Must have at least 1 A+ module');
}

if (!data.brand_story) {
  errors.push('❌ Missing brand_story');
}

if (!data.brand_store_suggestions_pl) {
  errors.push('❌ Missing brand_store_suggestions_pl');
}

if (!data.compliance_check) {
  errors.push('❌ Missing compliance_check');
}

// If hard errors, stop immediately
if (errors.length > 0) {
  throw new Error('Validation failed:\n\n' + errors.join('\n'));
}

// Validate lengths (soft warnings - can be overridden)
if (data.title_de.length > 200) {
  warnings.push(`⚠️ Title too long: ${data.title_de.length} chars (max 200)`);
}
if (data.title_de.length < 80) {
  warnings.push(`⚠️ Title too short: ${data.title_de.length} chars (min 80)`);
}

// Validate bullet lengths
data.bullets.forEach((bullet, idx) => {
  if (bullet.length < 260) {
    warnings.push(`⚠️ Bullet ${idx + 1} too short: ${bullet.length} chars (min 260)`);
  } else if (bullet.length > 350) {
    warnings.push(`⚠️ Bullet ${idx + 1} too long: ${bullet.length} chars (max 350 HARD LIMIT)`);
  }
});

if (data.description_html.length > 1800) {
  warnings.push(`⚠️ Description too long: ${data.description_html.length} chars (max 1800 with HTML)`);
}

// Check keywords byte length
const keywordsBytes = Utilities.newBlob(data.keywords).getBytes().length;
if (keywordsBytes > 250) {
  warnings.push(`⚠️ Keywords too long: ${keywordsBytes} bytes (max 250 bytes)`);
}

// If warnings, ask user if they want to proceed
if (warnings.length > 0) {
  const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
  const warningMessage = `⚠️ VALIDATION WARNINGS:\n\n${warnings.join('\n')}\n\n` +
    `These texts may be rejected by Amazon or perform poorly.\n\n` +
    `Do you want to ACCEPT and continue anyway?`;

  const response = ui.alert(
    '⚠️ Validation Warnings',
    warningMessage,
    ui.ButtonSet.YES_NO
  );

  if (response !== ui.Button.YES) {
    throw new Error('❌ Parsing cancelled by user due to validation warnings');
  }

  Logger.log('⚠️ User accepted validation warnings, proceeding...');
}

// All validation passed - populate OUTPUT sheet
Logger.log('✅ Validation passed, populating OUTPUT sheet...');

// Column C: Title
sheet.getRange(row, 3).setValue(data.title_de);

// Columns D-H: Bullets
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
  sheet.getRange(row, 4 + i).setValue(data.bullets[i]);
}

// Column I: Description HTML
sheet.getRange(row, 9).setValue(data.description_html);

// Column J: Keywords
sheet.getRange(row, 10).setValue(data.keywords);

// Columns K-T: Infographics (text_de and instructions_pl pairs)
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
  const infog = data.infographics[i];
  sheet.getRange(row, 11 + (i * 2)).setValue(infog.text_de);
  sheet.getRange(row, 12 + (i * 2)).setValue(infog.instructions_pl);
}

// Columns U-V: Video
sheet.getRange(row, 21).setValue(data.video.text_de);
sheet.getRange(row, 22).setValue(data.video.instructions_pl);

// Columns W-Z: A+ Modules (store as JSON strings)
for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(4, data.aplus_modules.length); i++) {
  sheet.getRange(row, 23 + i).setValue(JSON.stringify(data.aplus_modules[i]));
}

// Column AA: Brand Story
sheet.getRange(row, 27).setValue(data.brand_story);

// Column AB: Brand Store Suggestions
sheet.getRange(row, 28).setValue(data.brand_store_suggestions_pl);

// Column AC: Compliance Check
const complianceStatus = data.compliance_check.status === 'PASS' ? '✅ PASS' : '❌ FAIL';
const complianceText = `${complianceStatus}\n\n${data.compliance_check.notes || ''}`;
sheet.getRange(row, 29).setValue(complianceText);

// Update status to AWAITING_DOC
updateStatus(asin, 'AWAITING_DOC');

Logger.log(`✅ Grok output parsed successfully for ${asin}`);
return data;

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Parse error: ${error.message});
updateStatus(asin, 'ERROR', Parse Error: ${error.message});
throw error;
}
}

/**

Get spreadsheet ID from properties
*/
function getSpreadsheetId() {
return PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
}
/**

Find row number by ASIN
*/
function findRow(sheet, asin) {
const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
if (data[i][0] === asin) {
return i + 1;
}
}
throw new Error(ASIN ${asin} not found in sheet ${sheet.getName()});
}
/**

Find or create row by ASIN
*/
function findOrCreateRow(sheet, asin) {
try {
return findRow(sheet, asin);
} catch (e) {
// Add new row
const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
const newRow = lastRow + 1;
sheet.getRange(newRow, 1).setValue(asin);

// Format new row: set height and alignment
formatRow(sheet, newRow);

return newRow;
}
}

/**

Format row: set height to 80px and alignment to top-left
*/
function formatRow(sheet, row) {
// Set row height to 80px (between 50-100px as requested)
sheet.setRowHeight(row, 80);
// Get all columns in the row and set alignment to top-left
const lastCol = sheet.getLastColumn();
if (lastCol > 0) {
const range = sheet.getRange(row, 1, 1, lastCol);
range.setVerticalAlignment('top');
range.setHorizontalAlignment('left');
}
}

/**

Get selected ASIN from active cell
*/
function getSelectedAsin() {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();
const row = sheet.getActiveCell().getRow();
if (row < 2) return null;
return sheet.getRange(row, 1).getValue();
}
/**

Update status in INPUT sheet
*/
function updateStatus(asin, status, errorMsg = '') {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('INPUT');
const row = findRow(sheet, asin);
sheet.getRange(row, 2).setValue(status); // Column B: Status

if (status === 'PROCESSING' && sheet.getRange(row, 8).getValue() === '') {
sheet.getRange(row, 8).setValue(Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm')); // Timestamp_Started
}

if (status === 'COMPLETE') {
sheet.getRange(row, 9).setValue(Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm')); // Timestamp_Completed
}

if (errorMsg) {
sheet.getRange(row, 11).setValue(errorMsg); // Error_Log
}
}

/**

Save output URLs to OUTPUT sheet
Columns: AE=Language, AF=Title_Short_Lang, AG=Title_Short_PL, AH=Doc_URL, AI=PDF_URL, AJ=Client_Sheet_URL, AK=Flat_File_URL
*/
function saveOutputUrl(asin, type, url) {
const outputSheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('OUTPUT');
const row = findRow(outputSheet, asin);
// Determine which column to update
let column;
switch(type) {
case 'doc':
column = 34; // AH (was AF, shifted +2)
break;
case 'pdf':
column = 35; // AI (was AG, shifted +2)
break;
case 'client':
column = 36; // AJ (was AH, shifted +2)
break;
case 'flatfile':
column = 37; // AK (was AI, shifted +2)
break;
default:
Logger.log(Unknown URL type: ${type});
return;
}

outputSheet.getRange(row, column).setValue(url);
Logger.log(Saved ${type} URL to OUTPUT column ${column});
}
