/**

Parse Grok JSON output and populate OUTPUT sheet
*/
function parseGrokOutput(asin) {
Logger.log(Parsing Grok output for ${asin}...);
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('OUTPUT');
const row = findRow(sheet, asin);

// Get language code from OUTPUT sheet (column 31 = AE = Language)
const languageCode = (sheet.getRange(row, 31).getValue() || 'DE').toLowerCase();
Logger.log(Parsing JSON for language: ${languageCode});

// Read JSON from column B (user pastes Grok output here)
const jsonText = sheet.getRange(row, 2).getValue();

if (!jsonText || jsonText.trim() === '') {
throw new Error('No Grok output found in OUTPUT sheet column B. Please paste Grok response first.');
}

try {
// Clean JSON - remove markdown code blocks if present
let cleanJson = jsonText.trim();
cleanJson = cleanJson.replace(/^json\s*/i, ''); cleanJson = cleanJson.replace(/^\s*/i, '');
cleanJson = cleanJson.replace(/\s*```$/i, '');
cleanJson = cleanJson.trim();

const data = JSON.parse(cleanJson);

// Build dynamic title key
const titleKey = `title_${languageCode}`;
const textKey = `text_${languageCode}`;
const headerKey = `header_${languageCode}`;
const contentKey = `content_${languageCode}`;

// Validate required fields with dynamic language code
if (!data[titleKey]) {
  throw new Error(`Missing ${titleKey} in JSON (expected for language ${languageCode})`);
}
if (data[titleKey].length > 200) {
  throw new Error(`Title too long: ${data[titleKey].length} chars (max 200)`);
}
if (data[titleKey].length < 80) {
  throw new Error(`Title too short: ${data[titleKey].length} chars (min 80)`);
}

if (!data.bullets || !Array.isArray(data.bullets) || data.bullets.length !== 5) {
  throw new Error('Must have exactly 5 bullets');
}

// Validate bullet lengths
data.bullets.forEach((bullet, idx) => {
  if (bullet.length < 350 || bullet.length > 480) {
    Logger.log(`⚠️ Warning: Bullet ${idx + 1} length ${bullet.length} (should be 350-480)`);
  }
});

if (!data.description_html) {
  throw new Error('Missing description_html');
}

if (!data.keywords) {
  throw new Error('Missing keywords');
}

// Check keywords byte length
const keywordsBytes = Utilities.newBlob(data.keywords).getBytes().length;
if (keywordsBytes > 250) {
  const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
  const response = ui.alert(
    '⚠️ Keywords zu lang',
    `Keywords haben ${keywordsBytes} Bytes (max 250).\n\nMöchten Sie trotzdem fortfahren?\n\n` +
    `JA = Fortfahren (Keywords werden gespeichert)\n` +
    `NEIN = Abbrechen (bitte Keywords in Grok kürzen)`,
    ui.ButtonSet.YES_NO
  );

  if (response === ui.Button.NO) {
    throw new Error(`Keywords too long: ${keywordsBytes} bytes (max 250). Bitte kürzen und erneut parsen.`);
  }

  Logger.log(`⚠️ WARNING: Keywords ${keywordsBytes} bytes (max 250) - User chose to continue`);
}

if (!data.infographics || data.infographics.length !== 5) {
  throw new Error('Must have exactly 5 infographics');
}

if (!data.video) {
  throw new Error('Missing video data');
}

if (!data.aplus_modules || data.aplus_modules.length === 0) {
  throw new Error('Must have at least 1 A+ module');
}

if (!data.brand_story) {
  throw new Error('Missing brand_story');
}

if (!data.brand_store_suggestions_pl) {
  throw new Error('Missing brand_store_suggestions_pl');
}

if (!data.compliance_check) {
  throw new Error('Missing compliance_check');
}

// All validation passed - populate OUTPUT sheet
Logger.log('✅ Validation passed, populating OUTPUT sheet...');

// Column C: Title (dynamic language)
sheet.getRange(row, 3).setValue(data[titleKey]);

// Columns D-H: Bullets
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
  sheet.getRange(row, 4 + i).setValue(data.bullets[i]);
}

// Column I: Description HTML
sheet.getRange(row, 9).setValue(data.description_html);

// Column J: Keywords
sheet.getRange(row, 10).setValue(data.keywords);

// Columns K-T: Infographics (text_{lang} and instructions_pl pairs)
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
  const infog = data.infographics[i];
  sheet.getRange(row, 11 + (i * 2)).setValue(infog[textKey]);
  sheet.getRange(row, 12 + (i * 2)).setValue(infog.instructions_pl);
}

// Columns U-V: Video
sheet.getRange(row, 21).setValue(data.video[textKey]);
sheet.getRange(row, 22).setValue(data.video.instructions_pl);

// Columns W-Z: A+ Modules (store as JSON strings)
for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(4, data.aplus_modules.length); i++) {
  sheet.getRange(row, 23 + i).setValue(JSON.stringify(data.aplus_modules[i]));
}

// Column AA: Brand Story
sheet.getRange(row, 27).setValue(data.brand_story);

// Column AB: Brand Store Suggestions
sheet.getRange(row, 28).setValue(data.brand_store_suggestions_pl);

// Column AC: Compliance Check
const complianceStatus = data.compliance_check.status === 'PASS' ? '✅ PASS' : '❌ FAIL';
const complianceText = `${complianceStatus}\n\n${data.compliance_check.notes || ''}`;
sheet.getRange(row, 29).setValue(complianceText);

// Column AD: Title PL
sheet.getRange(row, 30).setValue(data.title_pl || '');

// Column AF: Title Short (language-specific) - NEW
const titleShortKey = `title_short_${languageCode}`;
sheet.getRange(row, 32).setValue(data[titleShortKey] || '');

// Column AG: Title Short PL - NEW
sheet.getRange(row, 33).setValue(data.title_short_pl || '');

// Update status to AWAITING_DOC
updateStatus(asin, 'AWAITING_DOC');

Logger.log(`✅ Grok output parsed successfully for ${asin}`);
return data;

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Parse error: ${error.message});
updateStatus(asin, 'ERROR', Parse Error: ${error.message});
throw error;
}
}

// ============================================================================
// GOOGLE DOC GENERATION
// ============================================================================

/**

Create Google Doc from template with listing content
*/
function createGoogleDoc(asin) {
Logger.log(Creating Google Doc from template for ${asin}...);
try {
const data = getOutputData(asin);

// Template ID
const TEMPLATE_ID = '1ASg9otLOdisvTg-vnjtCfyTHSNXoJQ8WR_agHI9krFc';

const language = data.language || 'DE';
const sellerName = (data.brand || 'WERHE');
const datePart = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'yyyy-MM-dd');

// Use title_short from data (generated by AI), or fallback to first 5 words
let titleShortLang = data.titleShortDE || data.titleShortFR || data.titleShortIT || data.titleShortES || '';
let titleShortPL = data.titleShortPL || '';

// Check if values are URLs (old data from before Setup Sheets) - use fallback
const isURL = (str) => str && (str.includes('http') || str.includes('docs.google') || str.includes('drive.google'));

if (!titleShortLang || isURL(titleShortLang)) {
  titleShortLang = data.titleDE.split(' ').slice(0, 5).join(' ');
  Logger.log(`Using fallback for titleShortLang in doc name: ${titleShortLang}`);
}
if (!titleShortPL || isURL(titleShortPL)) {
  titleShortPL = data.titlePL ? data.titlePL.split(' ').slice(0, 5).join(' ') : titleShortLang;
  Logger.log(`Using fallback for titleShortPL in doc name: ${titleShortPL}`);
}

// Clean titles but KEEP original characters (ä, ö, ü, ß, é, etc.)
titleShortLang = titleShortLang.replace(/[^\wäöüßÄÖÜéèêëàâçùûîôæœÉÈÊËÀÂÇÙÛÎÔÆŒ\s-]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '-');
titleShortPL = titleShortPL.replace(/[^\wąćęłńóśźżĄĆĘŁŃÓŚŹŻ\s-]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '-');

// Format: ASIN-[ASIN]-[Language]-[titleLANGshort]-[titlePLshort]-[sellername]-OPIS-PRODUKTU-[Date]
const docName = `ASIN-${asin}-${language}-${titleShortLang}-${titleShortPL}-${sellerName}-OPIS-PRODUKTU-${datePart}`;

// Step 1: Copy template with temporary name (working document)
Logger.log(`Step 1: Copying template as working document...`);
const templateFile = DriveApp.getFileById(TEMPLATE_ID);
const workingFile = templateFile.makeCopy(`TEMP-WORKING-${asin}-${Date.now()}`);
const workingDocId = workingFile.getId();
const workingDoc = DocumentApp.openById(workingDocId);
const body = workingDoc.getBody();

Logger.log(`Step 2: Replacing placeholders in working document...`);

// Prepare A+ modules text
let aplusTexts = ['', '', '', ''];
if (data.aplusModules && data.aplusModules.length > 0) {
  data.aplusModules.forEach((moduleJson, idx) => {
    if (!moduleJson || idx >= 4) return;
    try {
      const module = typeof moduleJson === 'string' ? JSON.parse(moduleJson) : moduleJson;
      let moduleText = `MODUL ${idx + 1}: ${module.module_type || 'Custom'}\n`;
      if (module.header_de) moduleText += `HEADER: ${module.header_de}\n`;
      if (module.content_de) moduleText += `CONTENT: ${module.content_de}\n`;
      if (module.image_suggestions_pl) moduleText += `IMAGES (PL): ${module.image_suggestions_pl}`;
      aplusTexts[idx] = moduleText;
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.log(`Error parsing A+ module ${idx}: ${e.message}`);
    }
  });
}

// Replace all placeholders
body.replaceText('{{ASIN}}', asin);
body.replaceText('{{TITLE_DE}}', data.titleDE || '');
body.replaceText('{{TITLE_DE_SHORT}}', titleShortLang);  // Fixed: was titleDEshort (undefined)
body.replaceText('{{TITLE_SHORT_LANG}}', titleShortLang);  // New placeholder for language-specific short title
body.replaceText('{{TITLE_PL}}', data.titlePL || '');
body.replaceText('{{TITLE_PL_SHORT}}', titleShortPL);  // Fixed: was titlePLshort (undefined)
body.replaceText('{{TITLE_SHORT_PL}}', titleShortPL);  // New placeholder for Polish short title
body.replaceText('{{BULLET_1}}', data.bullets[0] || '');
body.replaceText('{{BULLET_2}}', data.bullets[1] || '');
body.replaceText('{{BULLET_3}}', data.bullets[2] || '');
body.replaceText('{{BULLET_4}}', data.bullets[3] || '');
body.replaceText('{{BULLET_5}}', data.bullets[4] || '');
body.replaceText('{{DESCRIPTION_HTML}}', data.descriptionHTML || '');
body.replaceText('{{KEYWORDS}}', data.keywords || '');

// Infographics
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
  const infog = data.infographics[i] || { textDE: '', instructionsPL: '' };
  body.replaceText(`{{IMAGE_${i + 1}_TEXT_DE}}`, infog.textDE || '');
  body.replaceText(`{{IMAGE_${i + 1}_INSTRUCTIONS_PL}}`, infog.instructionsPL || '');
}

// Video
body.replaceText('{{VIDEO_TEXT_DE}}', data.video?.textDE || '');
body.replaceText('{{VIDEO_INSTRUCTIONS_PL}}', data.video?.instructionsPL || '');

// A+ Modules
body.replaceText('{{APLUS_MODULE_1}}', aplusTexts[0]);
body.replaceText('{{APLUS_MODULE_2}}', aplusTexts[1]);
body.replaceText('{{APLUS_MODULE_3}}', aplusTexts[2]);
body.replaceText('{{APLUS_MODULE_4}}', aplusTexts[3]);

// Brand and other fields
body.replaceText('{{BRAND_STORY}}', data.brandStory || '');
body.replaceText('{{BRAND_STORE}}', data.brandStoreSuggestions || '');
// Language placeholder (both uppercase and lowercase versions)
body.replaceText('{{LANGUAGE}}', language);
body.replaceText('{{language}}', language);

// Step 3: Save working document
Logger.log(`Step 3: Saving working document...`);
workingDoc.saveAndClose();

// Wait a bit to ensure save completes
Utilities.sleep(1000);

// Step 4: Create clean copy with final name (no placeholder history!)
Logger.log(`Step 4: Creating clean copy with final name...`);
const finalFile = workingFile.makeCopy(docName);
const finalDocId = finalFile.getId();
const finalDocUrl = finalFile.getUrl();

// Step 4b: Move to LISTING_FILES folder
Logger.log(`Step 4b: Moving document to LISTING_FILES folder...`);
const targetFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(DRIVE_FOLDER_ID);
finalFile.moveTo(targetFolder);

// Step 5: Delete working document
Logger.log(`Step 5: Deleting working document...`);
DriveApp.getFileById(workingDocId).setTrashed(true);

// Step 6: Share final document
Logger.log(`Step 6: Sharing final document...`);
finalFile.setSharing(DriveApp.Access.ANYONE_WITH_LINK, DriveApp.Permission.COMMENT);

// Save Doc URL to INPUT sheet and OUTPUT sheet
updateDocUrl(asin, finalDocUrl);
saveOutputUrl(asin, 'doc', finalDocUrl);

Logger.log(`✅ Google Doc created (clean copy without placeholder history): ${finalDocUrl}`);
return { doc: DocumentApp.openById(finalDocId), url: finalDocUrl, id: finalDocId };

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Error creating Google Doc: ${error.message});
updateStatus(asin, 'ERROR', Doc Error: ${error.message});
throw error;
}
}

// ============================================================================
// PDF EXPORT
// ============================================================================

/**

Export Google Doc to PDF
*/
function exportToPDF(asin) {
Logger.log(Exporting PDF for ${asin}...);
try {
const docUrl = getDocUrl(asin);
if (!docUrl) {
throw new Error('No Google Doc URL found. Create document first.');
}

// Extract document ID from URL - support both formats:
// Format 1: https://docs.google.com/document/d/ID/edit
// Format 2: https://docs.google.com/open?id=ID
let docId;

const match1 = docUrl.match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
const match2 = docUrl.match(/[?&]id=([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);

if (match1) {
  docId = match1[1];
} else if (match2) {
  docId = match2[1];
} else {
  throw new Error(`Invalid document URL format: ${docUrl}`);
}

Logger.log(`Extracted doc ID: ${docId}`);

// Get the file and export as PDF
const file = DriveApp.getFileById(docId);
const pdfBlob = file.getAs('application/pdf');
pdfBlob.setName(`Amazon-Listing-${asin}.pdf`);

// Create PDF in root first, then move to LISTING_FILES folder
const rootFolder = DriveApp.getRootFolder();
const pdfFile = rootFolder.createFile(pdfBlob);

// Move to LISTING_FILES folder
const targetFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(DRIVE_FOLDER_ID);
pdfFile.moveTo(targetFolder);
Logger.log(`Moved PDF to LISTING_FILES folder`);

// Make publicly accessible
pdfFile.setSharing(DriveApp.Access.ANYONE_WITH_LINK, DriveApp.Permission.VIEW);

const pdfUrl = pdfFile.getUrl();
saveOutputUrl(asin, 'pdf', pdfUrl);

Logger.log(`✅ PDF exported: ${pdfUrl}`);

return { file: pdfFile, url: pdfUrl, id: pdfFile.getId() };

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Error exporting PDF: ${error.message});
updateStatus(asin, 'ERROR', PDF Error: ${error.message});
throw error;
}
}

SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('✅ Nagłówki dodane do arkusza AmazonTekstyProduktowe');
}

/**

Export listing data to client-facing spreadsheet
*/
function exportToClientSheet(asin) {
Logger.log(Exporting to client sheet for ${asin}...);
try {
const data = getOutputData(asin);
const docUrl = getDocUrl(asin);

// Client sheet ID
const CLIENT_SHEET_ID = '17hh_WDL8obwWVtz74CloUHpiKINn3BpclIAxqfg6kS0';
const CLIENT_SHEET_NAME = 'AmazonTekstyProduktowe';

// Open client spreadsheet
const clientSS = SpreadsheetApp.openById(CLIENT_SHEET_ID);
let clientSheet = clientSS.getSheetByName(CLIENT_SHEET_NAME);

// If sheet doesn't exist, use first sheet
if (!clientSheet) {
  clientSheet = clientSS.getSheets()[0];
  Logger.log(`⚠ Sheet "${CLIENT_SHEET_NAME}" not found, using first sheet: ${clientSheet.getName()}`);
}

// Prepare row data (adjust order based on client sheet structure)
const rowData = [
  Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm'), // Date
  asin,                           // ASIN
  data.brand || '',               // Brand
  data.productType || '',         // Product Type
  data.language || '',            // Language
  data.titleDE || '',             // Title DE
  data.bullets[0] || '',          // Bullet 1
  data.bullets[1] || '',          // Bullet 2
  data.bullets[2] || '',          // Bullet 3
  data.bullets[3] || '',          // Bullet 4
  data.bullets[4] || '',          // Bullet 5
  data.descriptionHTML || '',     // Description HTML
  data.keywords || '',            // Keywords
  data.infographics[0]?.textDE || '',          // Image 1 Text DE
  data.infographics[0]?.instructionsPL || '',  // Image 1 Instructions PL
  data.infographics[1]?.textDE || '',          // Image 2 Text DE
  data.infographics[1]?.instructionsPL || '',  // Image 2 Instructions PL
  data.infographics[2]?.textDE || '',          // Image 3 Text DE
  data.infographics[2]?.instructionsPL || '',  // Image 3 Instructions PL
  data.infographics[3]?.textDE || '',          // Image 4 Text DE
  data.infographics[3]?.instructionsPL || '',  // Image 4 Instructions PL
  data.infographics[4]?.textDE || '',          // Image 5 Text DE
  data.infographics[4]?.instructionsPL || '',  // Image 5 Instructions PL
  data.video?.textDE || '',       // Video Text DE
  data.video?.instructionsPL || '', // Video Instructions PL
  data.brandStory || '',          // Brand Story
  data.brandStoreSuggestions || '', // Brand Store
  docUrl || ''                    // Google Doc URL
];

// Append row to client sheet
clientSheet.appendRow(rowData);

// Get the row number that was just added
const lastRow = clientSheet.getLastRow();

// Format the new row (light background, 50px height, wrap text, align top-left)
const range = clientSheet.getRange(lastRow, 1, 1, rowData.length);
range.setBackground('#f9f9f9');
range.setFontSize(10);
range.setWrap(true);
range.setVerticalAlignment('top');
range.setHorizontalAlignment('left');
clientSheet.setRowHeight(lastRow, 50);

const clientSheetUrl = clientSS.getUrl();
saveOutputUrl(asin, 'client', clientSheetUrl);

Logger.log(`✅ Data exported to client sheet: Row ${lastRow}`);
return { success: true, row: lastRow, sheetUrl: clientSheetUrl };

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Error exporting to client sheet: ${error.message});
// Don't fail the whole process if client sheet export fails
Logger.log('⚠️ Continuing despite client sheet error...');
return { success: false, error: error.message };
}
}

/**

Export listing data to Amazon Flat File format (copy template)
*/
function exportToFlatFile(asin) {
Logger.log(Exporting to Amazon Flat File for ${asin}...);
try {
const data = getOutputData(asin);

// Flat File Template ID
const FLAT_FILE_TEMPLATE_ID = '1eeO5akjAJvWF1JcxFA10-sgcJyTLo1G_cRe-BFbyN40';

// Generate file name similar to doc
const titleDEshort = data.titleDE.split(' ').slice(0, 6).join('-').replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '');
const titlePLshort = data.titlePL ? data.titlePL.split(' ').slice(0, 6).join('-').replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '') : titleDEshort;
const sellerName = (data.brand || 'WERHE').replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '');
const datePart = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'yyyy-MM-dd');
const language = data.language || 'DE';

const fileName = `ASIN-${asin}-${titleDEshort}-${titlePLshort}-${sellerName}-Amazon-Flat-File-${language}-${datePart}`;

// Copy template
Logger.log(`Copying flat file template...`);
const templateFile = DriveApp.getFileById(FLAT_FILE_TEMPLATE_ID);
const copiedFile = templateFile.makeCopy(fileName);
const flatFileSS = SpreadsheetApp.openById(copiedFile.getId());

// Open "Vorlage" sheet
const vorlageSheet = flatFileSS.getSheetByName('Vorlage');
if (!vorlageSheet) {
  throw new Error('Sheet "Vorlage" not found in template');
}

// Get all headers from row 2 (row 1 = German names, row 2 = API field names)
const lastCol = vorlageSheet.getLastColumn();
const headers = vorlageSheet.getRange(2, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0];
Logger.log(`Read ${headers.length} headers from Vorlage row 2`);

// Map column names to data
const columnMapping = {
  'amzn1.volt.ca.product_id_value': asin,
  'item_name[marketplace_id=A1PA6795UKMFR9][language_tag=de_DE]#1.value': data.titleDE || '',
  'product_description[marketplace_id=A1PA6795UKMFR9][language_tag=de_DE]#1.value': stripHtml(data.descriptionHTML) || '',
  'bullet_point[marketplace_id=A1PA6795UKMFR9][language_tag=de_DE]#1.value': data.bullets[0] || '',
  'bullet_point[marketplace_id=A1PA6795UKMFR9][language_tag=de_DE]#2.value': data.bullets[1] || '',
  'bullet_point[marketplace_id=A1PA6795UKMFR9][language_tag=de_DE]#3.value': data.bullets[2] || '',
  'bullet_point[marketplace_id=A1PA6795UKMFR9][language_tag=de_DE]#4.value': data.bullets[3] || '',
  'bullet_point[marketplace_id=A1PA6795UKMFR9][language_tag=de_DE]#5.value': data.bullets[4] || '',
  'generic_keyword[marketplace_id=A1PA6795UKMFR9][language_tag=de_DE]#1.value': data.keywords || ''
};

// Find columns and fill data in row 4 (rows 1-3 must remain untouched)
for (let col = 0; col < headers.length; col++) {
  const header = headers[col];
  if (columnMapping.hasOwnProperty(header)) {
    vorlageSheet.getRange(4, col + 1).setValue(columnMapping[header]);
    Logger.log(`Filled column "${header}" with data in row 4`);
  }
}

// Make file accessible
copiedFile.setSharing(DriveApp.Access.ANYONE_WITH_LINK, DriveApp.Permission.EDIT);

// Move to LISTING_FILES folder
const targetFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(DRIVE_FOLDER_ID);
copiedFile.moveTo(targetFolder);
Logger.log(`Moved Flat File to LISTING_FILES folder`);

const flatFileUrl = flatFileSS.getUrl();
saveOutputUrl(asin, 'flatfile', flatFileUrl);

Logger.log(`✅ Flat File created: ${flatFileUrl}`);
return { success: true, sheetUrl: flatFileUrl };

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Error exporting to flat file: ${error.message});
// Don't fail the whole process if flat file export fails
Logger.log('⚠️ Continuing despite flat file error...');
return { success: false, error: error.message };
}
}

/**

Helper: Strip HTML tags from text
*/
function stripHtml(html) {
if (!html) return '';
return html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}
/**

Generate ONE Flat File for multiple selected rows
*/
function generateFlatFileForSelectedRows() {
Logger.log('Generating Flat File for selected rows...');
try {
// Get selected rows from any sheet
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();
const selection = sheet.getActiveRange();
const selectedRows = selection.getRowIndex();
const numRows = selection.getNumRows();

if (selectedRows < 2) {
  throw new Error('Bitte wählen Sie mindestens eine Zeile mit Daten aus (nicht die Kopfzeile).');
}

// Get ASINs from column A of selected rows
const asins = [];
for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
  const asin = sheet.getRange(selectedRows + i, 1).getValue();
  if (asin && asin.toString().trim().length > 0) {
    const asinStr = asin.toString().trim();
    // Only add if looks like ASIN (starts with B0)
    if (asinStr.match(/^B0[A-Z0-9]{8}$/)) {
      asins.push(asinStr);
    }
  }
}

if (asins.length === 0) {
  throw new Error('Keine ASINs in den ausgewählten Zeilen gefunden.');
}

Logger.log(`Found ${asins.length} ASINs: ${asins.join(', ')}`);

// Show confirmation dialog
const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
const response = ui.alert(
  '🚀 Flat File generieren',
  `Möchten Sie EINEN Flat File für ${asins.length} Listing(s) generieren?\n\nASINs: ${asins.join(', ')}`,
  ui.ButtonSet.YES_NO
);

if (response !== ui.Button.YES) {
  return;
}

// Flat File Template ID
const FLAT_FILE_TEMPLATE_ID = '1eeO5akjAJvWF1JcxFA10-sgcJyTLo1G_cRe-BFbyN40';

// Get data for all ASINs
const allData = [];
for (const asin of asins) {
  try {
    const data = getOutputData(asin);
    allData.push({ asin, data });
  } catch (error) {
    Logger.log(`Error loading data for ${asin}: ${error.message}`);
  }
}

if (allData.length === 0) {
  throw new Error('Keine Daten für die ausgewählten ASINs gefunden.');
}

// Generate file name with bilingual titles from FIRST product
const firstData = allData[0].data;
let titleShortLang = firstData.titleShortDE || firstData.titleShortFR || firstData.titleShortIT || firstData.titleShortES || '';
let titleShortPL = firstData.titleShortPL || '';

// Check if values are URLs (old data from before Setup Sheets) - use fallback
const isURL = (str) => str && (str.includes('http') || str.includes('docs.google') || str.includes('drive.google'));

if (!titleShortLang || isURL(titleShortLang)) {
  titleShortLang = firstData.titleDE.split(' ').slice(0, 5).join(' ');
  Logger.log(`Using fallback for titleShortLang: ${titleShortLang}`);
}
if (!titleShortPL || isURL(titleShortPL)) {
  titleShortPL = firstData.titlePL ? firstData.titlePL.split(' ').slice(0, 5).join(' ') : titleShortLang;
  Logger.log(`Using fallback for titleShortPL: ${titleShortPL}`);
}

// Clean titles but KEEP special characters
titleShortLang = titleShortLang.replace(/[^\wäöüßÄÖÜéèêëàâçùûîôæœÉÈÊËÀÂÇÙÛÎÔÆŒ\s-]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '-');
titleShortPL = titleShortPL.replace(/[^\wąćęłńóśźżĄĆĘŁŃÓŚŹŻ\s-]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '-');

const sellerName = (firstData.brand || 'WERHE');
const datePart = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'yyyy-MM-dd');
const language = firstData.language || 'DE';
const countSuffix = allData.length > 1 ? `-${allData.length}products` : '';

// Format: ASIN-[firstASIN]-[LANG]-[titleShort]-[titleShortPL]-[seller]-Flat-File-[count]-[date]
const fileName = `ASIN-${allData[0].asin}-${language}-${titleShortLang}-${titleShortPL}-${sellerName}-Flat-File${countSuffix}-${datePart}`;

// Copy template
Logger.log(`Copying flat file template...`);
const templateFile = DriveApp.getFileById(FLAT_FILE_TEMPLATE_ID);
const copiedFile = templateFile.makeCopy(fileName);
const flatFileSS = SpreadsheetApp.openById(copiedFile.getId());

// Open "Vorlage" sheet
const vorlageSheet = flatFileSS.getSheetByName('Vorlage');
if (!vorlageSheet) {
  throw new Error('Sheet "Vorlage" not found in template');
}

// Get all headers from row 2 (row 1 = German names, row 2 = API field names)
const lastCol = vorlageSheet.getLastColumn();
const headers = vorlageSheet.getRange(2, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0];
Logger.log(`Read ${headers.length} headers from Vorlage row 2`);

// Fill data for each ASIN (starting at row 4)
let currentRow = 4;
const results = [];

for (const { asin, data } of allData) {
  try {
    // Map column names to data (adjust language_tag based on data.language)
    const marketplaceId = 'A1PA6795UKMFR9'; // Germany
    const languageTag = data.language === 'FR' ? 'fr_FR' :
                       data.language === 'IT' ? 'it_IT' :
                       data.language === 'ES' ? 'es_ES' : 'de_DE';

    const columnMapping = {
      'amzn1.volt.ca.product_id_value': asin,
      [`item_name[marketplace_id=${marketplaceId}][language_tag=${languageTag}]#1.value`]: data.titleDE || '',
      [`product_description[marketplace_id=${marketplaceId}][language_tag=${languageTag}]#1.value`]: stripHtml(data.descriptionHTML) || '',
      [`bullet_point[marketplace_id=${marketplaceId}][language_tag=${languageTag}]#1.value`]: data.bullets[0] || '',
      [`bullet_point[marketplace_id=${marketplaceId}][language_tag=${languageTag}]#2.value`]: data.bullets[1] || '',
      [`bullet_point[marketplace_id=${marketplaceId}][language_tag=${languageTag}]#3.value`]: data.bullets[2] || '',
      [`bullet_point[marketplace_id=${marketplaceId}][language_tag=${languageTag}]#4.value`]: data.bullets[3] || '',
      [`bullet_point[marketplace_id=${marketplaceId}][language_tag=${languageTag}]#5.value`]: data.bullets[4] || '',
      [`generic_keyword[marketplace_id=${marketplaceId}][language_tag=${languageTag}]#1.value`]: data.keywords || ''
    };

    // Find columns and fill data
    let filledCount = 0;
    for (let col = 0; col < headers.length; col++) {
      const header = headers[col];
      if (columnMapping.hasOwnProperty(header)) {
        vorlageSheet.getRange(currentRow, col + 1).setValue(columnMapping[header]);
        filledCount++;
        Logger.log(`  → Filled column ${col + 1} (${header})`);
      }
    }

    if (filledCount === 0) {
      Logger.log(`⚠️ WARNING: No columns matched for ${asin}! Check template headers vs columnMapping.`);
      Logger.log(`First 5 headers in template: ${headers.slice(0, 5).join(', ')}`);
    }

    Logger.log(`✓ Filled ${filledCount} columns in row ${currentRow} for ${asin}`);
    results.push({ asin, success: true, row: currentRow });
    currentRow++;

  } catch (error) {
    Logger.log(`Error filling data for ${asin}: ${error.message}`);
    results.push({ asin, success: false, error: error.message });
  }
}

// Make file accessible
copiedFile.setSharing(DriveApp.Access.ANYONE_WITH_LINK, DriveApp.Permission.EDIT);

// Move to LISTING_FILES folder
const targetFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(DRIVE_FOLDER_ID);
copiedFile.moveTo(targetFolder);
Logger.log(`Moved Flat File to LISTING_FILES folder`);

const flatFileUrl = flatFileSS.getUrl();

// Save URL for all successful ASINs
for (const result of results) {
  if (result.success) {
    saveOutputUrl(result.asin, 'flatfile', flatFileUrl);
  }
}

// Summary
const successCount = results.filter(r => r.success).length;
const failCount = results.length - successCount;

let message = `✅ Flat File erstellt mit ${successCount} von ${results.length} Produkten!\n\n`;
message += `📎 URL: ${flatFileUrl}\n\n`;
message += `Produkte:\n`;

results.forEach(r => {
  if (r.success) {
    message += `✓ ${r.asin} (Zeile ${r.row})\n`;
  } else {
    message += `✗ ${r.asin}: FEHLER - ${r.error}\n`;
  }
});

if (failCount > 0) {
  message += `\n⚠️ ${failCount} Fehler - siehe Logs für Details.`;
}

ui.alert('📋 Flat File Generation', message, ui.ButtonSet.OK);
Logger.log(`✅ Flat File generation completed: ${successCount} success, ${failCount} failed`);

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Error in generateFlatFileForSelectedRows: ${error.message});
SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('❌ Fehler', error.message, SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);
}
}

/**

Create email draft for multiple products at once
*/
function sendBulkEmailDraft() {
Logger.log(Creating bulk email draft...);
try {
// Get selected ASINs from current sheet
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();
const selection = sheet.getActiveRange();
const selectedRows = selection.getRowIndex();
const numRows = selection.getNumRows();

const asins = [];
for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
  const asin = sheet.getRange(selectedRows + i, 1).getValue();
  if (asin && asin.toString().length > 0) {
    asins.push(asin.toString());
  }
}

if (asins.length === 0) {
  throw new Error('Nie znaleziono ASIN w zaznaczonych wierszach');
}

Logger.log(`Found ${asins.length} ASINs: ${asins.join(', ')}`);

// Collect data for all products
const products = [];
const pdfAttachments = [];

for (const asin of asins) {
  try {
    const data = getOutputData(asin);
    const docUrl = getDocUrl(asin);

    // Get PDF URL from OUTPUT
    const outputSheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('OUTPUT');
    const row = findRow(outputSheet, asin);
    const pdfUrl = outputSheet.getRange(row, 35).getValue(); // Column AI (PDF_URL)

    products.push({
      asin: asin,
      brand: data.brand,
      productType: data.productType,
      titleDE: data.titleDE,
      docUrl: docUrl,
      pdfUrl: pdfUrl,
      language: data.language || 'DE'
    });

    // Get PDF file for attachment
    if (pdfUrl) {
      const pdfIdMatch = pdfUrl.match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
      if (pdfIdMatch) {
        const pdfFile = DriveApp.getFileById(pdfIdMatch[1]);
        pdfAttachments.push(pdfFile.getBlob());
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    Logger.log(`Error processing ASIN ${asin}: ${error.message}`);
  }
}

if (products.length === 0) {
  throw new Error('Nie udalo sie przetworzyc zadnych produktow');
}

// Get recipient email
const recipient = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('DEFAULT_EMAIL');

// Build email subject
const subject = `Listingi Amazon gotowe - ${products.length} ${products.length === 1 ? 'produkt' : 'produkty'}`;

// Build product list for email
let productsListHtml = '';
let productsListPlain = '';

products.forEach((product, idx) => {
  productsListHtml += `

<div style="background: #f5f5f5; padding: 15px; border-radius: 5px; margin: 20px 0;"> <h3 style="color: #1a73e8; margin-top: 0;">${idx + 1}. ${product.brand} ${product.productType}</h3> <strong>ASIN:</strong> ${product.asin}<br> <strong>Język:</strong> ${product.language}<br> <strong>Tytuł:</strong> ${product.titleDE.substring(0, 80)}...<br> <br> <strong>Dokumenty:</strong><br> <a href="${product.docUrl}">Google Doc (edytowalny)</a><br> <a href="${product.pdfUrl}">PDF (w załączniku)</a> </div> `;
  productsListPlain += `

${idx + 1}. ${product.brand} ${product.productType}
ASIN: ${product.asin}
Język: ${product.language}
Google Doc: ${product.docUrl}
PDF: ${product.pdfUrl}

`;
});

// Build HTML email
const bodyHtml = `

<div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 700px; margin: 0 auto;"> <h2 style="color: #1a73e8;">Listingi Amazon - Opisy produktów gotowe</h2> <p>Dzień dobry,</p> <p>Listingi Amazon dla <strong>${products.length} ${products.length === 1 ? 'produktu' : 'produktów'}</strong> są gotowe do przeglądania:</p>
${productsListHtml}

<h3 style="color: #0066cc;">Następne kroki:</h3> <ol> <li><strong>Przegląd treści:</strong> Proszę przejrzeć dokumenty i przekazać uwagi</li> <li><strong>Produkcja grafik:</strong> Przekazać instrukcje grafikom</li> <li><strong>Produkcja wideo:</strong> Zlecić produkcję wideo według scenariusza</li> <li><strong>Upload:</strong> Wgrać finalne treści do Amazon Seller Central</li> </ol> <p>W razie pytań pozostaję do dyspozycji.</p> <p> Pozdrawiam<br> <strong>NetAnaliza Koronczok</strong><br> service@netanaliza.com </p> <hr style="border: none; border-top: 1px solid #ddd; margin: 30px 0;"> <p style="font-size: 11px; color: #999;"> Automatycznie wygenerowane przez Amazon Listing Automation System </p> </div> `;
const bodyPlain = `

Listingi Amazon - Opisy produktów gotowe

Dzień dobry,

Listingi Amazon dla ${products.length} ${products.length === 1 ? 'produktu' : 'produktów'} są gotowe:

${productsListPlain}

W razie pytań: service@netanaliza.com

Pozdrawiam
NetAnaliza Koronczok
`;

// Create draft with all PDFs attached
GmailApp.createDraft(
  recipient,
  subject,
  bodyPlain,
  {
    htmlBody: bodyHtml,
    attachments: pdfAttachments,
    name: 'NetAnaliza Koronczok'
  }
);

Logger.log(`✅ Bulk email draft created with ${products.length} products and ${pdfAttachments.length} PDFs`);
SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(`✅ Email draft utworzony!\n\n${products.length} ${products.length === 1 ? 'produkt' : 'produkty'}\n${pdfAttachments.length} ${pdfAttachments.length === 1 ? 'PDF' : 'PDFy'} w załączniku\n\nSprawdź Gmail Drafts.`);

return { success: true, count: products.length, attachments: pdfAttachments.length };

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Error creating bulk email draft: ${error.message});
SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(❌ Błąd: ${error.message});
throw error;
}
}

/**

Create email draft for client
*/
function sendEmailDraft(asin) {
Logger.log(Creating email draft for ${asin}...);
try {
const data = getOutputData(asin);
const research = getResearchData(asin);
const docUrl = getDocUrl(asin);

// Export PDF

const recipient = data.clientEmail || PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('DEFAULT_EMAIL');

const subject = `Listing Amazon gotowy - ${data.brand} ${data.productType} (ASIN: ${asin})`;

const bodyHtml = `

<div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 700px; margin: 0 auto;"> <h2 style="color: #1a73e8;">Listing Amazon - Opis produktu gotowy</h2> <p>Dzień dobry,</p> <p>Listing Amazon dla poniższego produktu jest gotowy do przeglądania:</p> <div style="background: #f5f5f5; padding: 15px; border-radius: 5px; margin: 20px 0;"> <strong>Produkt:</strong> ${data.brand} ${data.productType}<br> <strong>ASIN:</strong> ${asin}<br> <strong>Marketplace:</strong> Amazon.de<br> <strong>Data utworzenia:</strong> ${Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm')} </div> <h3 style="color: #0066cc;">Dokumenty:</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Google Doc (edytowalny):</strong> <a href="${docUrl}">Link do dokumentu</a></li> <li><strong>PDF:</strong> <a href="${pdfData.url}">Pobierz PDF</a> (w załączniku)</li> </ul> <h3 style="color: #0066cc;">Zawartość:</h3> <ul> <li>Tytuł produktu (${data.titleDE.length} znaków)</li> <li>5 Bullet Points (350-480 znaków każdy)</li> <li>Opis produktu (${data.descriptionHTML.length} znaków, HTML)</li> <li>Słowa kluczowe (${Utilities.newBlob(data.keywords).getBytes().length} bajtów)</li> <li>5 obrazów produktu z instrukcjami dla grafika</li> <li>1 wideo produktowe (30-60s) ze scenariuszem</li> <li>${data.aplusModules.length} modułów A+ Premium Content</li> <li>Brand Story</li> <li>Sugestie Brand Store</li> </ul> <h3 style="color: #0066cc;">Następne kroki:</h3> <ol> <li><strong>Przegląd treści:</strong> Proszę przejrzeć dokument i przekazać uwagi</li> <li><strong>Produkcja grafik:</strong> Przekazać instrukcje grafikom</li> <li><strong>Produkcja wideo:</strong> Zlecić produkcję wideo według scenariusza</li> <li><strong>Upload:</strong> Wgrać finalne treści do Amazon Seller Central</li> </ol> <p>W razie pytań pozostaję do dyspozycji.</p> <p> Pozdrawiam<br> <strong>NetAnaliza Koronczok</strong><br> service@netanaliza.com </p> <hr style="border: none; border-top: 1px solid #ddd; margin: 30px 0;"> <p style="font-size: 11px; color: #999;"> Automatycznie wygenerowane przez Amazon Listing Automation System </p> </div> `;
const bodyPlain = `

Listing Amazon - Opis produktu gotowy

Dzień dobry,

Listing Amazon dla poniższego produktu jest gotowy:

Produkt: ${data.brand} ${data.productType}
ASIN: ${asin}
Marketplace: Amazon.de
Data: ${Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm')}

DOKUMENTY:

Google Doc: ${docUrl}
PDF: ${pdfData.url}
ZAWARTOŚĆ:

Tytuł produktu (${data.titleDE.length} znaków)
5 Bullet Points
Opis produktu (${data.descriptionHTML.length} znaków, HTML)
Słowa kluczowe
5 obrazów produktu z instrukcjami
1 wideo produktowe ze scenariuszem
${data.aplusModules.length} modułów A+ Content
Brand Story & sugestie Brand Store
W razie pytań: service@netanaliza.com

Pozdrawiam
NetAnaliza Koronczok
`;

// Get PDF file as blob for attachment
const pdfFile = DriveApp.getFileById(pdfData.id);

// Create draft
GmailApp.createDraft(
  recipient,
  subject,
  bodyPlain,
  {
    htmlBody: bodyHtml,
    attachments: [pdfFile.getBlob()],
    name: 'NetAnaliza Koronczok'
  }
);

Logger.log(`✅ Email draft created for ${recipient}`);
return { recipient: recipient, subject: subject };

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Error creating email draft: ${error.message});
// Don't fail the whole process if email fails
Logger.log('⚠️ Continuing despite email error...');
return null;
}
}

/**

Process listing - Steps 1-3 (until Grok manual step)
*/
function processListing(asin) {
Logger.log(\n========== PROCESSING LISTING: ${asin} ==========\n);
try {
// Validate ASIN exists in INPUT sheet
const inputData = getInputData(asin);

updateStatus(asin, 'PROCESSING');

// Step 1: Fetch product data from PA-API
Logger.log('📥 Step 1/3: Fetching product data from Amazon PA-API...');
fetchProductData(asin);

// Step 2: Reviews analysis (placeholder)
Logger.log('📝 Step 2/3: Setting up reviews analysis placeholder...');
analyzeReviews(asin);

// Step 3: Generate Grok prompt
Logger.log('✍️ Step 3/3: Generating Grok prompt...');
generateGrokPrompt(asin);

Logger.log('\n========== STEPS 1-3 COMPLETE ==========\n');
Logger.log('⏸️  MANUAL STEP REQUIRED:\n');
Logger.log('1. Go to GROK_PROMPT tab');
Logger.log('2. Copy the prompt from column B');
Logger.log('3. Paste it into Grok (https://grok.x.ai)');
Logger.log('4. Wait for Grok response (may take 1-2 minutes)');
Logger.log('5. Copy the entire JSON response from Grok');
Logger.log('6. Paste it into OUTPUT tab, column B (Grok_JSON_Input)');
Logger.log('7. Run: parseGrokOutput() from menu\n');

return {
  success: true,
  message: 'Steps 1-3 complete. Ready for manual Grok step.',
  nextAction: 'Copy prompt from GROK_PROMPT tab and paste to Grok'
};

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(\n❌ ERROR: ${error.message}\n);
updateStatus(asin, 'ERROR', error.message);
throw error;
}
}

/**

Complete listing after Grok - Steps 5-10
*/
function completeListingAfterGrok(asin) {
Logger.log(\n========== COMPLETING LISTING: ${asin} ==========\n);
try {
// Step 5: Parse Grok output
Logger.log('📝 Step 5/10: Parsing Grok JSON output...');
parseGrokOutput(asin);

// Step 6: Create Google Doc from template
Logger.log('📄 Step 6/10: Creating Google Doc from template...');
const docData = createGoogleDoc(asin);
Logger.log(`   ✓ Document created: ${docData.url}`);

// Step 7: Export to PDF
Logger.log('📎 Step 7/10: Exporting to PDF...');
const pdfData = exportToPDF(asin);
Logger.log(`   ✓ PDF created: ${pdfData.url}`);

// Step 8: Export to client sheet
Logger.log('📊 Step 8/10: Exporting to client sheet...');
const clientData = exportToClientSheet(asin);
if (clientData.success) {
  Logger.log(`   ✓ Data exported to client sheet: ${clientData.sheetUrl}`);
}

// Step 9: Export to Amazon Flat File (REMOVED - now manual only via menu)
// Use menu: "Generate Flat File for Selected Rows" to export multiple listings at once
const flatFileData = { success: false, note: 'Flat File export moved to separate menu option' };

// Step 10: Create email draft
Logger.log('📧 Step 10/10: Creating email draft...');
const emailData = sendEmailDraft(asin);
if (emailData) {
  Logger.log(`   ✓ Email draft created for: ${emailData.recipient}`);
}

// Mark as complete
updateStatus(asin, 'COMPLETE');

Logger.log('\n========== LISTING COMPLETE ✅ ==========\n');
Logger.log(`📄 Google Doc: ${docData.url}`);
Logger.log(`📎 PDF: ${pdfData.url}`);
Logger.log(`📊 Client Sheet: ${clientData.success ? clientData.sheetUrl : 'Error (see logs)'}`);
Logger.log(`📋 Flat File: ${flatFileData.success ? flatFileData.sheetUrl : 'Error (see logs)'}`);
Logger.log(`📧 Email draft: Check Gmail drafts\n`);

return {
  success: true,
  docUrl: docData.url,
  pdfUrl: pdfData.url,
  clientSheetUrl: clientData.success ? clientData.sheetUrl : null,
  flatFileUrl: flatFileData.success ? flatFileData.sheetUrl : null,
  message: 'Listing complete! All 4 outputs generated successfully.'
};

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(\n❌ ERROR: ${error.message}\n);
updateStatus(asin, 'ERROR', error.message);
throw error;
}
}

/**

Create custom menu on spreadsheet open

function onOpen() {

.addSeparator()
.addSubMenu(ui.createMenu('▶️ Process Listing')
.addItem('1️⃣ Start Process (Steps 1-3)', 'menuProcessListing')
.addItem('2️⃣ Parse Grok Output (Step 5)', 'menuParseGrokOutput')
.addItem('3️⃣ Complete Listing (Steps 6-10)', 'menuCompleteListing'))
.addSeparator()
.addSubMenu(ui.createMenu('🔧 Individual Steps')
.addItem('Generate Grok Prompt', 'menuGenerateGrokPrompt')
.addItem('Create Google Doc', 'menuCreateGoogleDoc')
.addItem('Export to PDF', 'menuExportToPDF')
.addItem('Export to Client Sheet', 'menuExportToClientSheet')
.addItem('Export to Flat File (single)', 'menuExportToFlatFile')
.addItem('Create Email Draft (single)', 'menuSendEmailDraft')
.addItem('📧 Create Email Draft (multiple)', 'sendBulkEmailDraft'))
.addSeparator()
.addItem('📋 Generate Flat File for Selected Rows', 'generateFlatFileForSelectedRows')
.addSeparator()
.addItem('📊 View Processing Status', 'menuShowStatus')
.addItem('ℹ️ Help & Documentation', 'menuShowHelp')
.addToUi();
}

function menuFetchMainProductOnly() {

return;
}
const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();

);

if (response === ui.Button.YES) {
try {
fetchProductData(asin, 'Główny', '');
ui.alert(

ui.ButtonSet.OK
);
} catch (error) {
ui.alert('❌ Błąd', error.message, ui.ButtonSet.OK);
}
}
}

/**

Menu: Fetch main product + similar products
*/
function menuFetchMainProductWithSimilar() {
const asin = getSelectedAsin();
if (!asin) {
SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('⚠️ Wybierz wiersz z ASIN w arkuszu INPUT');
return;
}
const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();

try {
// Step 1: Fetch main product first
Logger.log(📥 Fetching main product: ${asin});
fetchProductData(asin, 'Główny', '');
Logger.log(✅ Main product ${asin} fetched successfully);

// Step 2: Prompt for similar products ASINs
const promptResponse = ui.prompt(
  '🔍 Podobne produkty',
  `ASIN główny: ${asin}\n\n` +
  `Podaj ASINy podobnych/konkurencyjnych produktów (1-5 ASINów):\n` +
  `• Oddziel przecinkami (np: B08ABC123,B09XYZ456)\n` +
  `• Zostaw puste aby automatycznie znaleźć 2-3 podobne produkty\n\n` +
  `ASINy:`,
  ui.ButtonSet.OK_CANCEL
);

if (promptResponse.getSelectedButton() === ui.Button.CANCEL) {
  ui.alert('✅ Główny produkt pobrany', `ASIN: ${asin}\n\nPobrano tylko główny produkt.\nSprawdź arkusz RESEARCH.`, ui.ButtonSet.OK);
  return;
}

const input = promptResponse.getResponseText().trim();
let similarAsins = [];

if (input) {
  // User provided ASINs - parse and validate
  Logger.log(`User provided similar ASINs: ${input}`);
  similarAsins = input.split(',')
    .map(a => a.trim())
    .filter(a => a.length > 0);

  // Validate count (1-5)
  if (similarAsins.length > 5) {
    ui.alert('⚠️ Za dużo ASINów', `Podano ${similarAsins.length} ASINów.\nMaksymalnie można podać 5.\n\nZostanie pobranych tylko pierwszych 5.`, ui.ButtonSet.OK);
    similarAsins = similarAsins.slice(0, 5);
  }

  // Validate ASIN format (basic check)
  const validAsins = similarAsins.filter(a => a.match(/^[A-Z0-9]{10}$/));
  if (validAsins.length < similarAsins.length) {
    const invalidAsins = similarAsins.filter(a => !a.match(/^[A-Z0-9]{10}$/));
    ui.alert(
      '⚠️ Nieprawidłowe ASINy',
      `Pominięto nieprawidłowe ASINy:\n${invalidAsins.join(', ')}\n\nASINy muszą mieć 10 znaków (A-Z, 0-9).`,
      ui.ButtonSet.OK
    );
    similarAsins = validAsins;
  }

  if (similarAsins.length === 0) {
    ui.alert('❌ Brak poprawnych ASINów', 'Nie podano żadnych poprawnych ASINów.\n\nSzukam automatycznie...', ui.ButtonSet.OK);
    // Get marketplace from INPUT for auto-finding
    let marketplaceCode = 'de';
    try {
      const inputData = getInputData(asin);
      marketplaceCode = inputData.marketplace || 'de';
    } catch (error) {
      Logger.log('Could not get marketplace from INPUT, using default: de');
    }
    similarAsins = findSimilarProducts(asin, 3, marketplaceCode);
  }

} else {
  // Empty input - auto-find
  Logger.log('No ASINs provided, auto-finding similar products...');
  // Get marketplace from INPUT for auto-finding
  let marketplaceCode = 'de';
  try {
    const inputData = getInputData(asin);
    marketplaceCode = inputData.marketplace || 'de';
  } catch (error) {
    Logger.log('Could not get marketplace from INPUT, using default: de');
  }
  similarAsins = findSimilarProducts(asin, 3, marketplaceCode);
}

// Step 3: Fetch all similar products
if (similarAsins.length > 0) {
  Logger.log(`Fetching ${similarAsins.length} similar products...`);

  let successCount = 0;
  let failedAsins = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < similarAsins.length; i++) {
    const simAsin = similarAsins[i];
    try {
      Logger.log(`Fetching similar product ${i+1}/${similarAsins.length}: ${simAsin}...`);
      fetchProductData(simAsin, 'Podobny', asin);
      successCount++;
    } catch (error) {
      Logger.log(`⚠️ Error fetching similar product ${simAsin}: ${error.message}`);
      failedAsins.push(simAsin);
    }
  }

  // Final summary
  let summaryMessage = `✅ Gotowe!\n\n`;
  summaryMessage += `ASIN główny: ${asin}\n\n`;
  summaryMessage += `Pobrano ${successCount} podobnych produktów:\n`;
  summaryMessage += similarAsins.filter(a => !failedAsins.includes(a)).join('\n');

  if (failedAsins.length > 0) {
    summaryMessage += `\n\n⚠️ Nie udało się pobrać:\n${failedAsins.join('\n')}`;
  }

  summaryMessage += `\n\nSprawdź arkusz RESEARCH.`;

  ui.alert('✅ Pobieranie zakończone', summaryMessage, ui.ButtonSet.OK);
} else {
  ui.alert(
    '⚠️ Brak podobnych produktów',
    `ASIN główny: ${asin}\n\nNie znaleziono podobnych produktów.\nPobrano tylko główny produkt.\n\nSprawdź arkusz RESEARCH.`,
    ui.ButtonSet.OK
  );
}

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Error in menuFetchMainProductWithSimilar: ${error.message});
ui.alert('❌ Błąd', error.message, ui.ButtonSet.OK);
}
}

/**

Menu: Process selected listing (Steps 1-3)
*/
function menuProcessListing() {
const asin = getSelectedAsin();
if (!asin) {
SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('⚠️ Bitte wählen Sie eine Zeile mit ASIN im INPUT-Tab aus');
return;
}
const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
const response = ui.alert(
'Listing-Prozess starten',
ASIN: ${asin}\n\nSchritte 1-3 werden ausgeführt:\n• PA-API Daten abrufen\n• Konkurrenten suchen\n• Grok Prompt generieren\n\nFortfahren?,
ui.ButtonSet.YES_NO
);

if (response === ui.Button.YES) {
try {
// Step 1: Fetch main product first
Logger.log(📥 Fetching main product: ${asin});
fetchProductData(asin, 'Główny', '');
Logger.log(✅ Main product ${asin} fetched successfully);

  // Step 2: Prompt for similar products ASINs
  const promptResponse = ui.prompt(
    '🔍 Podobne produkty',
    `ASIN główny: ${asin}\n\n` +
    `Podaj ASINy podobnych/konkurencyjnych produktów (1-5 ASINów):\n` +
    `• Oddziel przecinkami (np: B08ABC123,B09XYZ456)\n` +
    `• Zostaw puste aby automatycznie znaleźć 2-3 podobne produkty\n` +
    `• Anuluj aby pominąć podobne produkty\n\n` +
    `ASINy:`,
    ui.ButtonSet.OK_CANCEL
  );

  let similarAsins = [];
  if (promptResponse.getSelectedButton() === ui.Button.OK) {
    const input = promptResponse.getResponseText().trim();

    if (input) {
      // User provided ASINs - parse and validate
      Logger.log(`User provided similar ASINs: ${input}`);
      similarAsins = input.split(',')
        .map(a => a.trim())
        .filter(a => a.length > 0);

      // Validate count (1-5)
      if (similarAsins.length > 5) {
        ui.alert('⚠️ Za dużo ASINów', `Podano ${similarAsins.length} ASINów.\nZostanie pobranych tylko pierwszych 5.`, ui.ButtonSet.OK);
        similarAsins = similarAsins.slice(0, 5);
      }

      // Validate ASIN format
      const validAsins = similarAsins.filter(a => a.match(/^[A-Z0-9]{10}$/));
      if (validAsins.length < similarAsins.length) {
        const invalidAsins = similarAsins.filter(a => !a.match(/^[A-Z0-9]{10}$/));
        ui.alert('⚠️ Nieprawidłowe ASINy', `Pominięto:\n${invalidAsins.join(', ')}`, ui.ButtonSet.OK);
        similarAsins = validAsins;
      }

      if (similarAsins.length === 0) {
        ui.alert('❌ Brak poprawnych ASINów', 'Szukam automatycznie...', ui.ButtonSet.OK);
        // Get marketplace from INPUT for auto-finding
        let marketplaceCode = 'de';
        try {
          const inputData = getInputData(asin);
          marketplaceCode = inputData.marketplace || 'de';
        } catch (error) {
          Logger.log('Could not get marketplace from INPUT, using default: de');
        }
        similarAsins = findSimilarProducts(asin, 3, marketplaceCode);
      }

    } else {
      // Empty input - auto-find
      Logger.log('No ASINs provided, auto-finding similar products...');
      // Get marketplace from INPUT for auto-finding
      let marketplaceCode = 'de';
      try {
        const inputData = getInputData(asin);
        marketplaceCode = inputData.marketplace || 'de';
      } catch (error) {
        Logger.log('Could not get marketplace from INPUT, using default: de');
      }
      similarAsins = findSimilarProducts(asin, 3, marketplaceCode);
    }

    // Step 3: Fetch all similar products
    if (similarAsins.length > 0) {
      Logger.log(`Fetching ${similarAsins.length} similar products...`);
      let successCount = 0;
      let failedAsins = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < similarAsins.length; i++) {
        const simAsin = similarAsins[i];
        try {
          Logger.log(`Fetching similar product ${i+1}/${similarAsins.length}: ${simAsin}...`);
          fetchProductData(simAsin, 'Podobny', asin);
          successCount++;
        } catch (error) {
          Logger.log(`⚠️ Error fetching similar product ${simAsin}: ${error.message}`);
          failedAsins.push(simAsin);
        }
      }

      Logger.log(`✅ Fetched ${successCount} similar products`);
    }
  }

  // Step 4: Reviews analysis (placeholder)
  Logger.log('📝 Setting up reviews analysis placeholder...');
  analyzeReviews(asin);

  // Step 5: Generate Grok prompt
  Logger.log('✍️ Generating Grok prompt...');
  generateGrokPrompt(asin);

  ui.alert(
    '✅ Steps 1-3 abgeschlossen!',
    `ASIN: ${asin}\n` +
    `Pobrano ${similarAsins.length} podobnych produktów\n\n` +
    `NÄCHSTER SCHRITT:\n` +
    `1. Gehe zu GROK_PROMPT Tab\n` +
    `2. Kopiere Prompt aus Spalte B\n` +
    `3. Füge in Grok ein (https://grok.x.ai)\n` +
    `4. Kopiere Grok Response (JSON)\n` +
    `5. Füge in OUTPUT Tab Spalte B ein\n` +
    `6. Wähle "Parse Grok Output" aus dem Menü`,
    ui.ButtonSet.OK
  );
} catch (error) {
  ui.alert('❌ Fehler', error.message, ui.ButtonSet.OK);
}

}
}

/**

Menu: Fetch product data only

SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('⚠️ Bitte wählen Sie eine Zeile mit ASIN aus');

}
try {
fetchProductData(asin);

/**

Menu: Show processing status
*/
function menuShowStatus() {
const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId());
const sheet = ss.getSheetByName('INPUT');
const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
let statusText = '📊 LISTING STATUS OVERVIEW\n\n';

for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
const asin = data[i][0];
const status = data[i][1];
const brand = data[i][3];
const productType = data[i][4];

if (asin) {
  const statusEmoji = {
    'PENDING': '⏳',
    'PROCESSING': '▶️',
    'READY_FOR_GROK': '⏸️',
    'AWAITING_DOC': '📝',
    'COMPLETE': '✅',
    'ERROR': '❌'
  };

  statusText += `${statusEmoji[status] || '❓'} ${asin} - ${brand} ${productType}\n`;
  statusText += `   Status: ${status}\n\n`;
}

}

if (statusText === '📊 LISTING STATUS OVERVIEW\n\n') {
statusText += 'Keine Einträge gefunden.\n\nFüge ASINs im INPUT Tab hinzu.';
}

SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Status', statusText, SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);
}

/**

Amazon Listing Creation Automation System - PART 2
Document generation, PDF export, and email functions
*/
// ============================================================================
// CONFIGURATION
// ============================================================================

// Google Drive folder for all generated files (LISTING_FILES)
const DRIVE_FOLDER_ID = '1igQRRWJDeOCEhvRY7kZJNw2IhD2JYc9G';

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

/**

Get spreadsheet ID from properties
*/
function getSpreadsheetId() {
return PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
}
/**

Find row number by ASIN
*/
function findRow(sheet, asin) {
const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
if (data[i][0] === asin) {
return i + 1;
}
}
throw new Error(ASIN ${asin} not found in sheet ${sheet.getName()});
}
/**

Find or create row by ASIN
*/
function findOrCreateRow(sheet, asin) {
try {
return findRow(sheet, asin);
} catch (e) {
// Add new row
const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
const newRow = lastRow + 1;
sheet.getRange(newRow, 1).setValue(asin);

// Format new row: set height and alignment
formatRow(sheet, newRow);

return newRow;
}
}

/**

Format row: set height to 80px and alignment to top-left
*/
function formatRow(sheet, row) {
// Set row height to 80px (between 50-100px as requested)
sheet.setRowHeight(row, 80);
// Get all columns in the row and set alignment to top-left
const lastCol = sheet.getLastColumn();
if (lastCol > 0) {
const range = sheet.getRange(row, 1, 1, lastCol);
range.setVerticalAlignment('top');
range.setHorizontalAlignment('left');
}
}

/**

Get selected ASIN from active cell
*/
function getSelectedAsin() {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();
const row = sheet.getActiveCell().getRow();
if (row < 2) return null;
return sheet.getRange(row, 1).getValue();
}
/**

Update status in INPUT sheet
*/
function updateStatus(asin, status, errorMsg = '') {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('INPUT');
const row = findRow(sheet, asin);
sheet.getRange(row, 2).setValue(status); // Column B: Status

if (status === 'PROCESSING' && sheet.getRange(row, 8).getValue() === '') {
sheet.getRange(row, 8).setValue(Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm')); // Timestamp_Started
}

if (status === 'COMPLETE') {
sheet.getRange(row, 9).setValue(Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm')); // Timestamp_Completed
}

if (errorMsg) {
sheet.getRange(row, 11).setValue(errorMsg); // Error_Log
}
}

/**

Get input data for ASIN
*/
function getInputData(asin) {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('INPUT');
const row = findRow(sheet, asin);
const data = sheet.getRange(row, 1, 1, 13).getValues()[0];
return {
asin: data[0],
status: data[1],
marketplace: data[2] || 'de',
brand: data[3],
productType: data[4],
clientEmail: data[5],
additionalNotes: data[6],
timestampStarted: data[7],
timestampCompleted: data[8],
docUrl: data[9],
errorLog: data[10],
language: data[12] || 'DE'
};
}

/**

Get research data for ASIN
*/
function getResearchData(asin) {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('RESEARCH');
const row = findRow(sheet, asin);
const data = sheet.getRange(row, 1, 1, 14).getValues()[0];
return {
asin: data[0],
titleDE: data[1],
bulletsDE: data[2],
descriptionDE: data[3],
imagesUrls: data[4],
starRating: data[5],
reviewsCount: data[6],
priceEUR: data[7],
competitorAsins: data[8],
reviewsSummary: data[9],
technicalSpecs: data[10],
browseNode: data[11],
keywordsExtracted: data[12],
timestampResearch: data[13]
};
}

/**

Get output data for ASIN
*/
function getOutputData(asin) {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('OUTPUT');
const row = findRow(sheet, asin);
const data = sheet.getRange(row, 1, 1, 33).getValues()[0]; // Read 33 columns now (was 30)
// Get input data for brand and product type
const inputData = getInputData(asin);
const language = (data[30] || inputData.language || 'DE').toUpperCase(); // Column 31 = Language

return {
asin: data[0],
grokJsonInput: data[1],
titleDE: data[2],
bullets: [data[3], data[4], data[5], data[6], data[7]],
descriptionHTML: data[8],
keywords: data[9],
infographics: [
{ id: 1, textDE: data[10], instructionsPL: data[11] },
{ id: 2, textDE: data[12], instructionsPL: data[13] },
{ id: 3, textDE: data[14], instructionsPL: data[15] },
{ id: 4, textDE: data[16], instructionsPL: data[17] },
{ id: 5, textDE: data[18], instructionsPL: data[19] }
],
video: { textDE: data[20], instructionsPL: data[21] },
aplusModules: [data[22], data[23], data[24], data[25]].filter(m => m),
brandStory: data[26],
brandStoreSuggestions: data[27],
complianceCheck: data[28],
titlePL: data[29] || '',
language: language,
titleShortDE: language === 'DE' ? data[31] : '', // Column 32 = Title_Short_Lang
titleShortFR: language === 'FR' ? data[31] : '',
titleShortIT: language === 'IT' ? data[31] : '',
titleShortES: language === 'ES' ? data[31] : '',
titleShortPL: data[32] || '', // Column 33 = Title_Short_PL
brand: inputData.brand,
productType: inputData.productType,
clientEmail: inputData.clientEmail
};
}

/**

Update Doc URL in INPUT sheet
*/
function updateDocUrl(asin, docUrl) {
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('INPUT');
const row = findRow(sheet, asin);
sheet.getRange(row, 10).setValue(docUrl); // Column J: Doc_URL
}
/**

Get Doc URL for ASIN
*/
function getDocUrl(asin) {
const inputData = getInputData(asin);
return inputData.docUrl;
}
/**

Save output URLs to OUTPUT sheet
Columns: AE=Language, AF=Title_Short_Lang, AG=Title_Short_PL, AH=Doc_URL, AI=PDF_URL, AJ=Client_Sheet_URL, AK=Flat_File_URL
*/
function saveOutputUrl(asin, type, url) {
const outputSheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('OUTPUT');
const row = findRow(outputSheet, asin);
// Determine which column to update
let column;
switch(type) {
case 'doc':
column = 34; // AH (was AF, shifted +2)
break;
case 'pdf':
column = 35; // AI (was AG, shifted +2)
break;
case 'client':
column = 36; // AJ (was AH, shifted +2)
break;
case 'flatfile':
column = 37; // AK (was AI, shifted +2)
break;
default:
Logger.log(Unknown URL type: ${type});
return;
}

outputSheet.getRange(row, column).setValue(url);
Logger.log(Saved ${type} URL to OUTPUT column ${column});
}

/**

Setup all required sheets with proper headers
RUN THIS ONCE to create sheet structure
*/
function setupSheets() {
const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId());
// Create INPUT sheet
let inputSheet = ss.getSheetByName('INPUT');
if (!inputSheet) {
inputSheet = ss.insertSheet('INPUT');
const inputHeaderRange = inputSheet.getRange('A1:M1');
inputHeaderRange.setValues([[
'ASIN', 'Status', 'Marketplace', 'Brand', 'Product_Type',
'Client_Email', 'Additional_Notes', 'Timestamp_Started',
'Timestamp_Completed', 'Doc_URL', 'Error_Log', '', 'Language'
]]);
inputHeaderRange.setFontWeight('bold').setBackground('#4285f4').setFontColor('#ffffff');
inputHeaderRange.setWrap(true).setVerticalAlignment('top').setHorizontalAlignment('left');
inputSheet.setFrozenRows(1);
inputSheet.setRowHeight(1, 50);
}

// Create or UPDATE RESEARCH sheet with ALL PA-API fields
let researchSheet = ss.getSheetByName('RESEARCH');
if (!researchSheet) {
researchSheet = ss.insertSheet('RESEARCH');
}

// Always update headers (in case structure changed)
const headers = getResearchHeaders();
const headerRange = researchSheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length);
headerRange.setValues([headers]);
headerRange.setFontWeight('bold');
headerRange.setBackground('#34a853');
headerRange.setFontColor('#ffffff');
headerRange.setWrap(true).setVerticalAlignment('top').setHorizontalAlignment('left');
researchSheet.setFrozenRows(1);
researchSheet.setFrozenColumns(3); // Freeze ASIN, ASIN_Type, Related_To_ASIN
researchSheet.setRowHeight(1, 50);

Logger.log(✅ RESEARCH sheet updated with ${headers.length} columns);

// Create GROK_PROMPT sheet
let grokSheet = ss.getSheetByName('GROK_PROMPT');
if (!grokSheet) {
grokSheet = ss.insertSheet('GROK_PROMPT');

]]);

}

// Create OUTPUT sheet
let outputSheet = ss.getSheetByName('OUTPUT');

outputSheet = ss.insertSheet('OUTPUT');
const outputHeaderRange = outputSheet.getRange('A1:AK1');
outputHeaderRange.setValues([[

/**

Parse Grok JSON output and populate OUTPUT sheet
*/
function parseGrokOutput(asin) {
Logger.log(Parsing Grok output for ${asin}...);
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.openById(getSpreadsheetId()).getSheetByName('OUTPUT');
const row = findRow(sheet, asin);

// Get language code from OUTPUT sheet (column 31 = AE = Language)
const languageCode = (sheet.getRange(row, 31).getValue() || 'DE').toLowerCase();
Logger.log(Parsing JSON for language: ${languageCode});

// Read JSON from column B (user pastes Grok output here)
const jsonText = sheet.getRange(row, 2).getValue();

if (!jsonText || jsonText.trim() === '') {
throw new Error('No Grok output found in OUTPUT sheet column B. Please paste Grok response first.');
}

try {
// Clean JSON - remove markdown code blocks if present
let cleanJson = jsonText.trim();
cleanJson = cleanJson.replace(/^json\s*/i, ''); cleanJson = cleanJson.replace(/^\s*/i, '');
cleanJson = cleanJson.replace(/\s*```$/i, '');
cleanJson = cleanJson.trim();

const data = JSON.parse(cleanJson);

// Build dynamic title key
const titleKey = `title_${languageCode}`;
const textKey = `text_${languageCode}`;
const headerKey = `header_${languageCode}`;
const contentKey = `content_${languageCode}`;

// Validate required fields with dynamic language code
if (!data[titleKey]) {
  throw new Error(`Missing ${titleKey} in JSON (expected for language ${languageCode})`);
}
if (data[titleKey].length > 200) {
  throw new Error(`Title too long: ${data[titleKey].length} chars (max 200)`);
}
if (data[titleKey].length < 80) {
  throw new Error(`Title too short: ${data[titleKey].length} chars (min 80)`);
}

if (!data.bullets || !Array.isArray(data.bullets) || data.bullets.length !== 5) {
  throw new Error('Must have exactly 5 bullets');
}

// Validate bullet lengths
data.bullets.forEach((bullet, idx) => {
  if (bullet.length < 350 || bullet.length > 480) {
    Logger.log(`⚠️ Warning: Bullet ${idx + 1} length ${bullet.length} (should be 350-480)`);
  }
});

if (!data.description_html) {
  throw new Error('Missing description_html');
}

if (!data.keywords) {
  throw new Error('Missing keywords');
}

// Check keywords byte length
const keywordsBytes = Utilities.newBlob(data.keywords).getBytes().length;
if (keywordsBytes > 250) {
  const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
  const response = ui.alert(
    '⚠️ Keywords zu lang',
    `Keywords haben ${keywordsBytes} Bytes (max 250).\n\nMöchten Sie trotzdem fortfahren?\n\n` +
    `JA = Fortfahren (Keywords werden gespeichert)\n` +
    `NEIN = Abbrechen (bitte Keywords in Grok kürzen)`,
    ui.ButtonSet.YES_NO
  );

  if (response === ui.Button.NO) {
    throw new Error(`Keywords too long: ${keywordsBytes} bytes (max 250). Bitte kürzen und erneut parsen.`);
  }

  Logger.log(`⚠️ WARNING: Keywords ${keywordsBytes} bytes (max 250) - User chose to continue`);
}

if (!data.infographics || data.infographics.length !== 5) {
  throw new Error('Must have exactly 5 infographics');
}

if (!data.video) {
  throw new Error('Missing video data');
}

if (!data.aplus_modules || data.aplus_modules.length === 0) {
  throw new Error('Must have at least 1 A+ module');
}

if (!data.brand_story) {
  throw new Error('Missing brand_story');
}

if (!data.brand_store_suggestions_pl) {
  throw new Error('Missing brand_store_suggestions_pl');
}

if (!data.compliance_check) {
  throw new Error('Missing compliance_check');
}

// All validation passed - populate OUTPUT sheet
Logger.log('✅ Validation passed, populating OUTPUT sheet...');

// Column C: Title (dynamic language)
sheet.getRange(row, 3).setValue(data[titleKey]);

// Columns D-H: Bullets
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
  sheet.getRange(row, 4 + i).setValue(data.bullets[i]);
}

// Column I: Description HTML
sheet.getRange(row, 9).setValue(data.description_html);

// Column J: Keywords
sheet.getRange(row, 10).setValue(data.keywords);

// Columns K-T: Infographics (text_{lang} and instructions_pl pairs)
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
  const infog = data.infographics[i];
  sheet.getRange(row, 11 + (i * 2)).setValue(infog[textKey]);
  sheet.getRange(row, 12 + (i * 2)).setValue(infog.instructions_pl);
}

// Columns U-V: Video
sheet.getRange(row, 21).setValue(data.video[textKey]);
sheet.getRange(row, 22).setValue(data.video.instructions_pl);

// Columns W-Z: A+ Modules (store as JSON strings)
for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(4, data.aplus_modules.length); i++) {
  sheet.getRange(row, 23 + i).setValue(JSON.stringify(data.aplus_modules[i]));
}

// Column AA: Brand Story
sheet.getRange(row, 27).setValue(data.brand_story);

// Column AB: Brand Store Suggestions
sheet.getRange(row, 28).setValue(data.brand_store_suggestions_pl);

// Column AC: Compliance Check
const complianceStatus = data.compliance_check.status === 'PASS' ? '✅ PASS' : '❌ FAIL';
const complianceText = `${complianceStatus}\n\n${data.compliance_check.notes || ''}`;
sheet.getRange(row, 29).setValue(complianceText);

// Column AD: Title PL
sheet.getRange(row, 30).setValue(data.title_pl || '');

// Column AF: Title Short (language-specific) - NEW
const titleShortKey = `title_short_${languageCode}`;
sheet.getRange(row, 32).setValue(data[titleShortKey] || '');

// Column AG: Title Short PL - NEW
sheet.getRange(row, 33).setValue(data.title_short_pl || '');

// Update status to AWAITING_DOC
updateStatus(asin, 'AWAITING_DOC');

Logger.log(`✅ Grok output parsed successfully for ${asin}`);
return data;

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Parse error: ${error.message});
updateStatus(asin, 'ERROR', Parse Error: ${error.message});
throw error;
}
}

// ============================================================================
// GOOGLE DOC GENERATION
// ============================================================================

/**

Create Google Doc from template with listing content
*/
function createGoogleDoc(asin) {
Logger.log(Creating Google Doc from template for ${asin}...);
try {
const data = getOutputData(asin);

// Template ID
const TEMPLATE_ID = '1ASg9otLOdisvTg-vnjtCfyTHSNXoJQ8WR_agHI9krFc';

const language = data.language || 'DE';
const sellerName = (data.brand || 'WERHE');
const datePart = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'GMT+1', 'yyyy-MM-dd');

// Use title_short from data (generated by AI), or fallback to first 5 words
let titleShortLang = data.titleShortDE || data.titleShortFR || data.titleShortIT || data.titleShortES || '';
let titleShortPL = data.titleShortPL || '';

// Check if values are URLs (old data from before Setup Sheets) - use fallback
const isURL = (str) => str && (str.includes('http') || str.includes('docs.google') || str.includes('drive.google'));

if (!titleShortLang || isURL(titleShortLang)) {
  titleShortLang = data.titleDE.split(' ').slice(0, 5).join(' ');
  Logger.log(`Using fallback for titleShortLang in doc name: ${titleShortLang}`);
}
if (!titleShortPL || isURL(titleShortPL)) {
  titleShortPL = data.titlePL ? data.titlePL.split(' ').slice(0, 5).join(' ') : titleShortLang;
  Logger.log(`Using fallback for titleShortPL in doc name: ${titleShortPL}`);
}

// Clean titles but KEEP original characters (ä, ö, ü, ß, é, etc.)
titleShortLang = titleShortLang.replace(/[^\wäöüßÄÖÜéèêëàâçùûîôæœÉÈÊËÀÂÇÙÛÎÔÆŒ\s-]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '-');
titleShortPL = titleShortPL.replace(/[^\wąćęłńóśźżĄĆĘŁŃÓŚŹŻ\s-]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '-');

// Format: ASIN-[ASIN]-[Language]-[titleLANGshort]-[titlePLshort]-[sellername]-OPIS-PRODUKTU-[Date]
const docName = `ASIN-${asin}-${language}-${titleShortLang}-${titleShortPL}-${sellerName}-OPIS-PRODUKTU-${datePart}`;

// Step 1: Copy template with temporary name (working document)
Logger.log(`Step 1: Copying template as working document...`);
const templateFile = DriveApp.getFileById(TEMPLATE_ID);
const workingFile = templateFile.makeCopy(`TEMP-WORKING-${asin}-${Date.now()}`);
const workingDocId = workingFile.getId();
const workingDoc = DocumentApp.openById(workingDocId);
const body = workingDoc.getBody();

Logger.log(`Step 2: Replacing placeholders in working document...`);

// Prepare A+ modules text
let aplusTexts = ['', '', '', ''];
if (data.aplusModules && data.aplusModules.length > 0) {
  data.aplusModules.forEach((moduleJson, idx) => {
    if (!moduleJson || idx >= 4) return;
    try {
      const module = typeof moduleJson === 'string' ? JSON.parse(moduleJson) : moduleJson;
      let moduleText = `MODUL ${idx + 1}: ${module.module_type || 'Custom'}\n`;
      if (module.header_de) moduleText += `HEADER: ${module.header_de}\n`;
      if (module.content_de) moduleText += `CONTENT: ${module.content_de}\n`;
      if (module.image_suggestions_pl) moduleText += `IMAGES (PL): ${module.image_suggestions_pl}`;
      aplusTexts[idx] = moduleText;
    } catch (e) {
      Logger.log(`Error parsing A+ module ${idx}: ${e.message}`);
    }
  });
}

// Replace all placeholders
body.replaceText('{{ASIN}}', asin);
body.replaceText('{{TITLE_DE}}', data.titleDE || '');
body.replaceText('{{TITLE_DE_SHORT}}', titleShortLang);  // Fixed: was titleDEshort (undefined)
body.replaceText('{{TITLE_SHORT_LANG}}', titleShortLang);  // New placeholder for language-specific short title
body.replaceText('{{TITLE_PL}}', data.titlePL || '');
body.replaceText('{{TITLE_PL_SHORT}}', titleShortPL);  // Fixed: was titlePLshort (undefined)
body.replaceText('{{TITLE_SHORT_PL}}', titleShortPL);  // New placeholder for Polish short title
body.replaceText('{{BULLET_1}}', data.bullets[0] || '');
body.replaceText('{{BULLET_2}}', data.bullets[1] || '');
body.replaceText('{{BULLET_3}}', data.bullets[2] || '');
body.replaceText('{{BULLET_4}}', data.bullets[3] || '');
body.replaceText('{{BULLET_5}}', data.bullets[4] || '');
body.replaceText('{{DESCRIPTION_HTML}}', data.descriptionHTML || '');
body.replaceText('{{KEYWORDS}}', data.keywords || '');

// Infographics
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
  const infog = data.infographics[i] || { textDE: '', instructionsPL: '' };
  body.replaceText(`{{IMAGE_${i + 1}_TEXT_DE}}`, infog.textDE || '');
  body.replaceText(`{{IMAGE_${i + 1}_INSTRUCTIONS_PL}}`, infog.instructionsPL || '');
}

// Video
body.replaceText('{{VIDEO_TEXT_DE}}', data.video?.textDE || '');
body.replaceText('{{VIDEO_INSTRUCTIONS_PL}}', data.video?.instructionsPL || '');

// A+ Modules
body.replaceText('{{APLUS_MODULE_1}}', aplusTexts[0]);
body.replaceText('{{APLUS_MODULE_2}}', aplusTexts[1]);
body.replaceText('{{APLUS_MODULE_3}}', aplusTexts[2]);
body.replaceText('{{APLUS_MODULE_4}}', aplusTexts[3]);

// Brand and other fields
body.replaceText('{{BRAND_STORY}}', data.brandStory || '');
body.replaceText('{{BRAND_STORE}}', data.brandStoreSuggestions || '');
// Language placeholder (both uppercase and lowercase versions)
body.replaceText('{{LANGUAGE}}', language);
body.replaceText('{{language}}', language);

// Step 3: Save working document
Logger.log(`Step 3: Saving working document...`);
workingDoc.saveAndClose();

// Wait a bit to ensure save completes
Utilities.sleep(1000);

// Step 4: Create clean copy with final name (no placeholder history!)
Logger.log(`Step 4: Creating clean copy with final name...`);
const finalFile = workingFile.makeCopy(docName);
const finalDocId = finalFile.getId();
const finalDocUrl = finalFile.getUrl();

// Step 4b: Move to LISTING_FILES folder
Logger.log(`Step 4b: Moving document to LISTING_FILES folder...`);
const targetFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(DRIVE_FOLDER_ID);
finalFile.moveTo(targetFolder);

// Step 5: Delete working document
Logger.log(`Step 5: Deleting working document...`);
DriveApp.getFileById(workingDocId).setTrashed(true);

// Step 6: Share final document
Logger.log(`Step 6: Sharing final document...`);
finalFile.setSharing(DriveApp.Access.ANYONE_WITH_LINK, DriveApp.Permission.COMMENT);

// Save Doc URL to INPUT sheet and OUTPUT sheet
updateDocUrl(asin, finalDocUrl);
saveOutputUrl(asin, 'doc', finalDocUrl);

Logger.log(`✅ Google Doc created (clean copy without placeholder history): ${finalDocUrl}`);
return { doc: DocumentApp.openById(finalDocId), url: finalDocUrl, id: finalDocId };

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Error creating Google Doc: ${error.message});
updateStatus(asin, 'ERROR', Doc Error: ${error.message});
throw error;
}
}

// ============================================================================
// PDF EXPORT
// ============================================================================

/**

Export Google Doc to PDF
*/
function exportToPDF(asin) {
Logger.log(Exporting PDF for ${asin}...);
try {
const docUrl = getDocUrl(asin);
if (!docUrl) {
throw new Error('No Google Doc URL found. Create document first.');
}

// Extract document ID from URL - support both formats:
// Format 1: https://docs.google.com/document/d/ID/edit
// Format 2: https://docs.google.com/open?id=ID
let docId;

const match1 = docUrl.match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
const match2 = docUrl.match(/[?&]id=([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);

if (match1) {
  docId = match1[1];
} else if (match2) {
  docId = match2[1];
} else {
  throw new Error(`Invalid document URL format: ${docUrl}`);
}

Logger.log(`Extracted doc ID: ${docId}`);

// Get the file and export as PDF
const file = DriveApp.getFileById(docId);
const pdfBlob = file.getAs('application/pdf');
pdfBlob.setName(`Amazon-Listing-${asin}.pdf`);

// Create PDF in root first, then move to LISTING_FILES folder
const rootFolder = DriveApp.getRootFolder();
const pdfFile = rootFolder.createFile(pdfBlob);

// Move to LISTING_FILES folder
const targetFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(DRIVE_FOLDER_ID);
pdfFile.moveTo(targetFolder);
Logger.log(`Moved PDF to LISTING_FILES folder`);

// Make publicly accessible
pdfFile.setSharing(DriveApp.Access.ANYONE_WITH_LINK, DriveApp.Permission.VIEW);

const pdfUrl = pdfFile.getUrl();
saveOutputUrl(asin, 'pdf', pdfUrl);

Logger.log(`✅ PDF exported: ${pdfUrl}`);

return { file: pdfFile, url: pdfUrl, id: pdfFile.getId() };

} catch (error) {
Logger.log(❌ Error exporting PDF: ${error.message});
updateStatus(asin, 'ERROR', PDF Error: ${error.message});
throw error;
}
}
